localRange.text: 校勘記一：霞瀨益石烈張元濟校勘記〈（以下稱張校）〉引百官志一「石烈，縣也」，百官志二「弭裏，鄉也」，謂石烈下不應綴鄉字。按國語解又以石烈為鄉，弭裏為鄉之小者。石烈鄉，鄉字亦復贅。檢下文太祖七年六月轄賴縣、營衛志下六院部轄懶石烈，均此名異譯。鄉字衍。二：伐河東代北代北，原誤「伐北」，據兵衛志上及永樂大典〈（道光殿本考證引）〉改。三：如迂王集會堝紀太宗天顯五年十月作如迂正集會堝。四：夏四月丁未朔唐梁王朱全忠廢其主尋弑之錢大昕廿二史考異〈（以下稱考異）〉引歐陽修五代史記〈（以下稱新五代史）〉，梁王即位在四月甲子，明年正月「弑濟陰王」。此系之四月朔，誤。五：河東李克用卒卒字，據張校補。六：皇后急遣蜀古魯救之蜀古魯，儀衛志四作曷古魯，是。七：問諸弟面木葉山射鬼箭厭禳馮家升遼史初校〈（以下稱馮校）〉云：問當作聞。八：晉幽州節度使盧國用來降按此為次年二月盧文進來降之重出。考異又論是時幽州節度使為周德威，不能同時又是盧國用。因文進為契丹平州節度使，遂誤以契丹所授之官為唐官。輯本薛居正五代史〈（以下稱舊五代史）〉九七文進字國用，新五代史四八作大用。九：李嗣恩之子武八嗣恩，原誤「嗣本」。按新、舊五代史李嗣本傳均不稱有子武八。檢舊五代史五二李嗣恩傳：「有子二人，長曰武八┅┅戰契丹於新州，歿焉。據改。

sourceRange.text: 天顯元年春正月己未，白氣貫日。庚申，拔扶餘城，誅其守將。丙寅，命惕隱安端、前北府宰相蕭阿古只等將萬騎為先鋒，遇諲譔老相兵，破之。皇太子、大元帥堯骨、南府宰相蘇、北院夷離堇斜涅赤，南院夷離堇迭里是夜圍忽汗城。己巳，諲譔請降。庚午，駐軍於忽汗城南。辛未，諲譔素服，稿索牽羊，率僚屬三百餘人出降。上優禮而釋之。甲戌，詔諭渤海郡縣。丙子，遣近侍康末怛等十三人入城索兵器，為邏卒所害。丁丑，諲譔復叛，攻其城，破之。駕幸城中。諲譔請罪馬前。詔以兵衛諲譔及族屬以出。祭告天地。復還軍中。二月庚寅，安邊、鄚頡、南海、定理等府及諸道節度、刺史來朝，慰勞遣之。

manualTranslations.zh: 二年春正月，天德、蕭翰、劉哥、盆都等謀反。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 誅天德，杖蕭翰，遷劉哥於邊，罰盆都使轄戛斯國。
manualTranslations.literal: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was beaten with the staff, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was flogged, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢主劉知遠殂，子承祐立。
manualTranslations.literal: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，南唐遣李朗、王祚來慰且賀，兼奉蠟丸書，議攻漢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo to offer condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss attacking Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo with condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss an attack on Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬申，皇子賢生。
manualTranslations.literal: On renshen day in the seventh autumn month Prince Xian was born.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on renshen day, Prince Xian was born.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月壬午，南京留守魏王趙延壽薨，以中臺省右相牒哷葛為南京留守，封燕王。
manualTranslations.literal: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Dielige was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Dielige, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，駐蹕彰武南。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.

sourceRange.text: 五年春正月癸亥朔，如百泉湖。漢郭威弒其主自立，國號周，遣朱憲來告。即遣使致良馬。漢劉崇自立於太原。二月，周遣姚漢英、華昭胤來，以書辭抗禮，留漢英等。夏五月壬戌朔，太子太傅趙瑩薨，輟朝一日，命歸葬於汴。詔州縣錄事參軍、主簿委政事省銓註。六月辛卯朔，劉崇為周所攻，遣使稱，乞援，且求封冊。即遣燕王牒哷、樞密使高勛冊為大漢神武皇帝。南唐遣蔣洪來，乞舉兵應援。是夏，清暑百泉嶺。九月庚申朔，自將南伐。壬戌，次歸化州祥古山。癸亥，祭讓國皇帝於行宮。群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。應歷元年，葬於顯州西山，陵曰顯陵。二年，謚孝和皇帝，廟號世宗。統和二十六年七月，加謚孝和莊憲皇帝。

context.afterSource: 贊曰：世宗中才之主也，入繼大統，曾未三年，納唐丸書，即議南伐，即乏持重，宜乖周防，蓋有致禍之道矣。
context.afterLocal: 贊曰：世宗中才之主也，入繼大統，曾未三年，納唐丸書，即議南伐，即乏持重，宜乖周防，蓋有致禍之道矣。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年春正月癸亥朔，如百泉湖。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢郭威弒其主自立，國號周，遣朱憲來告。
manualTranslations.literal: Guo Wei of Han murdered his lord and declared himself emperor; his state name was Zhou, and he sent Zhu Xian to report it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Wei of Han murdered his sovereign and declared himself emperor under the state name Zhou, then sent Zhu Xian to announce it.

manualTranslations.zh: 即遣使致良馬。
manualTranslations.literal: At once envoys were dispatched presenting fine horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He at once sent envoys presenting fine horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢劉崇自立於太原。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，周遣姚漢英、華昭胤來，以書辭抗禮，留漢英等。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language of equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language asserting equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月壬戌朔，太子太傅趙瑩薨，輟朝一日，命歸葬於汴。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered buried at Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered interred at Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔州縣錄事參軍、主簿委政事省銓註。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月辛卯朔，劉崇為周所攻，遣使稱，乞援，且求封冊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and also requesting investiture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and requesting formal investiture.

manualTranslations.zh: 即遣燕王牒哷、樞密使高勛冊為大漢神武皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: At once Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun were dispatched to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He at once sent Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 南唐遣蔣洪來，乞舉兵應援。
manualTranslations.literal: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夏，清暑百泉嶺。
manualTranslations.literal: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚申朔，自將南伐。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，次歸化州祥古山。
manualTranslations.literal: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸亥，祭讓國皇帝於行宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。
manualTranslations.literal: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated, aged thirty-four.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated at the age of thirty-four.

manualTranslations.zh: 應歷元年，葬於顯州西山，陵曰顯陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，謚孝和皇帝，廟號世宗。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with temple name Shizong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with the temple name Shizong.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和二十六年七月，加謚孝和莊憲皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.

sourceRange.text: 四年春二月癸亥，漢以皇子生，遣使來賀。閏月戊申，齊王罨撒葛薨。三月庚申朔，追冊為皇太叔。夏四月庚寅朔，追封蕭思溫為楚國王。是夏，駐蹕冰井。秋七月，如云州。丁丑，鼻骨德來貢。冬十月丁亥朔，如南京。十二月甲午，詔內外官上封事。

context.afterSource: 五年春正月甲子，惕隱休哥伐党項，破之，以俘獲之數來上。
context.afterLocal: 五年春正月甲子，惕隱休哥伐党項，破之，以俘獲之數來上。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春二月癸亥，漢以皇子生，遣使來賀。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, on guihai day of the second spring month, Han, because a prince was born, sent envoys to offer congratulations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on guihai day in the second spring month, Han sent envoys to offer congratulations on the birth of a prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月戊申，齊王罨撒葛薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Prince of Qi Yansage died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Prince of Qi Yansage died.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月庚申朔，追冊為皇太叔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, Yansage was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月庚寅朔，追封蕭思溫為楚國王。
manualTranslations.literal: That summer, on the gengyin new moon of the fourth month, Xiao Siwen was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That summer, on the gengyin new moon of the fourth month, Xiao Siwen was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夏，駐蹕冰井。
manualTranslations.literal: That summer the court encamped at Bingjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That summer the court encamped at Ice Well.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，如云州。
manualTranslations.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, went to Yun Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor went to Yun Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，鼻骨德來貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingchou day Biegude came to offer tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Biegude sent tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，如南京。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, went to the Southern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月甲午，詔內外官上封事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiawu day, an edict ordered inner and outer officials to submit sealed memorials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu day, an edict ordered officials throughout the court to submit sealed memorials.

sourceRange.text: 四年春正月己亥，如華林、天柱。三月乙未，清明，與諸王大臣較射，宴飲。夏四月，自將南伐。至滿城，戰不利，守太尉奚瓦里中流矢死。統軍使善補為伏兵所圍，樞密使斜軫救免，詔以失備杖之。五月，班師。清暑燕子城。秋七月壬辰，遣使賜喜隱死。八月，如西京。九月庚子，幸雲州。甲辰，獵於祥古山，帝不豫。壬子，次焦山，崩於行在。年三十五，在位十三年。遺詔梁王隆緒嗣位，軍國大事聽皇后命。統和元年正月壬戌，上尊謚孝成皇帝，廟號景宗。重熙二十一年，加謚孝成康靖皇帝。

context.beforeSource: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
context.afterSource: 贊曰：遼興六十餘年，神冊、會同之間，日不暇給；
context.beforeLocal: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
context.afterLocal: 贊曰：遼興六十餘年，神冊、會同之間，日不暇給；

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春正月己亥，如華林、天柱。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, he went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on jihai day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月乙未，清明，與諸王大臣較射，宴飲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on yiwei day, at the Qingming festival, he competed in archery with princes and ministers and feasted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the third month, at Qingming, the Emperor competed in archery with princes and ministers and held a feast.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，自將南伐。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, fourth month, he personally led troops south on campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the fourth summer month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 至滿城，戰不利，守太尉奚瓦里中流矢死。
manualTranslations.literal: Reaching Mancheng, the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was struck by a flying arrow and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Mancheng the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was hit by a stray arrow and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 統軍使善補為伏兵所圍，樞密使斜軫救免，詔以失備杖之。
manualTranslations.literal: Army commander Shanbu was surrounded by ambush troops; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him caned for inadequate preparedness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Army commander Shanbu was trapped by ambushers; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him flogged for failing to stay alert.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，班師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, the army withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the army withdrew from the campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 清暑燕子城。
manualTranslations.literal: He escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬辰，遣使賜喜隱死。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, envoys were dispatched ordering Xiyin to death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to order Xiyin put to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，如西京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, he went to the Western Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Emperor went to the Western Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚子，幸雲州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he visited Yunzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month the Emperor visited Yunzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，獵於祥古山，帝不豫。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiachen day, he hunted at Xianggu Mountain; the Emperor fell ill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted at Xianggu Mountain and fell ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬子，次焦山，崩於行在。
manualTranslations.literal: On renzi day, he halted at Jiaoshan and died at the traveling palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court halted at Jiaoshan, and the Emperor died at the traveling palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 年三十五，在位十三年。
manualTranslations.literal: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned thirteen years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned for thirteen years.

manualTranslations.zh: 遺詔梁王隆緒嗣位，軍國大事聽皇后命。
manualTranslations.literal: His testamentary edict made Prince of Liang Longxu his successor; military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His testamentary edict named Prince of Liang Longxu successor, and military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's orders.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和元年正月壬戌，上尊謚孝成皇帝，廟號景宗。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tonghe, first month, on renxu day, the posthumous honorific title Xiaocheng Emperor was bestowed and the temple name Jingzong was announced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tonghe, on renxu day of the first month, the court bestowed the posthumous title Xiaocheng Emperor and the temple name Jingzong.

manualTranslations.zh: 重熙二十一年，加謚孝成康靖皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.

sourceRange.text: 四年秋九月壬子，景宗崩。癸丑，即皇帝位於柩前，時年十二。皇后奉遺詔攝政，詔諭諸道。冬十月己未朔，帝始臨朝。辛酉，群臣上尊號曰昭聖皇帝，尊皇后為皇太后，大赦。以南院大王勃古哲總領山西諸州事，北院大王、於越休哥為南面行軍都統，奚王和朔奴副之，同政事門下平章事蕭道寧領本部軍駐南京。己丑，如顯州。十一月甲午，置乾州。十二月戊午朔，耶律速撒討阻卜。辛酉，南京留守荊王道隱奏宋遣使獻犀帶請和，詔以無書卻之。甲子，撻剌幹乃萬十醉言宮掖事，法當死，杖而釋之。辛未，西南面招討使秦王韓匡嗣薨。癸酉，奉大行皇帝梓宮於菆塗殿。庚辰，省置中臺省官。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年秋九月壬子，景宗崩。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, autumn, ninth month, on renzi day, Jingzong died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on renzi day in the ninth autumn month, Jingzong died.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸丑，即皇帝位於柩前，時年十二。
manualTranslations.literal: On guichou day, he took the imperial throne before the coffin; he was then twelve years old.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guichou day he assumed the throne before the coffin; he was twelve years old.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇后奉遺詔攝政，詔諭諸道。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress carried out regency by testamentary edict; an edict was issued to instruct all circuits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress assumed regency under the testamentary edict, and an edict was issued to notify all circuits.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月己未朔，帝始臨朝。
manualTranslations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei new moon, the Emperor first held court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, on the jiwei new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor held his first audience.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛酉，群臣上尊號曰昭聖皇帝，尊皇后為皇太后，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinyou day the hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Zhaosheng; the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Zhaosheng, the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 以南院大王勃古哲總領山西諸州事，北院大王、於越休哥為南面行軍都統，奚王和朔奴副之，同政事門下平章事蕭道寧領本部軍駐南京。
manualTranslations.literal: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was put in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was placed in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 己丑，如顯州。
manualTranslations.literal: On jichou day, he went to Xian Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Emperor went to Xian Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月甲午，置乾州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, Qian Prefecture was established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, Qian Prefecture was established.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月戊午朔，耶律速撒討阻卜。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu new moon, Yelü Susa campaigned against the Zubu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the twelfth month, Yelü Susa campaigned against the Zubu.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛酉，南京留守荊王道隱奏宋遣使獻犀帶請和，詔以無書卻之。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinyou day, Nanjing regent Prince of Jing Daoyin reported that Song had sent envoys offering rhinoceros-horn belts and suing for peace; an edict refused on the grounds that no formal letter had been sent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Nanjing regent Prince of Jing Daoyin reported that Song had sent envoys with rhinoceros-horn belts to sue for peace; an edict rejected the overture because no formal letter accompanied it.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，撻剌幹乃萬十醉言宮掖事，法當死，杖而釋之。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiazi day, Tatala Gannai Wanshi, speaking while drunk of inner-palace affairs, should by law have died, but was caned and released.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Tatala Gannai Wanshi spoke of inner-palace affairs while drunk — a capital offense by law — but was beaten with the rod and released.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，西南面招討使秦王韓匡嗣薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinwei day, Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi, southwestern campaign commissioner, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Han Kuangsi, Prince of Qin and southwestern campaign commissioner, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸酉，奉大行皇帝梓宮於菆塗殿。
manualTranslations.literal: On guiyou day, the late Emperor's coffin was escorted to Zaitu Hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the late Emperor's coffin was escorted to Zaitu Hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚辰，省置中臺省官。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengchen day, offices of the Central Secretariat were reduced and reorganized.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the offices of the Central Secretariat were streamlined.

context.afterSource: 八年春正月辛巳，如臺湖。
context.afterLocal: 八年春正月辛巳，如臺湖。

sourceRange.text: 十六年春正月乙丑，如長濼。二月庚子，夏國遣使來貢。丙午，以監門衛上將軍耶律喜羅為中臺省左相。三月甲子，女直遣使來貢。乙亥，鼻骨德酋長來貢。夏四月癸卯，振崇德宮所隸州縣民之被水者。丁未，罷民輸官俸，給自內帑。己酉，祈雨。乙卯，如木葉山。五月甲子，祭白馬神。丁卯，祠木葉山，告來歲南伐。庚辰，鐵驪來貢。乙酉，還上京。婦人年逾九十者賜物。六月戊子朔，致奠於祖、懷二陵。是月，清暑炭山。秋七月丁巳朔，錄囚，聽政。八月丁亥朔，東幸。九月丁巳朔，駐蹕得勝口。冬十一月，遣使冊高麗國王誦。十二月丙戌朔，宋國王休哥薨，輟朝五日。進封皇弟恒王隆慶為梁國王、南京留守，鄭王隆祐為吳國王。是年，放進士楊又玄等二人。十七年春正月乙卯朔，如長春宮。夏四月，如炭山清暑。六月，兀惹烏昭慶來。秋七月，以伐宋詔諭諸道。九月庚辰朔，幸南京。乙亥，南伐。癸卯，射鬼箭。北院樞密使魏王耶律斜軫薨。以韓德讓兼知北院樞密使事。冬十月癸酉，攻遂城，不克，遣蕭繼遠攻狼山鎮石砦，破之。次瀛州，與宋軍戰，擒其將康昭裔、宋順，獲兵仗、器甲無算。進攻樂壽縣，拔之。次遂城，敵眾臨水以拒，縱騎兵突之，殺戮殆盡。是年，放進士初錫等四人及第。

context.afterSource: 十八年春正月，還次南京，賞有功將士，罰不用命者。
context.afterLocal: 十八年春正月，還次南京，賞有功將士，罰不用命者。

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年春正月乙丑，如長濼。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on yichou day, he went to Chang Marsh.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Tonghe, on yichou day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月庚子，夏國遣使來貢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on gengzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the second month Western Xia sent tribute envoys.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，以監門衛上將軍耶律喜羅為中臺省左相。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingwu day, made Gate Guard senior general Yelü Xiluo Central Secretariat left chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Gate Guard senior general Yelü Xiluo was appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月甲子，女直遣使來貢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on jiazi day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the third month the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，鼻骨德酋長來貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On yihai day, a Biegude chieftain came with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yihai day a Biegude chieftain came with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月癸卯，振崇德宮所隸州縣民之被水者。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on guimao day, relief was given to the people of prefectures and counties subordinate to Chongde Palace who had been inundated by flood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month the court provided relief to flood victims among the people of the prefectures and counties under Chongde Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未，罷民輸官俸，給自內帑。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingwei day, ended the people supplying official salaries; payment was made from the inner treasury.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court ended the practice of having the people supply official salaries, and salaries were paid from the inner treasury.

manualTranslations.zh: 己酉，祈雨。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiyou day, prayed for rain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court prayed for rain.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，如木葉山。
manualTranslations.literal: On yimao day, went to Mount Muye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor went to Mount Muye.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲子，祭白馬神。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi day, sacrificed to the White Horse Spirit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fifth month the court sacrificed to the White Horse Spirit.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，祠木葉山，告來歲南伐。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingmao day, offered sacrifice at Mount Muye, announcing next year's southern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court sacrificed at Mount Muye and proclaimed the southern campaign for the coming year.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚辰，鐵驪來貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengchen day, the Iron Li came with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Iron Li came with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，還上京。
manualTranslations.literal: On yiyou day, returned to the Supreme Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the court returned to the Supreme Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 婦人年逾九十者賜物。
manualTranslations.literal: Women over ninety years of age were granted gifts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Women over ninety years of age were granted gifts.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月戊子朔，致奠於祖、懷二陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi new moon, offerings were made at the Ancestor and Huai mausoleums.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the sixth month offerings were presented at the Ancestor and Huai mausoleums.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，清暑炭山。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, took summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月丁巳朔，錄囚，聽政。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on dingsi new moon, reviewed prisoners and held court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court reviewed prisoners and held audiences.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丁亥朔，東幸。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on dinghai new moon, traveled east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the eighth month the court traveled east.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月丁巳朔，駐蹕得勝口。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi new moon, imperial halt at Desheng Pass.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Desheng Pass.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月，遣使冊高麗國王誦。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, dispatched envoys to invest Goryeo King Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month envoys were dispatched to invest Goryeo King Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，宋國王休哥薨，輟朝五日。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingxu new moon, Song King Xiuge died; court audiences were suspended for five days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the twelfth month Song King Xiuge died, and court was suspended for five days.

manualTranslations.zh: 進封皇弟恒王隆慶為梁國王、南京留守，鄭王隆祐為吳國王。
manualTranslations.literal: Advanced and enfeoffed the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Heng Longqing as Prince of Liang and Nanjing garrison commander; Prince of Zheng Longyou as Prince of Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Heng Longqing was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Nanjing garrison commander, and Prince of Zheng Longyou as Prince of Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，放進士楊又玄等二人。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, jinshi Yang Youxuan and one other were passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Yang Youxuan and one other passed the examinations.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年春正月乙卯朔，如長春宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on yimao new moon, went to Changchun Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Tonghe, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Changchun Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，如炭山清暑。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, fourth month, went to Coal Mountain for summer coolness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，兀惹烏昭慶來。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, Wuran's Wuzhaoqing came.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wuran's Wuzhaoqing came.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，以伐宋詔諭諸道。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, by edict announced the campaign against Song to all circuits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month an edict notified all circuits of the campaign against Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚辰朔，幸南京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengchen new moon, favored Nanjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the ninth month the court went to Nanjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，南伐。
manualTranslations.literal: On yihai day, southern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yihai day a southern campaign was launched.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸卯，射鬼箭。
manualTranslations.literal: On guimao day, shot ghost arrows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court shot ghost arrows.

manualTranslations.zh: 北院樞密使魏王耶律斜軫薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Northern Court Privy Commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Xiezhen died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Xiezhen died.

manualTranslations.zh: 以韓德讓兼知北院樞密使事。
manualTranslations.literal: Made Han Derang also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han Derang was also made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月癸酉，攻遂城，不克，遣蕭繼遠攻狼山鎮石砦，破之。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guiyou day, attacked Suicheng but did not take it; dispatched Xiao Jiyuan to attack Langshan town's Stone Stockade and broke it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the army attacked Suicheng without success; Xiao Jiyuan was sent to attack the Stone Stockade at Langshan town and took it.

manualTranslations.zh: 次瀛州，與宋軍戰，擒其將康昭裔、宋順，獲兵仗、器甲無算。
manualTranslations.literal: Halting at Ying Prefecture, fought Song troops, captured their generals Kang Zhaoyi and Song Shun, obtained weapons and armor beyond counting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Ying Prefecture the army fought Song forces, captured generals Kang Zhaoyi and Song Shun, and seized countless weapons and armor.

manualTranslations.zh: 進攻樂壽縣，拔之。
manualTranslations.literal: Advanced to attack Leshou County and stormed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The army advanced against Leshou County and took it.

manualTranslations.zh: 次遂城，敵眾臨水以拒，縱騎兵突之，殺戮殆盡。
manualTranslations.literal: Halting at Suicheng, the enemy masses faced the water to resist; cavalry was loosed to charge them, and nearly all were slaughtered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Suicheng the enemy massed along the water to resist; cavalry was sent in a charge and nearly all were slaughtered.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，放進士初錫等四人及第。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, jinshi Chu Xi and three others were passed and granted degree.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Chu Xi and three others passed the examinations.

sourceRange.text: 興宗神聖孝章皇帝，諱宗真，字夷不堇，小字只骨。聖宗長子，母曰欽哀皇蕭氏。上始生，齊天皇后取養之。幼而聰明，長而魁偉，龍顏日角，豁達大度。善騎射，好儒術，通音律。三歲封梁王。太平元年，冊為皇太子。十年六月，判北南院樞密使事。

context.afterSource: 十一年夏六月己卯，聖宗崩，即皇帝位於柩前。

manualTranslations.zh: 興宗神聖孝章皇帝，諱宗真，字夷不堇，小字只骨。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xingzong Shensheng Xiaozhang, taboo name Zongzhen, courtesy name Yibujin, childhood name Zhigu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor Xingzong, posthumous title Shensheng Xiaozhang, personal name Zongzhen, courtesy name Yibujin, childhood name Zhigu.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖宗長子，母曰欽哀皇蕭氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Eldest son of Emperor Shengzong; his mother was Empress Qin'ai of the Xiao clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was the eldest son of Emperor Shengzong; his mother was Empress Qin'ai, née Xiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 上始生，齊天皇后取養之。
manualTranslations.literal: At his birth, Empress Qi Tian took him to raise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At his birth Empress Qi Tian took him to be raised.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼而聰明，長而魁偉，龍顏日角，豁達大度。
manualTranslations.literal: As a child he was clever; grown he was imposing in stature, with dragon countenance and sun-cornered brow, open-minded and magnanimous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a child he was clever; when grown he was imposing in stature, with a dragon-like countenance and sun-cornered brow, and was open-minded and magnanimous.

manualTranslations.zh: 善騎射，好儒術，通音律。
manualTranslations.literal: He excelled at mounted archery, loved Confucian learning, and understood music.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He excelled at mounted archery, loved Confucian learning, and was versed in music.

manualTranslations.zh: 三歲封梁王。
manualTranslations.literal: At three years old he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At three he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太平元年，冊為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taiping he was invested as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping he was invested as crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年六月，判北南院樞密使事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year he was assigned to oversee Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year he was assigned to oversee Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs.

localRange.text: 興宗二

context.afterSource: 十年春正月辛亥朔，宋遣梁適、張從一、富弼、趙日宣來賀。

sourceRange.text: 二十四年春正月癸亥，如混同江。戊辰，朝皇太后。辛巳，宋遣使來賀，饋馴象。二月己丑朔，召宋使釣魚、賦詩。癸巳，如長春河。甲寅，夏國遣使來賀。三月癸亥，皇太弟重元生子，曲赦行在及長春、鎮北二州徒以下罪。夏五月，駐蹕南崖。秋七月，壬午，如秋山。次南崖之北峪，不豫。八月丁亥，疾大漸，召燕趙國王洪基，諭以治國之要。戊子，大赦，縱五坊鷹鶻，焚釣魚之具。己丑，帝崩於行宮，年四十。遺詔燕趙國王洪基嗣位。清寧元年十月庚子，上尊謚為神聖孝章皇帝，廟號興宗。贊曰：興宗即位，年十有六矣，不能先尊母后而尊其母，以致臨朝專政，賊殺不辜，又不能以禮幾諫，使齊天死於弒逆，有虧王者之孝，惜哉！若夫大行在殯，飲酒博鞠，疊見簡書。及其謁遺像而哀慟，受宋吊而衰绖，所為若出二人。何為其然歟？至於感富弼之言而申南宋之好，許諒祚之盟而罷西夏之兵，邊鄙不聳，政治內修，親策進士，大修條制，下至士庶，得陳便宜，則求治之志切矣。於時左右大臣，曾不聞一賢之進，一事之諫，欲庶幾古帝王之風，其可得乎？雖然，聖宗而下，可謂賢君矣。

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年春正月癸亥，如混同江。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, on guihai day, went to the Huntong River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on guihai day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊辰，朝皇太后。
manualTranslations.literal: On wuchen day, audience with the Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛巳，宋遣使來賀，饋馴象。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinsi day, Song dispatched envoys to offer congratulations and presented a trained elephant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Song sent envoys to offer congratulations and presented a trained elephant.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月己丑朔，召宋使釣魚、賦詩。
manualTranslations.literal: Second month, on jichou new moon, summoned Song envoys to fish and compose poetry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the second month Song envoys were summoned to fish and compose poetry.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸巳，如長春河。
manualTranslations.literal: On guisi day, went to the Changchun River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guisi day the court went to the Changchun River.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣使來賀。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiayin day, Xia State dispatched envoys to offer congratulations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xia State sent envoys to offer congratulations.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月癸亥，皇太弟重元生子，曲赦行在及長春、鎮北二州徒以下罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Third month, on guihai day, the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan had a son; partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor in the travel palace and Changchun and Zhenbei prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the third month the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan had a son; a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor in the travel palace and in Changchun and Zhenbei prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月，駐蹕南崖。
manualTranslations.literal: Summer, fifth month, halted at Nanya.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court halted at Nanya.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，壬午，如秋山。
manualTranslations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renwu day, went to autumn mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

manualTranslations.zh: 次南崖之北峪，不豫。
manualTranslations.literal: Stopped at the northern ravine of Nanya and fell ill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court stopped at the northern ravine of Nanya and fell ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丁亥，疾大漸，召燕趙國王洪基，諭以治國之要。
manualTranslations.literal: Eighth month, on dinghai day, illness grew grave; summoned Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji and instructed him on essentials of governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the eighth month the illness grew grave; Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was summoned and instructed on the essentials of governance.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊子，大赦，縱五坊鷹鶻，焚釣魚之具。
manualTranslations.literal: On wuzi day, great amnesty; released the five-compound hawks and falcons; burned fishing equipment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuzi day a great amnesty was proclaimed; the five-compound hawks and falcons were released and fishing equipment was burned.

manualTranslations.zh: 己丑，帝崩於行宮，年四十。
manualTranslations.literal: On jichou day the Emperor died at the mobile palace, age forty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Emperor died at the mobile palace at age forty.

manualTranslations.zh: 遺詔燕趙國王洪基嗣位。
manualTranslations.literal: The testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji to succeed to the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji to succeed to the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧元年十月庚子，上尊謚為神聖孝章皇帝，廟號興宗。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qingning, tenth month, on gengzi day the elevated posthumous title Sacred Filial Zhang Emperor was granted, temple name Xingzong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingning, on gengzi day of the tenth month, the posthumous title Sacred Filial Zhang Emperor was elevated and the temple name Xingzong was granted.

manualTranslations.zh: 贊曰：興宗即位，年十有六矣，不能先尊母后而尊其母，以致臨朝專政，賊殺不辜，又不能以禮幾諫，使齊天死於弒逆，有虧王者之孝，惜哉！
manualTranslations.literal: The eulogy says: When Xingzong took the throne he was already sixteen; he could not first honor the Empress Mother but instead exalted his own mother, with the result that she monopolized court power, unjustly killed the innocent, and again he could not remonstrate by proper ritual, allowing Qitian to die by regicide — a breach of princely filial piety. Alas!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: When Xingzong took the throne he was already sixteen; he could not first honor the Empress Mother but instead exalted his own mother, with the result that she monopolized court power, unjustly killed the innocent, and again he could not remonstrate by proper ritual, allowing Qitian to die by regicide — a breach of princely filial piety. Alas!

manualTranslations.zh: 若夫大行在殯，飲酒博鞠，疊見簡書。
manualTranslations.literal: When the late emperor's coffin still lay in state he drank wine and played cuju football, repeatedly drawing rebuke in memorials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While the late emperor's coffin still lay in state he drank wine and played cuju football, repeatedly drawing rebuke in memorials.

manualTranslations.zh: 及其謁遺像而哀慟，受宋吊而衰绖，所為若出二人。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet when he paid homage before the departed image he wailed in grief, and when accepting Song's condolences he wore mourning hemp — his conduct seemed that of two men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet when he paid homage before the departed image he wailed in grief, and when accepting Song's condolences he wore mourning hemp — his conduct seemed that of two men.

manualTranslations.zh: 何為其然歟？
manualTranslations.literal: Why was this so?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why was this so?

manualTranslations.zh: 至於感富弼之言而申南宋之好，許諒祚之盟而罷西夏之兵，邊鄙不聳，政治內修，親策進士，大修條制，下至士庶，得陳便宜，則求治之志切矣。
manualTranslations.literal: As to responding to Fu Bi's words and renewing friendship with Southern Song, permitting Liangzuo's treaty and standing down Western Xia's forces — the frontiers were untroubled and governance was reformed within; he personally examined the jinshi, greatly revised statutes, and allowed even commoners to present expedients — his desire for good order was earnest indeed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As to responding to Fu Bi's words and renewing friendship with Southern Song, permitting Liangzuo's treaty and standing down Western Xia's forces — the frontiers were untroubled and governance was reformed within; he personally examined the jinshi, greatly revised statutes, and allowed even commoners to present expedients — his desire for good order was earnest indeed.

manualTranslations.zh: 於時左右大臣，曾不聞一賢之進，一事之諫，欲庶幾古帝王之風，其可得乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Yet at that time among the ministers at his side one never heard of a worthy advanced or a matter remonstrated — how could one hope for the manner of ancient emperors and kings?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet at that time among the ministers at his side one never heard of a worthy advanced or a matter remonstrated — how could one hope for the manner of ancient emperors and kings?

manualTranslations.zh: 雖然，聖宗而下，可謂賢君矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Even so, from Shengzong downward he may be called a worthy ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even so, from Shengzong downward he may be called a worthy ruler.

sourceRange.text: 六年春正月甲午，如千鵝濼。二月丙寅，阻卜來朝，貢方物。夏四月癸未，西北路招討司以所降阻卜酋長至行在。五月甲辰，清暑拖古烈。甲寅，設賢良科，詔應是科者，先以所業十萬言進。六月辛巳，阻卜來朝。乙酉，以惕隱耶律白為中京留守。是月，禦永安殿放進士趙廷睦等百三十八人。秋七月辛亥，獵於合魯聶特。八月丙子，耶律白薨，追封遼西郡王。九月庚戌，幸藕絲澱。甲寅，以馬希白詩才敏妙，十吏書不能給，召試之。冬十月丁卯，五國部長來朝。壬申，西北路招討司擒阻卜酋長來獻。十一月乙卯，禁鬻生熟鐵於回鶻、阻卜等界。十二月戊午，加圓釋、法鈞二僧並守司空。己未，以坤寧節，赦死罪以下。辛酉，禁漢人捕獵。

context.afterSource: 七年春正月戊子，如鴨子河。
context.afterLocal: 七年春正月戊子，如鴨子河。

manualTranslations.zh: 六年春正月甲午，如千鵝濼。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, went to Qian'e Marsh.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on jiawu day of the first spring month the court went to Qian'e Marsh.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月丙寅，阻卜來朝，貢方物。
manualTranslations.literal: Second month, on bingyin day Zubu came to court and presented local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingyin day of the second month Zubu came to court and presented local products.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月癸未，西北路招討司以所降阻卜酋長至行在。
manualTranslations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day Northwest Route pacification office brought surrendered Zubu chieftains to the imperial halt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month Northwest Route pacification office brought surrendered Zubu chieftains to the imperial halt.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲辰，清暑拖古烈。
manualTranslations.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day summered at Tuogulie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fifth month the court summered at Tuogulie.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲寅，設賢良科，詔應是科者，先以所業十萬言進。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiayin day established the Worthy-and-Good examination; edict ordered those answering it first to submit one hundred thousand characters of their work.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Worthy-and-Good examination was established; an edict ordered candidates first to submit one hundred thousand characters of their work.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月辛巳，阻卜來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi day Zubu came to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the sixth month Zubu came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，以惕隱耶律白為中京留守。
manualTranslations.literal: On yiyou day tiyin Yelü Bai was made Central Capital regent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yiyou day tiyin Yelü Bai was made Central Capital regent.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，禦永安殿放進士趙廷睦等百三十八人。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhao Tingmu and one hundred thirty-eight others were passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhao Tingmu and one hundred thirty-eight others were passed.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月辛亥，獵於合魯聶特。
manualTranslations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day hunted at Helu Niete.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Helu Niete.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丙子，耶律白薨，追封遼西郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: Eighth month, on bingzi day Yelü Bai died; posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eighth month Yelü Bai died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚戌，幸藕絲澱。
manualTranslations.literal: Ninth month, on gengxu day visited Ousi Marsh.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the ninth month the court visited Ousi Marsh.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲寅，以馬希白詩才敏妙，十吏書不能給，召試之。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiayin day because Ma Xibai's poetic talent was keen and nimble and ten clerks' transcription could not keep pace, summoned him for examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiayin day because Ma Xibai's poetic talent was keen and nimble and ten clerks could not keep pace with transcription, he was summoned for examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月丁卯，五國部長來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day chieftains of the Five States came to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month chieftains of the Five States came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，西北路招討司擒阻卜酋長來獻。
manualTranslations.literal: On renshen day Northwest Route pacification office captured Zubu chieftains and brought them as tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renshen day Northwest Route pacification office captured Zubu chieftains and presented them as tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月乙卯，禁鬻生熟鐵於回鶻、阻卜等界。
manualTranslations.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day forbidden sale of raw and wrought iron on the borders with Uighur, Zubu, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month sale of raw and wrought iron on the borders with Uighur, Zubu, and others was forbidden.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月戊午，加圓釋、法鈞二僧並守司空。
manualTranslations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuwu day monks Yuanshi and Fajun were both promoted acting Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the twelfth month monks Yuanshi and Fajun were both promoted acting Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，以坤寧節，赦死罪以下。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiwei day, because of the Kunning Festival, amnesty for offenses from capital crime downward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, because of the Kunning Festival, amnesty was granted for offenses from capital crime downward.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛酉，禁漢人捕獵。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinyou day forbidden Han people to hunt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Han people were forbidden to hunt.

localRange.text: 校勘記一：辛亥葬仁聖大孝文皇帝宣懿皇后于慶陵遼文匯八道宗哀冊、宣懿哀冊並作壬子將遷座於永福陵。二：其弟阿骨打襲按金史世紀，楊割〈（盈歌）〉卒於乾統三年癸未，烏雅束襲；烏雅束卒于天慶三年癸巳，阿骨打襲。此系帶敘，年份未合。三：宋遣林洙來議與夏約和林洙，國志一○、宋史二○及長編並作林攄。四：知北院樞密使事蕭得里底事字原脫，據上文四年六月及卷一○○本傳補。五：遣劉正符曹穆來告劉正符，國志一○、宋史二○及長編並作劉正夫。六：以和魯斡為義和仁聖皇太叔按皇子表，聖作壽。和魯斡與天祚為祖孫輩，「皇太叔」系封號。七：封高麗王為三韓國公贈其父為高麗國王按高麗史一一，壽昌三年已封為高麗王，六年已封為三韓國公。又卷一二，六年二月，遼遣使冊為高麗王，無追封之事。八：正月如鴨子河至二月幸混同江按紀太平四年二月，「詔改鴨子河曰混同江」。但此後鴨子河之名仍沿用未廢。九：其弟吳乞買粘罕胡舍等嘗從獵按國志一○云：「阿骨打有弟曰吳乞馬、粘罕、胡舍輩，天祚歲入秋山，數人必從行。吳乞馬即吳乞買，漢名晟，為阿骨打之弟。粘罕，本名粘沒喝，又作粘哥，金史七四有傳作宗翰；胡舍即胡舍，大金國志二七有傳作骨舍。二人均阿骨打之。一○：阿骨打乃與弟粘罕胡舍等謀「弟」，應作。三※校勘記」九：。一一：冬十月壬寅朔冬字，依文例補。朔字，據朔考補。一二：蕭敵里亦坐免官按蕭敵里即上文蕭嗣先，金史作蕭寁里。一三：西北路招討使耶律斡里朵為行軍都統國志一○作「北樞密副使耶律斡離朵淶流河路都統」。

sourceRange.text: 延慶三年，班師東歸，馬行二十日，得善地，遂建都城，號虎思斡耳朶，改延慶為康國元年。三月，以六院司大王蕭斡里剌為兵馬都元帥，敵剌部前同知樞密院事蕭查剌阿不副之，茶赤剌部禿魯耶律燕山為都部署，護衞耶律鐵哥為都監，率七萬騎東征。以青牛白馬祭天，樹旗以誓于眾曰：「我大遼自太祖、太宗艱難而成帝業，其後嗣君耽樂無厭，不恤國政，盜賊蠭起，天下土崩。朕率爾眾，遠至朔漠，期復大業，以光中興。此非朕與爾世居之地。」申命元帥斡里剌曰：「今汝其往，信賞必罰，與士卒同甘苦，擇善水草以立營，量敵而進，毋自取禍敗也。」行萬餘里無所得，牛馬多死，勒兵而還。大石曰：「皇天弗順，數也！」康國十年歿，在位二十年，廟號德宗。

localRange.text: 校勘記至天德按金史八二蕭仲恭傳作「至霍里底泊」。清甯初太后鞠育之按淳死於保大二年，若「年六十」無誤，則當生於清寧九年，「清甯初」有誤字。天祚即位進王鄭按紀乾統元年六月，以北平郡王淳進封鄭王。乾統二年加越王按紀乾統三年十一月，鄭王淳進封越國王。宰相李純按紀保大二年三月及卷一○二本傳並作李處溫。大黃室韋等十八部按敵剌，百官志二作敵烈；王紀剌即金史之廣吉刺、元史之宏吉剌；茶赤剌，紀大安十年四月、百官志二並作茶劄剌，即元史之劄只剌特；鼻古特，百官志二作鼻國德；密兒紀，紀壽隆三年二月作梅里急，即元秘史之篾兒乞；忽母思，即百官志二之胡母思山部，兵衛志下之胡母思山蕃；糾而畢，部族表作紀而畢。卜古罕城羅校謂即太祖紀之古回鶻城。蕭剌阿不按下文作蕭查剌阿不。

sourceRange.text: 保大二年，天祚入夾山，奚王回離保、林牙耶律大石等引唐靈武故事，議欲立淳。淳不從，官屬勸進曰：「主上蒙塵，中原擾攘，若不立王，百姓何歸？宜熟計之。」遂即位。百官上號天錫皇帝，改保大二年為建福元年，大赦。放進士李寶信等一十九人，遙降天祚為湘陰王。以燕、雲、平、上京、中京、遼西六路，淳主之；沙漠以北、南北路兩都招討府、諸蕃部族等，仍隸天祚。自此遼國分矣。封其妻普賢女為德妃，以回離保知北院樞密使事，軍旅之事悉委大石。又遣使報宋，免歲幣，結好。宋人發兵問罪，擊敗之。尋遣使奉表于金，乞為附庸。事未决，淳病死，年六十。百官偽諡曰孝章皇帝，廟號宣宗，葬燕西香山永安陵。遺命遙立秦王定以存社稷，德妃為皇太后，稱制，改建福為德興元年，放進士李球等百八人。時宋兵來攻，戰敗之，由是人心大悅，兵勢日振。宰相李純等潛納宋兵，居民內應，抱關者被殺甚眾。翌日，攻內東門，衞兵力戰，宋軍大潰，踰城而走，死者相藉。五表于金，求立秦王，不從。而金兵大至，德妃奔天德軍，見天祚。天祚怒，誅德妃，降淳庶人，除其屬籍。

sourceRange.text: 奚王府六部五帳分。其先曰時瑟，事東遙裏十帳部主哲裏。後逐哲裏，自立為奚王。卒，弟吐勒斯立。遙輦鮮質可汗討之，俘其拒敵者七百戶，摭其降者。以時瑟鄰睦之故，止俘部曲之半，余悉留焉。奚勢由是衰矣。初為五部：曰遙裏，曰伯德，曰奧裏，曰梅只，曰楚裏。太祖盡降之，號五部奚。天贊二年，有東扒裏廝胡損者，恃險堅壁於箭笴山以拒命，揶諭曰：大軍何能為，我當飲墮瑰門下矣！」太祖滅之，以奚府給役戶，並括諸部隱丁，收合流散，置墮瑰部，因墮瑰門之語為名，遂號六部奚。命勃魯恩主之，仍號奚王。太宗即位，置宰相、常袞各二員。聖宗合奧裏、梅只、墮瑰三部為一；特置二克部以足六部之數。奚王和朔奴討兀惹，敗績，籍六部隸北府。

manualTranslations.literal: Xi Princely Residence: six divisions and five accounts.

manualTranslations.zh: 其先曰時瑟，事東遙裏十帳部主哲裏。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly there was Shise, who served Zheli, lord of the Eastern Yaoli ten-account division.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Formerly there was Shise, who served Zheli, lord of the Eastern Yaoli ten-account division.

manualTranslations.zh: 後逐哲裏，自立為奚王。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he expelled Zheli and declared himself Xi King.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he expelled Zheli and declared himself Xi King.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，弟吐勒斯立。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, his younger brother Tulesi succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, his younger brother Tulesi succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 遙輦鮮質可汗討之，俘其拒敵者七百戶，摭其降者。
manualTranslations.literal: Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian line campaigned against him, capturing seven hundred households of those who resisted and gathering those who surrendered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian line campaigned against him, capturing seven hundred households of those who resisted and gathering those who surrendered.

manualTranslations.zh: 以時瑟鄰睦之故，止俘部曲之半，余悉留焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of Shise's neighborly amity, only half of the followers were taken captive; the rest were all left in place.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of Shise's neighborly amity, only half of the followers were taken captive; the rest were all left in place.

manualTranslations.zh: 奚勢由是衰矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi power declined from this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi power declined from this.

manualTranslations.zh: 初為五部：曰遙裏，曰伯德，曰奧裏，曰梅只，曰楚裏。
manualTranslations.literal: Initially there were five divisions: called Yaoli, Bode, Aoli, Meizhi, and Chuli.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Initially there were five divisions: Yaoli, Bode, Aoli, Meizhi, and Chuli.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖盡降之，號五部奚。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu brought them all to submission, calling them the Five-Division Xi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu brought them all to submission and styled them the Five-Division Xi.

manualTranslations.zh: 天贊二年，有東扒裏廝胡損者，恃險堅壁於箭笴山以拒命，揶諭曰：大軍何能為，我當飲墮瑰門下矣！」
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianzan, there was Dongbali Si Husun, who relied on the terrain, fortified himself at Jian'i Mountain to resist the command, and mocked them, saying: "What can the great army do? I shall drink beneath the Duigui Gate!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianzan, Dongbali Si Husun relied on the terrain, fortified himself at Jian'i Mountain to resist the command, and taunted them, saying: "What can the great army do? I shall drink beneath the Duigui Gate!"

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖滅之，以奚府給役戶，並括諸部隱丁，收合流散，置墮瑰部，因墮瑰門之語為名，遂號六部奚。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu destroyed him, used Xi Residence service households, also gathered hidden men from the various divisions, collected the scattered, established the Duigui Division, and because of the words about the Duigui Gate took that as the name, then called them the Six-Division Xi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu destroyed him, assigned Xi Residence service households, gathered hidden men from the various divisions, collected the scattered, established the Duigui Division, named it for the words about the Duigui Gate, and styled them the Six-Division Xi.

manualTranslations.zh: 命勃魯恩主之，仍號奚王。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He appointed Boluen to head it, still styling him Xi King.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗即位，置宰相、常袞各二員。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizong took the throne, he established two chancellors and two changgun for each.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖宗合奧裏、梅只、墮瑰三部為一；

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shenzong merged the Aoli, Meizhi, and Duigui three divisions into one;

manualTranslations.zh: 奚王和朔奴討兀惹，敗績，籍六部隸北府。

sourceRange.text: 懷州，奉陵軍，上，節度。本唐歸誠州。太宗行帳放牧於此。天贊中，從太祖破扶餘城，下龍泉府，俘其人，築寨居之。會同中，掠燕、薊所俘亦置此。太宗崩，葬西山，曰懷陵。大同元年，世宗置州以奉焉。是年，有騎十餘，獵於祖州西五十里大山中，見太宗乘白馬，獨追白狐，射之，一發而斃；忽不見，但獲狐與矢。是日，太宗崩於欒城。後於其地建廟，又於州之鳳凰門繪太宗馳騎貫狐之像。穆宗被害，葬懷陵側，建鳳凰殿以奉焉。有清涼殿，為行幸避暑之所。皆在州西二十里。隸永興宮。統縣二：扶餘縣。

localRange.text: 扶餘縣。

manualTranslations.zh: 懷州，奉陵軍，上，節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Huai Prefecture, Fengling Army, upper grade, military commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture—Fengling Army, upper grade, with a military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 本唐歸誠州。
manualTranslations.literal: Originally Tang Guicheng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It had been Tang Guicheng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗行帳放牧於此。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong pastured his traveling camp here.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong pastured his mobile camp here.

manualTranslations.zh: 天贊中，從太祖破扶餘城，下龍泉府，俘其人，築寨居之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Tianzan era, following Taizu he took Fuyu City, reduced Longquan Prefecture, captured its people, and built stockades to settle them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Tianzan era, following Taizu he stormed Fuyu City, took Longquan Prefecture, seized its people, and walled stockades for them.

manualTranslations.zh: 會同中，掠燕、薊所俘亦置此。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Huitong era, captives taken from Yan and Ji were also settled here.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Huitong, captives from Yan and Ji were resettled here as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗崩，葬西山，曰懷陵。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizong died he was buried on West Mountain, called Huai Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizong died he was buried on West Mountain at Huai Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年，世宗置州以奉焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong, Shizong established the prefecture to tend it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year 1 Shizong founded the prefecture to maintain the tomb.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，有騎十餘，獵於祖州西五十里大山中，見太宗乘白馬，獨追白狐，射之，一發而斃；
manualTranslations.literal: That year more than ten horsemen hunting in the great mountains fifty li west of Zu Prefecture saw Taizong riding a white horse, alone pursuing a white fox; they shot it and felled it with one arrow;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, while hunting in the great mountains fifty li west of Zu Prefecture, more than ten horsemen saw Taizong on a white horse pursuing a white fox alone; they shot it down with one arrow;

manualTranslations.zh: 忽不見，但獲狐與矢。
manualTranslations.literal: suddenly he vanished, and they obtained only the fox and the arrow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: then he vanished, leaving only the fox and the arrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日，太宗崩於欒城。
manualTranslations.literal: That day Taizong died at Luancheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That same day Taizong died at Luancheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 後於其地建廟，又於州之鳳凰門繪太宗馳騎貫狐之像。
manualTranslations.literal: Later a temple was built on that ground, and at the prefecture Phoenix Gate a painting was made of Taizong galloping and transfixing the fox.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later a temple rose on that site, and at the prefecture Phoenix Gate they painted Taizong galloping and piercing the fox.

manualTranslations.zh: 穆宗被害，葬懷陵側，建鳳凰殿以奉焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When Muzong was murdered he was buried beside Huai Mausoleum, and Phoenix Hall was built to tend him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Muzong was murdered he was buried beside Huai Mausoleum, and Phoenix Hall was built to serve him.

manualTranslations.zh: 有清涼殿，為行幸避暑之所。
manualTranslations.literal: There was Cool Breeze Hall, a traveling residence for escaping summer heat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cool Breeze Hall served as a traveling retreat from summer heat.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆在州西二十里。
manualTranslations.literal: All were twenty li west of the prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All lay twenty li west of the prefectural seat.

manualTranslations.zh: 隸永興宮。
manualTranslations.literal: Subordinate to Yongxing Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It belonged to Yongxing Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 統縣二：扶餘縣。
manualTranslations.literal: It ruled two counties: Fuyu County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It governed two counties—Fuyu County.

sourceRange.text: 龍化州，興國軍，下，節度。本漢北安平縣地。契丹始祖奇首可汗居此，稱龍庭。太祖於此建東樓。唐天復二年，太祖為叠烈部夷離堇，破代北，遷其民，建城居之。明年，伐女直，俘數百戶實焉。天祐元年，增修東城，制度頗壯麗。十三年，太祖於城東金鈴岡受尊號曰大聖大明天皇帝，建元神冊。天顯元年，崩於東樓。太宗升節度。隸彰湣宮，兵事屬北路女直兵馬司。刺史州一，未詳。統縣一：龍化縣。太祖東伐女直，南掠燕、薊，所俘建城置邑。戶一千。

manualTranslations.zh: 龍化州，興國軍，下，節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Longhua Prefecture, Xingguo Army, lower grade, military commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Longhua Prefecture—Xingguo Army, lower grade, with a military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 本漢北安平縣地。
manualTranslations.literal: Originally the land of Han Beianping County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Its soil had been Han Beianping County.

manualTranslations.zh: 契丹始祖奇首可汗居此，稱龍庭。
manualTranslations.literal: The Khitan Ancestor Qishou Khan dwelt here, called Dragon Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Khitan Ancestor Qishou Khan lived here, called the Dragon Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖於此建東樓。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu built the East Tower here.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu built the East Tower here.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐天復二年，太祖為叠烈部夷離堇，破代北，遷其民，建城居之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tang Tianfu, Taizu was yilijin of the Dieci Division; he broke northern Dai, moved its people, and built a city for them to dwell in.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tang Tianfu year 2, as yilijin of the Dieci Division Taizu broke northern Dai, resettled its people, and walled a city for them.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，伐女直，俘數百戶實焉。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he attacked the Jurchen and captured several hundred households to fill it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he campaigned against the Jurchen and settled several hundred captured households there.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐元年，增修東城，制度頗壯麗。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianyou the eastern city was enlarged and repaired; its layout was quite grand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianyou year 1 the eastern quarter was enlarged and repaired to a rather magnificent plan.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，太祖於城東金鈴岡受尊號曰大聖大明天皇帝，建元神冊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year, east of the city at Jinling Hill Taizu received the exalted title Great Sage, Great Bright Heaven Emperor and established the Shence era name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 13, at Jinling Hill east of the city, Taizu received the exalted title Great Sage, Great Bright Heaven Emperor and proclaimed the Shence reign title.

manualTranslations.zh: 天顯元年，崩於東樓。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianxian he died at the East Tower.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianxian year 1 he died at the East Tower.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗升節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong was promoted to military commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong was raised to military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 隸彰湣宮，兵事屬北路女直兵馬司。
manualTranslations.literal: Subordinate to Zhangmin Palace; military affairs belonged to the Northern Route Jurchen Horse and Army Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It belonged to Zhangmin Palace; military affairs came under the Northern Route Jurchen Horse and Army Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 刺史州一，未詳。
manualTranslations.literal: One cishi prefecture, not specified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One prefecture of cishi rank, unspecified.

manualTranslations.zh: 統縣一：龍化縣。
manualTranslations.literal: It ruled one county: Longhua County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It governed one county—Longhua County.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖東伐女直，南掠燕、薊，所俘建城置邑。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu campaigned east against the Jurchen and raided south into Yan and Ji; captives were used to build cities and establish settlements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu campaigned east against the Jurchen and raided Yan and Ji to the south, using captives to found walled towns and settlements.

manualTranslations.zh: 戶一千。
manualTranslations.literal: Households 1,000.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 1,000 households.

sourceRange.text: 五十里至金沟馆。将至馆，川原平旷，谓之金沟淀。自此入山，诘曲登陟，无复里堠，但以马行记日，约其里数。九十里至古北口，两傍峻崖，仅容车轨。又度德胜岭，盘道数层，俗名思乡岭，八十里至新馆。过雕窠岭、偏枪岭，四十里至如来馆。过乌泺河，东有滦州，又过摸斗岭，一名渡云岭，芹菜岭，七十里至柳河馆。松亭岭甚险峻，七十里至打造部落馆。

localRange.text: 五十里至金溝館。將至館，川原平曠，謂之金溝澱。自此入山，詰曲登陟，無復裏堠，但以馬行記日，約其里數。九十里至古北口，兩傍峻崖，僅容車軌。又度德勝嶺，盤道數層，俗名思鄉嶺，八十里至新館。過雕窠嶺、偏槍嶺，四十里至臥如來館。過烏灤河，東有灤州，又過摸鬥嶺，一名渡雲嶺，芹菜嶺，七十里至柳河館。松亭嶺甚險峻，七十里至打造部落館。

sourceRange.text: 圣宗尝过七金山土河之滨，南望云气，有郛郭楼阙之状，因议建都。择良工于燕、蓟，董役二岁，郛郭、宫掖、楼阁、府库、市肆廊庑，拟神都之制。统和二十四年，五帐院进故奚王牙帐地。二十五年，城之，实以汉户，号曰中京，府曰大定。

localRange.text: 聖宗嘗過七金山土河之濱，南望雲氣，有郛郭樓闕之狀，因議建都。擇良工於燕、薊，董役二歲，郛郭、宮掖、樓閣、府庫、市肆廊廡，擬神都之制。統和二十四年，五帳院進故奚王牙帳地。二十五年，城之，實以漢戶，號曰中京，府曰大定。

sourceRange.text: 统和中置。建州，保静军，上，节度。唐武德中，置昌乐县。太祖完葺故垒，置州。汉乾祐元年，故石晋太后诣世宗，求于汉城侧耕垦自赡。许于建州南四十里给地五十顷，营构房室，创立宗庙。州在灵河之南，屡遭水害，圣宗迁于河北康崇州故城。初名武宁军，隶永兴宫，后属敦睦宫。统县二：永霸县。

sourceRange.text: 易州，高陽軍，上，刺史。漢為易、故安二縣地。隋置易州，隋末為上谷郡。唐武德四年復易州。天寶元年仍上谷郡。乾元元年又改易州。五代隸定州節度使。會同九年，孫方簡以其地來附。應歷九年，為周世宗所取，後屬宋。統和七年，攻克之，升高陽軍。有易水、淶水、狼山、太寧山、白馬山。統縣三：易縣。

sourceRange.text: 城方三十六里，崇三丈，衡廣一丈五尺。敵樓、戰櫓具。八門：東曰安東、迎春，南曰開陽、丹鳳、西曰顯西、清晉、北曰通天、拱辰。大內在西南隅。皇城內有景宗、聖宗御容殿二，東曰宣和，南曰大內。內門曰宣教，改元和；外三門曰南端、左掖、右掖。左掖改萬春，右掖改千秋。門有樓閣，球場在其南，東為永平館。皇城西門曰顯西，設而不開；北曰子北。西城巔有涼殿，東北隅有燕角樓。坊市、廨舍、寺觀，蓋不勝書。其外，有居庸、松亭、榆林之關。古北之口，桑乾河、高梁河、石子河、大安山、燕山，中有瑤嶼。府曰幽都，軍號盧龍，開泰元年落軍額。統州六、縣十一：析津縣。本晉薊縣，改薊北縣，開泰元年更今名。以燕分野旅寅為析木之津，故名。戶二萬。宛平縣。本晉幽都縣，開泰元年改今名。戶二萬二千。

sourceRange.text: 營州，鄰海軍，下，刺史。本商孤竹國。秦屬遼西郡。漢為昌黎郡。前燕慕容皝徙都於此。元魏立營州，領昌黎、建德、遼東、樂浪、冀陽、營丘六郡。後周為高寶寧所據。隋開皇置州，大業改遼西郡。唐武德元年改營州，萬歲通天元年始入契丹。聖歷二年僑治漁陽。開元五年還治柳城。天寶元年改曰柳城郡。後唐復為營州。太祖以居定州俘戶。統縣一：廣寧縣。漢柳城縣，屬遼西郡。東北與奚、契丹接境。萬歲通天元年，入契丹李萬榮。神龍元年移幽州界。開元四年復舊地。遼改今名。戶三千。

sourceRange.text: 檀州，武威軍，下，刺史。本燕漁陽郡地，漢為白檀縣。《魏書》：曹公歷白檀，破烏丸於柳城。《續漢書》：白檀在右北平。元魏創密雲郡，兼置安州。後周改為元州。隋開皇十八年割燕樂、密雲二縣置檀州。唐天寶元年改密雲郡，乾元元年復為檀州。遼加今軍號。有桑溪、鮑丘山、桃花山、螺山。統縣二：密雲縣。

sourceRange.text: 涿州，永泰軍，上，刺史。漢高祖六年分燕置涿郡，魏文帝改范陽郡，晉為范陽國，元魏復為郡。隋開皇二年罷郡，屬幽州，大業三年以幽州為涿郡，唐武德元年郡廢，為涿縣，七年改范陽縣，大歷四年置涿州。石晉以歸太宗。有大房山、六聘山、涿水、樓桑河、橫溝河、禮遜河、祁溝河。統縣四：范陽縣。

sourceRange.text: 豐州，天德軍，節度使。秦為上郡北境，漢屬五原郡。地磧鹵，少田疇。自晉永嘉之亂，屬赫連勃勃。後周置永豐鎮。隋開皇中升永豐縣，改豐州。大業七年為五原郡，義寧元年，太守張遜奏改歸順郡。唐武德元年為豐州總管府。六年省，遷民於白馬縣，遂廢。貞觀四年分靈州境，置相州都督府，領蕃戶。天寶初改九原郡。乾元元年復豐州，後入回鶻。會昌中克之，後唐改天德軍。太祖神冊五年攻下，更名應天軍，復為州。有大鹽濼、九十九泉、沒越濼、古磧口、青冢，即王昭君墓，兵事屬西南面招討司。統縣二：富民縣。本漢臨戎縣，遼改今名。戶一千二百。

manualTranslations.literal: Sui Kaihuang era raised it to Yongfeng County and changed it to Feng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Sui Kaihuang it was promoted to Yongfeng County and renamed Feng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 大業七年為五原郡，義寧元年，太守張遜奏改歸順郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Daye year 7 it became Wuyuan Commandery; in the first year of Yining, Administrator Zhang Xun memorialized to change it to Guishun Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daye year 7 made it Wuyuan Commandery; Yining year 1 Prefect Zhang Xun petitioned to rename it Guishun Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐武德元年為豐州總管府。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang Wude year 1 it became Feng Prefecture grand commandant headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tang Wude year 1 it became the Feng Prefecture grand commandant headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年省，遷民於白馬縣，遂廢。
manualTranslations.literal: Year 6 it was abolished; populations were moved to Baima County, and it was then abandoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 6 the prefecture was removed, the populace relocated to Baima County, and it was abandoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞觀四年分靈州境，置相州都督府，領蕃戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhenguan year 4 split off Ling Prefecture territory, established Xiang Prefecture grand commandant headquarters, governing frontier households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhenguan year 4 carved territory from Ling Prefecture, set up Xiang Prefecture grand commandant headquarters, and administered frontier households.

manualTranslations.zh: 天寶初改九原郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Early Tianbao changed it to Jiuyuan Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early Tianbao it became Jiuyuan Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾元元年復豐州，後入回鶻。
manualTranslations.literal: Qianyuan year 1 restored Feng Prefecture; later it fell to the Uighurs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qianyuan year 1 Feng Prefecture was restored; later it passed to the Uighurs.

manualTranslations.zh: 會昌中克之，後唐改天德軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Huichang era recaptured it; Later Tang changed it to Tiande Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Huichang period retook it; Later Tang renamed it Tiande Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖神冊五年攻下，更名應天軍，復為州。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 5 of Emperor Taizu's Shence reign it was stormed, renamed Yingtian Army, then restored as a prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu year 5 of Shence seized it, renamed it Yingtian Army, and restored it as a prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 有大鹽濼、九十九泉、沒越濼、古磧口、青冢，即王昭君墓，兵事屬西南面招討司。
manualTranslations.literal: There are Great Salt Marsh, Ninety-Nine Springs, Moyue Marsh, ancient Qikou Pass, and Qingzhong—the tomb of Wang Zhaojun; military affairs belonged to the Southwest Pacification Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It has Great Salt Marsh, Ninety-Nine Springs, Moyue Marsh, ancient Qikou Pass, and Qingzhong, Wang Zhaojun's tomb; military affairs came under the Southwest Pacification Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 統縣二：富民縣。
manualTranslations.literal: It governed two counties: Fumin County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prefecture administered two counties: Fumin County.

manualTranslations.zh: 本漢臨戎縣，遼改今名。
manualTranslations.literal: Originally Han Linrong County; Liao changed to the present name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was Han Linrong County; Liao gave it the present name.

manualTranslations.zh: 戶一千二百。
manualTranslations.literal: One thousand two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 1,200 registered households.

sourceRange.text: 東勝州，武興軍，下，刺史。隋開皇七年置勝州。大業五年改榆林郡。唐貞觀五年於南河地置決勝州，故謂此為東勝州。天寶七年又為榆林郡。乾元元年復為勝州。太祖神冊元年破振武軍，勝州之民皆趨河東，州廢。晉割代北來獻，復置。兵事屬西南面招討司。統縣二：榆林縣。

localRange.text: 榆林縣。

manualTranslations.zh: 東勝州，武興軍，下，刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Eastern Sheng Prefecture, Wuxing Army, lower grade, cishi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Eastern Sheng Prefecture—Wuxing Army, lower grade, with a prefect.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇七年置勝州。
manualTranslations.literal: Sui Kaihuang year 7 established Sheng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sui Kaihuang year 7 founded Sheng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 大業五年改榆林郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Daye year 5 changed it to Yulin Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daye year 5 it became Yulin Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐貞觀五年於南河地置決勝州，故謂此為東勝州。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang Zhenguan year 5 established Juesheng Prefecture on the south-bank lands, hence this was called Eastern Sheng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tang Zhenguan year 5 set up Juesheng Prefecture on the south-bank lands, so this was called Eastern Sheng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 天寶七年又為榆林郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianbao year 7 it again became Yulin Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianbao year 7 it again became Yulin Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾元元年復為勝州。
manualTranslations.literal: Qianyuan year 1 restored it as Sheng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qianyuan year 1 it was restored as Sheng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖神冊元年破振武軍，勝州之民皆趨河東，州廢。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taizu Shence year 1 broke Zhenwu Army; the people of Sheng Prefecture all fled east of the river, and the prefecture was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu Shence year 1 stormed Zhenwu Army; Sheng Prefecture's people all fled to the east bank and the prefecture was abandoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉割代北來獻，復置。
manualTranslations.literal: Jin ceded the Dai north as tribute and it was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin surrendered the Dai north it was re-established.

manualTranslations.zh: 兵事屬西南面招討司。
manualTranslations.literal: Military affairs belonged to the Southwest Pacification Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Its military affairs came under the Southwest Pacification Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 統縣二：榆林縣。
manualTranslations.literal: It governed two counties: Yulin County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prefecture administered two counties: Yulin County.

sourceRange.text: 蔚州，忠順軍，上，節度。《周職方》，并州川曰漚夷，在州境飛狐縣。趙襄子滅代，武靈王置代郡；項羽徙趙歇為代王，歇還趙，立陳余王代；漢韓信斬余，復置代郡；文帝初封代；皆此地。周宣帝始置蔚州，隋開皇中廢。唐武德四年復置。至德二年改興唐縣。乾元元年仍舊。大中從，朱邪執宜為刺史，有功，賜姓名李國昌。子克用乞為留後，僖宗不許。廣明初，攻敗國昌，代北無備，太祖來攻，克之，俘掠居民而去。石晉獻地，升忠順軍，後更武安軍。統和四年入宋，尋復之，降刺史，隸奉聖州，升觀察，復忠順軍節度。兵事屬西京都部署司。統縣五：靈仙縣。唐置興唐縣，梁改隆化縣，後唐同光初復置，晉改今名。戶二萬。

manualTranslations.zh: 蔚州，忠順軍，上，節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Prefecture, Zhongshun Army, upper grade, military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Prefecture—Zhongshun Army, upper grade, with a military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 《周職方》，并州川曰漚夷，在州境飛狐縣。
manualTranslations.literal: The Zhou "Offices of the Realm" records that Bing Province's river was called Ouyi, in Feihu County within the prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Zhou Offices of the Realm names Bing Province's river Ouyi, located in Feihu County within this prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 趙襄子滅代，武靈王置代郡；
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao Xiangzi destroyed Dai; King Wuling of Zhao established Dai Commandery;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiangzi destroyed Dai; King Wuling of Zhao founded Dai Commandery;

manualTranslations.zh: 項羽徙趙歇為代王，歇還趙，立陳余王代；
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang Yu moved Zhao Xie to be king of Dai; Xie returned to Zhao and Chen Yu was made king of Dai;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang Yu installed Zhao Xie as king of Dai; Xie returned to Zhao and Chen Yu was enthroned as king of Dai;

manualTranslations.zh: 漢韓信斬余，復置代郡；
manualTranslations.literal: Han's Han Xin slew Yu and restored Dai Commandery;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han Xin of Han killed Yu and re-established Dai Commandery;

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝初封代；
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wen at first enfeoffed Dai here;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen first enfeoffed Dai here;

manualTranslations.zh: 皆此地。
manualTranslations.literal: all these events concern this place.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: all these events took place here.

manualTranslations.zh: 周宣帝始置蔚州，隋開皇中廢。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xuan of Zhou first established Yu Prefecture; Sui Kaihuang abolished it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan of Zhou first founded Yu Prefecture; Sui Kaihuang abolished it.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐武德四年復置。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang Wude year 4 restored it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tang Wude year 4 re-established it.

manualTranslations.zh: 至德二年改興唐縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhide year 2 changed it to Xingtang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhide year 2 it was renamed Xingtang County.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾元元年仍舊。
manualTranslations.literal: Qianyuan year 1 restored the former name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qianyuan year 1 it reverted to the former arrangement.

manualTranslations.zh: 大中中，朱邪執宜為刺史，有功，賜姓名李國昌。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Dazhong era Zhuye Zhiyi served as prefect, merited reward, and was granted the surname and personal name Li Guochang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era Zhuye Zhiyi was prefect; for his service he was granted the surname and name Li Guochang.

manualTranslations.zh: 子克用乞為留後，僖宗不許。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Keyong petitioned to remain as acting commissioner; Emperor Xizong refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Keyong asked to stay on as acting commissioner; Emperor Xizong refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣明初，攻敗國昌，代北無備，太祖來攻，克之，俘掠居民而去。
manualTranslations.literal: Early Guangming attackers defeated Guochang; the Dai north was undefended; Taizu came, seized it, and carried off the inhabitants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early Guangming forces defeated Guochang; with the Dai north undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.

manualTranslations.zh: 石晉獻地，升忠順軍，後更武安軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Jin ceded the territory; it was raised to Zhongshun Army, later changed to Wu'an Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Jin surrendered the territory; it was promoted to Zhongshun Army and later renamed Wu'an Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和四年入宋，尋復之，降刺史，隸奉聖州，升觀察，復忠順軍節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Tonghe year 4 it fell to Song, was soon recovered, reduced to a prefect, subordinated to Fengsheng Prefecture, raised to surveillance commissioner, and restored as Zhongshun Army command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tonghe year 4 it briefly fell to Song but was soon recovered; it was reduced to a prefect, placed under Fengsheng Prefecture, raised to surveillance commissioner, and restored as Zhongshun Army command.

manualTranslations.zh: 兵事屬西京都部署司。
manualTranslations.literal: Military affairs belonged to the Western Capital metropolitan deployment office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Its military affairs came under the Western Capital metropolitan deployment office.

manualTranslations.zh: 統縣五：靈仙縣。
manualTranslations.literal: It governed five counties: Lingxian County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prefecture administered five counties: Lingxian County.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐置興唐縣，梁改隆化縣，後唐同光初復置，晉改今名。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang established Xingtang County; Liang changed it to Longhua County; early Later Tang Tongguang restored it; Jin changed to the present name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tang founded Xingtang County; Liang renamed it Longhua County; early Later Tang Tongguang restored it; Jin gave it the present name.

manualTranslations.zh: 戶二萬。
manualTranslations.literal: Twenty thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand registered households.

sourceRange.text: ○歷大同元年，太宗皇帝自晉汴京收百司僚屬伎術歷象，遷於中京，遼始有歷。先是，梁、唐仍用景福《崇玄曆》。晉天福四年，司天監馬重績奏上《乙未元曆》，號《調元曆》，太宗所收天汴是也。穆宗應歷十一年，司天王白、李正等進歷，蓋《乙未元曆》也。聖宗統和十二年，可汗州刺史賈俊進新歷，則《大明曆》是也。高麗所誌《大遼古今錄》稱統和十二年始頒正朔改歷，驗矣。《大明曆》本宋祖沖之法，具見沈約《宋書》。具如左。

context.afterSource: 宋武帝大明六年，祖沖之上《甲子元曆》法，未及施用，因名《大明曆》。

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年，太宗皇帝自晉汴京收百司僚屬伎術歷象，遷於中京，遼始有歷。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong year 1, Emperor Taizong collected the officials, retainers, craftsmen, and calendrical specialists from the Jin capital Bianjing and relocated them to the Central Capital; the Liao then first had a calendar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year 1 (947), Emperor Taizong gathered officials, retainers, artisans, and calendrical specialists from the Jin capital Bianjing and moved them to the Central Capital, and the Liao first acquired a state calendar.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，梁、唐仍用景福《崇玄曆》。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, Liang and Tang still used the Jingfu Chongxuan Calendar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liang and Tang had continued using the Jingfu Chongxuan Calendar.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉天福四年，司天監馬重績奏上《乙未元曆》，號《調元曆》，太宗所收天汴是也。
manualTranslations.literal: In Jin Tianfu year 4, Director of Astronomy Ma Chongji submitted the Yiwei Origin Calendar, called the Tiaoyuan Calendar; this was what Taizong collected at Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Later Jin Tianfu year 4 (939), Director of Astronomy Ma Chongji presented the Yiwei Origin Calendar, titled the Tiaoyuan Calendar—the calendar Taizong had taken from Bianjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 穆宗應歷十一年，司天王白、李正等進歷，蓋《乙未元曆》也。
manualTranslations.literal: In Muzong Yingli year 11, Director of Astronomy Wang Bai, Li Zheng and others presented a calendar, essentially the Yiwei Origin Calendar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Muzong's Yingli year 11 (961), Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others of the Directorate of Astronomy submitted a calendar that was essentially the Yiwei Origin Calendar.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖宗統和十二年，可汗州刺史賈俊進新歷，則《大明曆》是也。
manualTranslations.literal: In Shengzong Tonghe year 12, Prefect Jia Jun of Kehanzhou presented a new calendar; this was the Great Brightness Calendar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shengzong's Tonghe year 12 (994), Jia Jun, prefect of Kehanzhou, presented a new calendar—the Great Brightness Calendar.

manualTranslations.zh: 高麗所誌《大遼古今錄》稱統和十二年始頒正朔改歷，驗矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The Korean record Great Liao Ancient and Modern Accounts states that in Tonghe year 12 the correct new moon and calendar reform were first issued; verified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Korean work Great Liao Ancient and Modern Accounts records that the new moon and calendar reform were first promulgated in Tonghe year 12—confirmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 《大明曆》本宋祖沖之法，具見沈約《宋書》。
manualTranslations.literal: The Great Brightness Calendar ultimately derives from Zu Chongzhi's methods of Song; fully seen in Shen Yue's Book of Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Great Brightness Calendar ultimately derives from Zu Chongzhi's Song methods, as fully recorded in Shen Yue's Book of Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 具如左。
manualTranslations.literal: The details are as on the left.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The particulars follow below.

sourceRange.text: 歷代儀象表漏，各具於誌。太宗大同元年，得晉歷象、刻漏、渾象。後唐清泰二年已稱損折不可施用，其至中京者概可知矣。古之煉銅，黑黃白青之氣盡，然後用之，故可施久遠。唐沙門一行鑄渾天儀，時稱精妙，未幾銅鐵漸澀，不能自轉，置不復用。金質不精，水性不行，況移之沍寒之地乎！○刻漏晉天福三年造。
