manualTranslations.zh: 歷代儀象表漏，各具於誌。
manualTranslations.literal: Calendrical instruments, armillary spheres, gnomons, and clepsydrae of successive dynasties are each set out in their respective treatises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The calendrical instruments, armillary spheres, gnomons, and clepsydrae of successive dynasties are each recorded in their own treatises.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗大同元年，得晉歷象、刻漏、渾象。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taizong's first year of Datong, Jin calendrical instruments, a clepsydra, and an armillary sphere were obtained.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong under Emperor Taizong, the Liao obtained the Jin dynasty's calendrical instruments, water clock, and armillary sphere.

manualTranslations.zh: 後唐清泰二年已稱損折不可施用，其至中京者概可知矣。
manualTranslations.literal: By the second year of Qingtai of Later Tang they were already said to be damaged and broken beyond use; what reached the Central Capital may be generally known.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the second Qingtai year of the Later Tang they were already reported damaged and unusable; what had reached the Central Capital can be inferred well enough.

manualTranslations.zh: 古之煉銅，黑黃白青之氣盡，然後用之，故可施久遠。
manualTranslations.literal: In ancient smelting of bronze, when the black, yellow, white, and green vapors were all spent, then it was used; therefore it could serve for long ages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In antiquity bronze was not put to use until smelting had driven off the black, yellow, white, and green vapors, and so it could last for generations.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐沙門一行鑄渾天儀，時稱精妙，未幾銅鐵漸澀，不能自轉，置不復用。
manualTranslations.literal: The Tang monk Yixing cast a celestial globe; at the time it was praised as ingenious, but before long bronze and iron gradually grew stiff and could not turn by themselves, and it was set aside and not used again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Tang monk Yixing cast a celestial globe that was hailed at the time for its finesse, but soon its bronze and iron parts stiffened and would no longer turn; it was abandoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 金質不精，水性不行，況移之沍寒之地乎！
manualTranslations.literal: If the quality of metal is poor and water's motion will not run, how much more if it is moved to a land of frozen cold!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the metal is impure and water cannot flow freely, how much less can such devices work if moved to a land of bitter frost!

sourceRange.text: 遥辇九帐大常衮司。掌遥辇洼可汗、阻午可汗、胡剌可汗、苏可汗、鲜质可汗、昭古可汗、耶澜可汗、巴剌可汗、痕德堇可汗九世宫分之事。太祖受位于遥辇，以九帐居皇族一帐之上，设常衮司以奉之，有司不与焉。凡辽十二宫、五京，皆太祖以来征讨所得，非受之于遥辇也。

localRange.text: 遙輦九帳大常袞司。掌遙輦窪可汗、阻午可汗、胡剌可汗、蘇可汗、鮮質可汗、昭古可汗、耶瀾可汗、巴剌可汗、痕德堇可汗九世宮分之事。太祖受位於遙輦，以九帳居皇族一帳之上，設常袞司以奉之，有司不與焉。凡遼十二宮、五京，皆太祖以來征討所得，非受之於遙輦也。

sourceRange.text: 有侦候，有候人，有拽剌。东征行枢密院东征都统所。亦曰东面行军都统所，又曰东路行军都统所。东征统军司东征先锋使司西征统军司南征都统所。亦曰南面行军都统所。南征统军司南面行营总管府南面行营都部署司河南道行军都统所北道行军都统所东北面行军都统所西北面行军都统所西南面行军都统所辽制，属国、属部官，大者拟王封，小者准部使。命其酋长与契丹人区别而用恩威兼制，得柔远之道。

manualTranslations.literal: Originally the Ministry of War office: under Zhou it was Grand Marshal; under Han it was Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This office descends from the Ministry of War: under Zhou it was Grand Marshal, under Han Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐季宦官用事，內置樞密院，後改用士人。
manualTranslations.literal: In late Tang eunuchs held power; a Privy Council was established within the palace, and later scholar-officials were appointed instead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late Tang eunuchs dominated court affairs, so an inner Privy Council was created and later staffed with scholar-officials.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉天福中廢，開運元年復置。
manualTranslations.literal: It was abolished during Jin Tianfu and restored in the first year of Kaiyun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jin abolished it in Tianfu and restored it in Kaiyun year 1.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖初有漢兒司，韓知古總知漢兒司事。
manualTranslations.literal: At the start of Taizu there was the Han Affairs Office, with Han Zhigu in overall charge of Han Affairs Office affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Taizu’s reign there was a Han Affairs Office; Han Zhigu directed its affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗入汴，因晉置樞密院，掌漢人兵馬之政，初兼尚書省。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizong entered Bian he followed Jin in establishing the Privy Council to govern Han military and horse affairs, at first also holding the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Taizong entered Bian he followed Jin’s model and established the Privy Council to govern Han military affairs, initially combining it with the Department of State Affairs.

sourceRange.text: 聖宗統和元年，冊承天皇太后，設宮懸、簨虡，太樂工、協律郎入。太后儀衛動，舉麾，《太和》樂作；太樂令、太常卿導引升御坐，簾卷，樂止。文武三品以上入，《舒和》樂作；至位，樂止。皇帝入門，《雍和》樂作；至殿前位，樂止。宰相押冊，皇帝隨冊，樂作；至殿前置冊於案，樂止。翰林學士、大將軍舁冊，樂作；置御坐前，樂止。丞相上殿，樂作；至讀冊位，樂止。皇帝下殿，樂作；至位，樂止。太后宣答訖，樂作；皇帝至西閣，樂止。親王、丞相上殿，樂作；退班出，樂止。下簾，樂作；皇太后入內，樂止。

context.beforeSource: 興宗重熙九年，上契丹冊，皇帝出，奏《隆安》之樂。
context.afterSource: 冊皇太子儀：太子初入門，《貞安》之樂作。

manualTranslations.zh: 聖宗統和元年，冊承天皇太后，設宮懸、簨虡，太樂工、協律郎入。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tonghe, Emperor Shengzong, at the investiture of Empress Dowager Chengtian, suspended bells and music frames were set up; musicians of the Grand Music Office and pitch-tuning officers entered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tonghe, at the investiture of Empress Dowager Chengtian, full suspended bells and music frames were installed; musicians of the Grand Music Office and pitch-tuning officers took their places.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后儀衛動，舉麾，《太和》樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress dowager's guards moved, the baton was raised and the music Taihe sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager's guards moved, the baton was raised and the music Taihe began;

manualTranslations.zh: 太樂令、太常卿導引升御坐，簾卷，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: the Director of Music and the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led her up to the imperial seat, the curtains were raised, and the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the Director of Music and the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led her up to the throne, the curtains were raised, and the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 文武三品以上入，《舒和》樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: Civil and military officials of the third rank and above entered; the music Shuhe sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of the third rank and above entered; the music Shuhe sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 至位，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when they reached their places, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when they reached their places, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝入門，《雍和》樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor entered the gate; the music Yonghe sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the gate; the music Yonghe sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 至殿前位，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when he reached his place before the hall, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when he reached his place before the hall, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 宰相押冊，皇帝隨冊，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: The chief minister escorted the register, the emperor followed the register, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The chief minister escorted the document of investiture, the emperor followed the register, and music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 至殿前置冊於案，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when the register was placed on the table before the hall, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the document was set on the table before the hall, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 翰林學士、大將軍舁冊，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: Hanlin academicians and the grand general bore the register, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hanlin academicians and the grand general bore the register, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 置御坐前，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when it was set before the imperial seat, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when it was set before the throne, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 丞相上殿，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: The chief counselor ascended the hall, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The chief counselor ascended the hall, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 至讀冊位，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when he reached the place for reading the register, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when he reached the place for reading the register, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝下殿，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor descended from the hall, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor descended from the hall, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 至位，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when he reached his place, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when he reached his place, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后宣答訖，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress dowager had finished her proclamation and response, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager had finished her proclamation and response, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝至西閣，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when the emperor reached the west side chamber, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the emperor reached the west side chamber, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 親王、丞相上殿，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: Princes and the chief counselor ascended the hall, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Princes and the chief counselor ascended the hall, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 退班出，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when they withdrew from the ranks and departed, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when they withdrew from the ranks and departed, the music ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 下簾，樂作；
manualTranslations.literal: The curtains were lowered, music sounded;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The curtains were lowered, music sounded;

manualTranslations.zh: 皇太后入內，樂止。
manualTranslations.literal: when the empress dowager entered the inner quarters, the music ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the empress dowager entered the inner quarters, the music ceased.

sourceRange.text: 漢服黃帝始制冕冠章服，後王以祀以祭以享。夏收、殷冔、周弁以朝，冠端以居，所以別尊卑、辨儀物也。厥後唐以冕冠、青衣為祭服，通天、絳袍為朝服，平巾幘、袍襕為常服。大同元年正月朔，太宗皇帝入晉，備法駕，受文武百官賀於汴京崇元殿，自是日以為常。是年北歸，唐晉文物，遼則用之。左右采訂，摭其常用者存諸篇。

manualTranslations.zh: 漢服黃帝始制冕冠章服，後王以祀以祭以享。
manualTranslations.literal: Han dress: The Yellow Emperor first made the regalia crown and patterned garments; later kings used them for sacrifice, worship, and feasting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For Han ritual dress, the Yellow Emperor first instituted the full regalia crown and patterned garments; later kings used them in sacrifice, worship, and feasting.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏收、殷冔、周弁以朝，冠端以居，所以別尊卑、辨儀物也。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xia the shou cap, in Yin the fu cap, and in Zhou the bian cap for court; guan caps for residence—thus to distinguish rank and distinguish ritual objects.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xia they wore the shou cap, in Yin the fu cap, and in Zhou the bian cap at court; at home they wore guan caps—thus to distinguish rank and delineate ceremonial objects.

manualTranslations.zh: 厥後唐以冕冠、青衣為祭服，通天、絳袍為朝服，平巾幘、袍襕為常服。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereafter in Tang the regalia crown and blue-green robes served as sacrificial dress; tongtian hats and crimson robes as court dress; plain headcloths and robe-trousers as everyday dress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereafter Tang took the regalia crown and blue-green robes as sacrificial dress, tongtian hats and crimson robes as court dress, and plain headcloths with robe-trousers as everyday dress.

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年正月朔，太宗皇帝入晉，備法駕，受文武百官賀於汴京崇元殿，自是日以為常。
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day of the first month of Datong 1, Emperor Taizong entered Jin, prepared the full imperial equipage, and received the congratulations of civil and military officials at Chongyuan Hall in Bianjing; from that day this became the regular practice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of Datong 1 (947), Emperor Taizong entered Jin, assembled the full imperial procession, and received the congratulations of civil and military officials at Chongyuan Hall in Bianjing; thereafter this became the established custom.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年北歸，唐晉文物，遼則用之。
manualTranslations.literal: That year he returned north; the cultural institutions of Tang and Jin, Liao then adopted and used them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year he returned north, and Liao adopted the cultural institutions of Tang and Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 左右采訂，摭其常用者存諸篇。
manualTranslations.literal: On both sides they collected and edited, selecting what was in regular use and preserving it in these sections.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The compilers on both sides collected and edited, selecting what was in regular use and preserving it in these sections.

sourceRange.text: 興宗仁懿皇后蕭氏，小字撻裏，欽哀皇后弟孝穆之長女。性寬容，姿貌端麗。帝即位，入宮，生道宗。重熙四年，立爲皇后。二十三年，號貞懿慈和文惠孝敬廣愛崇聖皇后。道宗即位，尊爲皇太后。清寧二年，上尊號曰慈懿仁和文惠孝敬廣愛宗天皇太后。九年秋，敦睦宮使耶律良以重元與其子涅魯古反狀密告太后，乃言於帝。帝疑之，太后曰：「此社稷大事，宜早爲計。」帝始戒嚴。及戰，太后親督衞士，破逆黨。大康二年崩，謚仁懿皇后。仁慈淑謹，中外感德。凡正旦、生辰諸國貢幣，悉賜貧瘠。嘗夢重元曰：「臣骨在太子山北，不勝寒栗。」寤，即命屋之，慈憫類此。

sourceRange.text: 景宗睿智皇后蕭氏，諱綽，小字燕燕，北府宰相思温女。早慧。思温嘗觀諸女掃地，惟后潔除，喜曰：「此女必能成家。」帝即位，選爲貴妃。尋冊爲皇后，生聖宗。景宗崩，尊爲皇太后，攝國政。后泣曰：「母寡子弱，族屬雄強，邊防未靖，奈何？」耶律斜軫、韓德讓進曰：「信任臣等，何慮之有！」於是后與斜軫、德讓參決大政，委於越休哥以南邊事。統和元年，上尊號曰承天皇太后。二十四年，加上尊號曰睿德神略應運啓化承天皇太后。二十七年崩，謚曰聖神宣獻皇后。重熙二十一年，更今謚。后明達治道，聞善必從，故群臣咸竭其忠。習知軍政，澶淵之役，親禦戎軍，指麾三軍，賞罰信明，將士用命。聖宗稱遼盛主，后教訓爲多。

sourceRange.text: 喜隱，字完德，雄偉善騎射，封趙王。應歷中，謀反，事覺，上臨問有狀，以親釋之。未幾，復反，下獄。景宗即位，聞有赦，自去其械而朝。上怒曰：「汝罪人，何得擅離禁所！」詔誅守者，復置於獄。及改元保寧，乃宥之，妻以皇后之姊，復爵，王宋。喜隱輕僄無恒，小得志即驕。上嘗召，不時至，怒而鞭之，由是憤怨謀亂。貶而復召，適見上與劉繼元書，辭意卑遜，諫曰：「本朝於漢為祖，書旨如此，恐虧國體。」帝尋改之。授西南面招討使，命之河東索吐蕃戶，稍見進用。復誘群小謀叛，上命械其手足，築圜土，囚祖州。宋降卒二百餘人欲劫立喜隱，以城堅不得入，立其子留禮壽，上京留守除室擒之。留禮壽伏誅，賜喜隱死。

sourceRange.text: 平王隆先，字團隱，母大氏。景宗即位，始封平王。未幾，兼政事令，留守東京。薄賦稅，省刑獄，恤鰥寡，數薦賢能之士。後與統軍耶律室魯同討高麗有功，還薨，葬醫巫閭山之道隱谷。平王為人聰明，博學能詩，有《閬苑集》行於世。保寧之季，其子陳哥與渤海官屬謀殺其父，舉兵作亂，上命轘裂於市。晉王道隱，字留隱，母高氏。道隱生於唐，人皇王遭李從珂之害，時年尚幼，洛陽僧匿而養之，因名道隱。太宗滅唐，還京，詔賜外羅山地居焉。性沈靜，有文武才，時人稱之。景宗即位，封蜀王，為上京留守。乾亨元年，遷守南京，號令嚴肅，民獲安業。居數年，徙封荊王。統和初，病薨，追封晉王。

sourceRange.text: 唐以天子儀衛迎倍，倍坐船殿，眾官陪列上壽。至汴，見明宗。明宗以莊宗后夏氏妻之，賜姓東丹，名之曰慕華。改瑞州為懷化軍，拜懷化軍節度使、瑞慎等州觀察使。復賜姓李，名贊華。移鎮滑州，遙領虔州節度使。倍雖在異國，常思其親，問安之使不絕。後明宗養子從珂弒其君自立，倍密報太宗曰：「從珂弒君，盍討之。」及太宗立石敬瑭為晉主，加兵於洛。從珂欲自焚，召倍與俱，倍不從，遣壯士李彥紳害之，時年三十八。有一僧為收瘞之。敬瑭入洛，喪服臨哭，以王禮權厝。後太宗改葬於醫巫閭山，謚曰文武元皇王。世宗即位，謚讓國皇帝，陵曰顯陵。統和中，更謚文獻。重熙二十年，增謚文獻欽義皇帝，廟號義宗，及謚二后曰端順，曰柔貞。

sourceRange.text: 晉王，小字敖盧斡，天祚皇帝長子，母曰文妃蕭氏。甫髫齔，馳馬善射。出為大丞相耶律隆運後，封晉王。性樂道人善，而矜人不能。時宮中見讀書者輒斥，敖盧斡嘗入寢殿，見小底茶剌閱書，因取觀。會諸王至，陰袖而歸之，曰：「勿令他人見也。」一時號稱長者。及長，積有人望，內外歸心。保大元年，南軍都統耶律余睹與其母文妃密謀立之，事覺，余睹降金，文妃伏誅，敖盧斡實不與謀，免。二年，耶律撒八等復謀立，不克。上知敖盧斡得人心，不忍加誅，令縊殺之。或勸之亡，敖盧斡曰：「安忍為蕞爾之軀，而失臣子之大節！」遂就死。聞者傷之。

sourceRange.text: 三年七月，皇都既成，燕群臣以落之。曷魯是月得疾薨，年四十七。既葬，賜名其阡宴答，山曰於越峪，詔立石紀功。清寧間，命立祠上京。初，曷魯病革，太祖臨視，問所欲言。曷魯曰：「陛下聖德寬仁，群生咸遂，帝業隆興。臣既蒙寵遇，雖瞑目無憾。惟析叠剌部議未決，願亟行之。」及薨，太祖流涕曰：「斯人若登三五載，吾謀蔑不濟矣！」後太祖二十一功臣，各有所擬，以曷魯為心雲。子惕剌、撒剌，俱不仕。

sourceRange.text: 蕭敵魯，字敵輦，其母為德祖女弟，而淳欽皇后又其女兄也。五世祖曰胡母裏，遙輦氏時嘗使唐，唐留之幽州。一夕，折關遁歸國，由是世為決獄官。敵魯性寬厚，膂力絕人，習軍旅事。太祖潛藩，日侍左右，凡征討必與行陣。既即位，敵魯與弟阿古只、耶律釋魯、耶律曷魯偕總宿衛。拜敵魯北府宰相，世其官。太祖征奚及討劉守光，敵魯略地海濱，殺獲甚眾。頃之，剌葛等作亂，潰而北走。敵魯率輕騎追之，兼晝夜行。至榆河，敗其黨，獲剌葛以獻。太祖嘉之，錫賚甚渥。後討西南夷，功居諸將先。神冊三年十二月卒。敵魯有膽略，聞敵所在即馳赴，親冒矢石，前後戰未嘗少恤，必勝乃止。以故在太祖功臣列，喻以手雲。弟阿古只。阿古只，字撒本。少卓越自放不羈。長驍勇善射，臨敵敢前。每射甲楯輒洞貫。太祖為於越時，以材勇充任使。既即位，與敵魯總腹心部。剌葛之亂也，淳欽皇后軍黑山，阻險自固。太祖方經略奚地，命阿古只統百騎往衛之。逆黨叠裏特、耶律滑哥素憚其勇略，相戒曰：「是不可犯也！」剌葛既北走，與敵魯追擒於榆河。神冊初元，討西南夷有功；徇山西諸郡縣，又下之，敗周德威軍。三年，以功拜北府宰相，世其職。天贊初，與王郁略地燕、趙，破磁窯鎮。太祖西征，悉諉以南面邊事。

sourceRange.text: 老古，字撒懶，其母淳欽皇后姊也。老古幼養宮掖，既長，沈毅有勇略，隸太祖帳下。既即位，屢有戰功。剌葛之亂也，欲乘我不備為掩襲計，紿降。太祖將納之，命老古、耶律欲穩嚴號令，勒士卒，控轡以防其變。逆黨知有備，懼而遁。以功授右皮室詳穩，典宿衛。太祖侵燕、趙，遇唐兵雲碧店，老古恃勇輕敵，直犯其鋒。戰久之，被數創，歸營而卒。太祖深悼惜之，佐命功臣其一也。

sourceRange.text: __TOC__○耶律覿烈（羽之）耶律鐸臻（古突呂不）王郁耶律圖魯窘耶律覿烈，字兀裏軫，六院部蒲古只夷離堇之後。父偶思，亦為夷離堇。初，太祖為於越時，覿烈以謹願寬恕見器使。既即位，兄曷魯典宿衛，以故覿烈入侍帷幄，與聞政事。神冊三年，曷魯薨，命覿烈為叠剌部夷離堇，屬以南方事。會討党項，皇太子為先鋒，覿烈副之。軍至天德、雲內，分道並進。覿烈率偏師渡河力戰，斬獲甚眾。天贊初，析叠剌部為北、南院，置夷離堇。時大元帥率師由古北口略燕地，覿烈徇山西，所至城堡皆下，太祖嘉其功，錫賚甚厚。從伐渤海，拔扶餘城，留覿烈與寅底石守之。天顯二年，留守南京。十年卒，年五十六。弟羽之。

manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Dilie
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Dilie

manualTranslations.idiomatic: (Yuzhi)

manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Duozhen
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Duozhen

manualTranslations.literal: (Gu and Tulubu)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (Gu and Tulubu)

manualTranslations.zh: 王郁耶律圖魯窘。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Yu; Yelu Tulujiong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yu; Yelu Tulujiong.

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律覿烈，字兀裏軫，六院部蒲古只夷離堇之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Dilie, style name Wulizhen, was a descendant of the yilijin Puguzhi of the Six Courts tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Dilie, whose style was Wulizhen, was a descendant of the yilijin Puguzhi of the Six Courts tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 父偶思，亦為夷離堇。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Ousi also served as yilijin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Ousi had also served as yilijin.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，太祖為於越時，覿烈以謹願寬恕見器使。
manualTranslations.literal: Early on, when the Taizu was Yuyue, Dilie was valued and employed for his prudence, willingness, and forgiving nature.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early on, when Taizu was Yuyue, Dilie was valued and employed for his prudence, willingness, and forgiving nature.

manualTranslations.zh: 既即位，兄曷魯典宿衛，以故覿烈入侍帷幄，與聞政事。
manualTranslations.literal: After Taizu acceded, his elder brother Helu commanded the palace guard, and so Dilie entered service within the imperial tent and took part in state affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Taizu acceded, his elder brother Helu commanded the palace guard, and so Dilie entered service within the imperial tent and took part in state affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 神冊三年，曷魯薨，命覿烈為叠剌部夷離堇，屬以南方事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Shence, Helu died; Dilie was appointed yilijin of the Yila tribe and entrusted with southern affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shence, after Helu died, Dilie was appointed yilijin of the Yila tribe and entrusted with southern affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 會討党項，皇太子為先鋒，覿烈副之。
manualTranslations.literal: When they campaigned against the Tangut, the heir apparent served as vanguard and Dilie assisted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they campaigned against the Tangut, the heir apparent served as vanguard and Dilie served as his deputy.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍至天德、雲內，分道並進。
manualTranslations.literal: The army reached Tiande and Yunnei and advanced along separate routes in concert.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The army reached Tiande and Yunnei and advanced along separate routes in concert.

manualTranslations.zh: 覿烈率偏師渡河力戰，斬獲甚眾。
manualTranslations.literal: Dilie led a detached force across the river and fought fiercely, killing and capturing a great host.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dilie led a detached force across the river and fought fiercely, killing and capturing a great host.

manualTranslations.zh: 天贊初，析叠剌部為北、南院，置夷離堇。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianzan, the Yila tribe was divided into Northern and Southern Courts and yilijin were installed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianzan, the Yila tribe was divided into Northern and Southern Courts and yilijin were installed.

manualTranslations.zh: 時大元帥率師由古北口略燕地，覿烈徇山西，所至城堡皆下，太祖嘉其功，錫賚甚厚。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the grand marshal led the army through Gubeikou to raid the Yan region; Dilie swept through Shanxi, and wherever he went the fortresses fell. The Taizu praised his achievements and rewarded him lavishly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the grand marshal led the army through Gubeikou to raid the Yan region. Dilie swept through Shanxi, and wherever he went the fortresses fell. Taizu praised his achievements and rewarded him lavishly.

manualTranslations.zh: 從伐渤海，拔扶餘城，留覿烈與寅底石守之。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Bohai, stormed Fuyu city, and Dilie was left with Yindishi to hold it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Bohai and stormed Fuyu city; Dilie was left with Yindishi to hold it.

manualTranslations.zh: 天顯二年，留守南京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianxian, he remained behind as garrison commander at Nanjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianxian, he remained behind as garrison commander at Nanjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年卒，年五十六。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he died, at age fifty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he died, at the age of fifty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟羽之。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother was Yuzhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Yuzhi.

sourceRange.text: 耶律朔古，字彌骨頂，橫帳孟父之後。幼為太祖所養。既冠，為右皮室詳穩。從伐渤海，戰有功。天顯七年，授三河烏古部都詳穩。平易近民，民安之，以故久其任。會同間，為惕隱。時晉主石重貴渝盟，帝親征，晉將杜重威擁眾拒滹沱。月餘，帝由他渡濟。朔古與趙延壽據中渡橋，重威兵卻，遂降。是歲，入汴。世宗即位，朔古奉太宗喪歸上京，佐皇太后出師，坐是免官，卒。

context.afterSource: 耶律魯不古，字信寧，太祖從侄也。

sourceRange.text: 後太宗克汴，延壽因李崧求為皇太子，上曰：「吾於魏王雖割肌肉亦不惜，但皇太子須天子之子得為，魏王豈得為也？」蓋上嘗許滅晉後，以中原帝延壽，以故摧堅破敵，延壽常以身先，至是以崧達意。上命遷延壽秩，翰林學士承旨張礪進擬中京留守、大丞相、錄尚書事、都督中外諸軍事，上塗「錄尚書事、都督中外諸軍事」。世宗即位，以翊戴功，授樞密使。天祿二年薨。

sourceRange.text: 何魯不，字斜寧，嘗與耶律屋質平察割亂。穆宗以其父吼首議立世宗，故不顯用。晚年為本族敞史。及景宗即位，以平察割功，授昭德軍節度使，為北院大王。時黃龍府軍將燕頗殺守臣以叛，何魯不討之，破於鴨淥江。坐不親追擊，以至失賊，杖之。乾亨間卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 何魯不，字斜寧，嘗與耶律屋質平察割亂。
manualTranslations.literal: Helubu, courtesy name Xiening, once joined Yelu Wuzhi in suppressing Chage's rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Helubu, whose courtesy name was Xiening, once joined Yelu Wuzhi in suppressing Chage's rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 穆宗以其父吼首議立世宗，故不顯用。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Muzong knew his father Hou had been foremost in planning to enthrone Shizong, he did not employ him prominently.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Muzong knew his father Hou had led the plan to enthrone Shizong, he did not give him prominent office.

manualTranslations.zh: 晚年為本族敞史。
manualTranslations.literal: In his later years he served as changshi of his own tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In his later years he served as changshi of his own tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 及景宗即位，以平察割功，授昭德軍節度使，為北院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in suppressing Chage he was made Zhaode Army military commissioner and great king of the Northern Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, for his service in suppressing Chage he was appointed Zhaode Army military commissioner and made great king of the Northern Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 時黃龍府軍將燕頗殺守臣以叛，何魯不討之，破於鴨淥江。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Yan Yan, a garrison officer of Huanglong Prefecture, killed the defending official and rebelled; Helubu campaigned against him and defeated him on the Yalu River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yan Yan, a garrison officer of Huanglong Prefecture, killed the defending official and rebelled, Helubu campaigned against him and defeated him on the Yalu River.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐不親追擊，以至失賊，杖之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he did not pursue in person, the rebels escaped; he was beaten with the staff.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he failed to pursue in person and let the rebels escape, he was flogged.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾亨間卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died during the Qianheng era.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died during the Qianheng era.

sourceRange.text: 保寧初，宋圍太原，以屋質率兵往援，至白馬嶺，遣勁卒夜出間道，疾馳駐太原西，鳴鼓舉火。宋兵以為大軍至，懼而宵遁。以功加於越。四年，漢劉繼元遣使來貢，致幣於屋質，屋質以聞，帝命受之。五年五月薨，年五十七。帝痛悼，輟朝三日。後道宗詔上京立祠祭享，樹碑以紀其功雲。

context.beforeSource: 應歷五年，為北院大王，總山西事。

manualTranslations.literal: Early in the Baoning era, when Song besieged Taiyuan, Wuzhi was sent with troops to relieve the city; reaching White Horse Ridge, he dispatched crack troops by night along a hidden path to gallop swiftly and halt west of Taiyuan, beating drums and raising fires.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era, when Song besieged Taiyuan, Wuzhi led troops to relieve the city; at White Horse Ridge he sent crack troops by night along a hidden path to gallop west of Taiyuan, beating drums and raising fires.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋兵以為大軍至，懼而宵遁。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song army thought a great host had arrived, feared it, and fled by night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song army thought the main force had arrived, panicked, and fled overnight.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功加於越。
manualTranslations.literal: For his merit he was advanced to yuyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this service he was promoted to yuyue.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，漢劉繼元遣使來貢，致幣於屋質，屋質以聞，帝命受之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, Liu Jiyuan of Han sent envoys to present tribute and offered gifts to Wuzhi; Wuzhi reported this, and the emperor ordered the gifts accepted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Liu Jiyuan of Northern Han sent envoys with tribute and offered gifts to Wuzhi; Wuzhi reported the matter, and the emperor ordered the gifts accepted.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年五月薨，年五十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year he died, aged fifty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth month of the fifth year, aged fifty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝痛悼，輟朝三日。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for three days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for three days.

manualTranslations.zh: 後道宗詔上京立祠祭享，樹碑以紀其功雲。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Emperor Daozong ordered a shrine erected at the Upper Capital for sacrificial offerings and a stele set up to record his achievements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Emperor Daozong ordered a shrine built at the Upper Capital for sacrificial offerings and a stele erected to commemorate his achievements.

sourceRange.text: 耶律窪，字敵輦，隋國王釋魯孫，南院夷離堇綰思子。少有器識，人以公輔期之。太祖時，雖未官，常任以事。太宗即位，為惕隱。天顯末，帝援河東，窪為先鋒，敗張敬達軍於太原北。會同中，遷北院大王。及伐晉，復為先鋒，與梁漢璋戰於瀛州，敗之。太宗崩於欒城，南方州郡多叛，士馬困乏，軍中不知所為。窪與耶律吼定策立世宗，乃令諸將曰：「大行上賓，神器無主，永康王人皇王之嫡長，天人所屬，當立；有不從者，以軍法從事。」諸將皆曰：「諾。」世宗即位，賜宮戶五十，拜於越。卒，年五十四。耶律頹昱，字團寧，孟父楚國王之後。父末掇，嘗為夷離堇。頹昱性端直。會同中，領九石烈部，政濟寬猛。世宗即位，為惕隱。天祿三年，兼政事令，封漆水郡王。及穆宗立，以匡贊功，嘗許以本部大王。後將葬世宗，頹昱懇言於帝曰：「臣蒙先帝厚恩，未能報；幸及大葬，臣請陪位。」帝由是不悅，寢其議。薨。耶律撻烈，字涅魯袞，六院部郎君甗古直之後。沈厚多智，有任重才。年四十未仕。會同間，為邊部令穩。應歷初，升南院大王，均賦役，勸耕稼，部人化之，戶口豐殖。時周人侵漢，以撻烈都統西南道軍援之。周已下太原數城，漢人不敢戰。及聞撻烈兵至，周主遣郭從義、尚鈞等率精騎拒於忻口。撻烈擊敗之，獲其將史彥超，周軍遁歸，復所陷城邑，漢主詣撻烈謝。及漢主殂，宋師來伐，上命撻烈為行軍都統，發諸道兵救之。既出雁門，宋諜知而退。保寧元年，加兼政事令，致政。乾亨初，召之。上見鬚髮皓然，精力猶健，問以政事，厚禮之。以疾薨，年七十九。

context.afterSource: 撻烈凡用兵，賞罰信明，得士卒心。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律窪，字敵輦，隋國王釋魯孫，南院夷離堇綰思子。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Wa, courtesy name Dirilian, was grandson of Prince of Sui Shilu and son of yilijin Wansi of the Southern Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Wa, whose courtesy name was Dirilian, was grandson of Prince of Sui Shilu and son of Southern Court yilijin Wansi.

manualTranslations.zh: 少有器識，人以公輔期之。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he had capacity and insight, and people looked to him for high office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he showed foresight and judgment, and people expected him to reach high office.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖時，雖未官，常任以事。
manualTranslations.literal: During Taizu's time, though without office, he was often entrusted with affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Taizu, though he held no formal office, he was often entrusted with important affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗即位，為惕隱。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, he became tiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, he was made tiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 天顯末，帝援河東，窪為先鋒，敗張敬達軍於太原北。
manualTranslations.literal: Late in the Tianxian era the emperor aided Hedong; Wa served as vanguard and defeated Zhang Jingda's army north of Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in the Tianxian era the emperor marched to aid Hedong; Wa served as vanguard and defeated Zhang Jingda's army north of Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 會同中，遷北院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: During Huitong he was transferred to great king of the Northern Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Huitong period he was transferred to great king of the Northern Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 及伐晉，復為先鋒，與梁漢璋戰於瀛州，敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: When they campaigned against Jin he again served as vanguard, fought Liang Hanzhang at Yingzhou, and defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army campaigned against Jin he again served as vanguard, fought Liang Hanzhang at Yingzhou, and defeated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗崩於欒城，南方州郡多叛，士馬困乏，軍中不知所為。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizong died at Luancheng, many southern prefectures and districts rebelled; troops and horses were exhausted, and the army did not know what to do.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng, many southern prefectures rebelled; troops and horses were exhausted, and the army was at a loss.

manualTranslations.zh: 窪與耶律吼定策立世宗，乃令諸將曰：「大行上賓，神器無主，永康王人皇王之嫡長，天人所屬，當立；
manualTranslations.literal: Wa and Yelu Hou settled on a plan to enthrone Shizong, then ordered the generals, saying, "The late emperor has ascended as guest; the regalia of state has no master. Prince Yongkang is the direct eldest son of Emperor Ren and the choice of Heaven and men—he should be enthroned;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wa and Yelu Hou resolved to enthrone Shizong, then told the generals, "The late emperor has departed; the throne stands vacant. Prince Yongkang is the direct eldest son of Emperor Ren and Heaven's chosen heir—he should be enthroned;

manualTranslations.zh: 有不從者，以軍法從事。」
manualTranslations.literal: whoever does not obey will be dealt with by military law."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: whoever refuses will be dealt with by military law."

manualTranslations.zh: 諸將皆曰：「諾。」
manualTranslations.literal: The generals all said, "Yes."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The generals all answered, "Yes."

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗即位，賜宮戶五十，拜於越。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he granted fifty palace households and invested him as yuyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he granted Wa fifty palace households and invested him as yuyue.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，年五十四。
manualTranslations.literal: He died, aged fifty-four.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at the age of fifty-four.

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律頹昱，字團寧，孟父楚國王之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Tuiyu, courtesy name Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Tuiyu, whose courtesy name was Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 父末掇，嘗為夷離堇。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Moduo once served as yilijin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Moduo had once served as yilijin.

manualTranslations.zh: 頹昱性端直。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuiyu's nature was upright and direct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tuiyu was upright and forthright by nature.

manualTranslations.zh: 會同中，領九石烈部，政濟寬猛。
manualTranslations.literal: During Huitong he led the Nine Shilie tribes; his governance balanced leniency and severity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Huitong period he led the Nine Shilie tribes and governed with a balance of leniency and severity.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗即位，為惕隱。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he became tiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he was made tiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祿三年，兼政事令，封漆水郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tianlu he was made concurrent chief administrator and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianlu he was made concurrent chief administrator and enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 及穆宗立，以匡贊功，嘗許以本部大王。
manualTranslations.literal: When Muzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was once promised the great kingship of his tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, for his service in supporting the enthronement he was once promised the great kingship of his tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 後將葬世宗，頹昱懇言於帝曰：「臣蒙先帝厚恩，未能報；
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Shizong was to be buried, Tuiyu earnestly said to the emperor, "Your servant received great favor from the late emperor and has been unable to repay it;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when Shizong was to be buried, Tuiyu earnestly said to the emperor, "I received great favor from the late emperor and have been unable to repay it;

manualTranslations.zh: 幸及大葬，臣請陪位。」
manualTranslations.literal: now that the great burial has come, your servant asks to take part in the rites."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: now that the state funeral is at hand, I ask to take part in the rites."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝由是不悅，寢其議。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was displeased by this and set the proposal aside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased and set the proposal aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died.

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律撻烈，字涅魯袞，六院部郎君甗古直之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Talie, courtesy name Nielugun, was a descendant of Langjun Enguzhi of the Six Courts tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Talie, whose courtesy name was Nielugun, was a descendant of Langjun Enguzhi of the Six Courts tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 沈厚多智，有任重才。
manualTranslations.literal: He was deep, steady, and resourceful, with talent fit for heavy responsibility.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was deep, steady, and resourceful, with talent fit for heavy responsibility.

manualTranslations.zh: 年四十未仕。
manualTranslations.literal: He reached forty without taking office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He reached forty without taking office.

manualTranslations.zh: 會同間，為邊部令穩。
manualTranslations.literal: During Huitong he served as lingwen of a frontier tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Huitong period he served as lingwen of a frontier tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 應歷初，升南院大王，均賦役，勸耕稼，部人化之，戶口豐殖。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Yingli he was promoted to great king of the Southern Court; he equalized levies and corvée, encouraged farming, and the people of his tribe were transformed—households multiplied.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Yingli period he was promoted to great king of the Southern Court; he equalized levies and corvée, encouraged farming, and the people of his tribe were transformed until households multiplied.

manualTranslations.zh: 時周人侵漢，以撻烈都統西南道軍援之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Zhou invaded Han, and Talie was made overall commander of the Southwest Route army to relieve it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhou invaded Han, Talie was made overall commander of the Southwest Route army to relieve it.

manualTranslations.zh: 周已下太原數城，漢人不敢戰。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou had already taken several cities around Taiyuan, and the Han forces did not dare fight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou had already taken several cities around Taiyuan, and the Han forces did not dare give battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 及聞撻烈兵至，周主遣郭從義、尚鈞等率精騎拒於忻口。
manualTranslations.literal: When they heard Talie's army had arrived, the Zhou ruler sent Guo Congyi, Shang Jun, and others with crack cavalry to oppose him at Xinkou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When word came that Talie's army had arrived, the Zhou ruler sent Guo Congyi, Shang Jun, and others with elite cavalry to oppose him at Xinkou.

manualTranslations.zh: 撻烈擊敗之，獲其將史彥超，周軍遁歸，復所陷城邑，漢主詣撻烈謝。
manualTranslations.literal: Talie defeated them, captured their general Shi Yanchao, the Zhou army fled back, the lost cities were recovered, and the Han ruler came to thank Talie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Talie defeated them, captured their general Shi Yanchao, the Zhou army fled, the lost cities were recovered, and the Han ruler came in person to thank him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及漢主殂，宋師來伐，上命撻烈為行軍都統，發諸道兵救之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Han ruler died, Song forces came to attack; the emperor ordered Talie to serve as campaign commander-in-chief and mobilize troops from all routes to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Han ruler died, Song forces invaded; the emperor ordered Talie to serve as campaign commander-in-chief and mobilize troops from all routes to relieve them.

manualTranslations.zh: 既出雁門，宋諜知而退。
manualTranslations.literal: Once he had marched out through Yanmen, Song scouts learned of it and withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once he marched out through Yanmen Pass, Song scouts learned of it and withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 保寧元年，加兼政事令，致政。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoning he was made additional concurrent chief administrator and retired from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoning he was made additional concurrent chief administrator and retired from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾亨初，召之。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Qianheng he was summoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianheng period he was summoned to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 上見鬚髮皓然，精力猶健，問以政事，厚禮之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor saw his beard and hair were white but his vigor was still strong; he questioned him on state affairs and treated him with great honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor saw that his beard and hair were white but his vigor remained strong; he questioned him on state affairs and treated him with great honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 以疾薨，年七十九。
manualTranslations.literal: He died of illness, aged seventy-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died of illness at the age of seventy-nine.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__○耶律夷臘葛蕭海璃蕭護思蕭思溫蕭繼先耶律夷臘葛，字蘇散，本宮分人檢校太師合魯子之。應歷初，以父任入侍。數歲，始為殿前都點檢。時上新即位，疑諸王有異志，引夷臘葛為布衣交，一切機密事必與之謀，遷寄班都知，賜宮戶。時上酗酒，數以細故殺人。有監雉者因傷雉而亡，獲之欲誅，夷臘葛諫曰：「是罪不應死。」帝竟殺之，以屍付夷臘葛曰：「收汝故人！」夷臘葛終不為止。復有監鹿詳穩亡一鹿，下獄當死，夷臘葛又諫曰：「人命至重，豈可為一獸殺之？」良久，得免。遼法，麚歧角者，惟天子得射。會秋獵，善為鹿鳴者呼一麚至，命夷臘葛射，應弦而踣。上大悅，賜金、銀各百兩，名馬百匹，及黑山東抹真之地。後穆宗被弒，坐守衛不嚴，被誅。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律夷臘葛，字蘇散，本宮分人檢校太師合魯子之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelü Yilage, style name Sussan — of the palace division, son of Inspector Grand Preceptor Helu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelü Yilage, whose style name was Sussan, was from the palace division and was the son of Inspector Grand Preceptor Helu.

manualTranslations.zh: 應歷初，以父任入侍。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yingli, through his father's appointment he entered to serve at court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the start of the Yingli era he entered court service through his father's appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 數歲，始為殿前都點檢。
manualTranslations.literal: After several years he first became Palace Front Chief Inspector.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a few years he was first made Palace Front Chief Inspector.

manualTranslations.zh: 時上新即位，疑諸王有異志，引夷臘葛為布衣交，一切機密事必與之謀，遷寄班都知，賜宮戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the new emperor had just taken the throne, suspecting the princes of disloyal intent; he drew Yilage into friendship as a commoner companion — every confidential matter he necessarily consulted with him; he was transferred to Chief Steward of the Ji Class and granted palace households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the new emperor had just ascended, suspecting the princes of disloyal intent, he treated Yilage as a commoner's friend and consulted him on every confidential matter. Yilage was promoted to Chief Steward of the Ji Class and granted palace households.

manualTranslations.zh: 時上酗酒，數以細故殺人。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the emperor drank heavily and frequently killed people over trivial causes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor drank heavily at the time and often killed people over trifling matters.

manualTranslations.zh: 有監雉者因傷雉而亡，獲之欲誅，夷臘葛諫曰：「是罪不應死。」
manualTranslations.literal: There was a pheasant keeper who fled because a pheasant was injured and died; when caught the emperor wished to execute him; Yilage remonstrated, saying: "This offense should not be punished with death."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A pheasant keeper fled after a pheasant in his charge was injured and died. When he was caught the emperor wanted to execute him, but Yilage remonstrated: "This crime does not warrant death."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝竟殺之，以屍付夷臘葛曰：「收汝故人！」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor still killed him, and handing the corpse to Yilage said: "Take your old friend!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor killed him anyway and, handing the corpse to Yilage, said: "Take your old friend!"

manualTranslations.zh: 夷臘葛終不為止。
manualTranslations.literal: Yilage in the end did not desist.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yilage still did not hold back.

manualTranslations.zh: 復有監鹿詳穩亡一鹿，下獄當死，夷臘葛又諫曰：「人命至重，豈可為一獸殺之？」
manualTranslations.literal: Again there was a deer-keeper stanap who lost a deer; imprisoned, he deserved death; Yilage again remonstrated: "Human life is supremely weighty — how can one kill a man for a single beast?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later a deer-keeper stanap lost a deer and, thrown in prison, was to be executed. Yilage remonstrated again: "Human life is paramount — how can a man be killed over one animal?"

manualTranslations.zh: 良久，得免。
manualTranslations.literal: After a long while, he was spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After some time he was spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 遼法，麚歧角者，惟天子得射。
manualTranslations.literal: Under Liao law, a stag with forked antlers — only the Son of Heaven might shoot it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Liao law, only the emperor might shoot a stag with forked antlers.

manualTranslations.zh: 會秋獵，善為鹿鳴者呼一麚至，命夷臘葛射，應弦而踣。
manualTranslations.literal: At an autumn hunt, one skilled in deer calls summoned a stag; the emperor ordered Yilage to shoot — at the bowstring's release it fell.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During an autumn hunt, a man skilled at imitating deer calls lured a stag forward. The emperor ordered Yilage to shoot, and at the twang of the bowstring the stag dropped.

manualTranslations.zh: 上大悅，賜金、銀各百兩，名馬百匹，及黑山東抹真之地。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and bestowed one hundred taels each of gold and silver, one hundred famous horses, and the land of Mozhen east of Black Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and granted him one hundred taels each of gold and silver, one hundred fine horses, and the Mozhen territory east of Black Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 後穆宗被弒，坐守衛不嚴，被誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Muzong was assassinated, for laxity in guarding him Yilage was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when Emperor Muzong was assassinated, Yilage was executed for laxity in his guard duties.

sourceRange.text: 女裏，字涅烈袞，逸其氏族，補積慶宮人。應歷初，為習馬小底，以母憂去。一日至雅伯山，見一巨人，惶懼走。巨人止之曰：「勿懼，我地祇也。葬爾母於斯，當速詣闕，必貴。」女裏從之，累遷馬群侍中。時景宗在藩邸，以女裏出自本宮，待遇殊厚，女裏亦傾心結納。及穆宗遇弒，女裏奔赴景宗。是夜，集禁兵五百以衛。既即位，以翼戴功，加政事令、契丹行宮都部署，賞賚甚渥，尋加守太尉。北漢主劉繼元聞女裏為上信任，遇其生日必致禮。

context.afterSource: 女裏素貪，同列蕭阿不底亦好賄，二人相善。
context.afterLocal: 女裏素貪，同列蕭阿不底亦好賄，二人相善。

manualTranslations.zh: 女裏，字涅烈袞，逸其氏族，補積慶宮人。
manualTranslations.literal: Nuli, courtesy name Nieliegün; his clan is not recorded. He was made a palace attendant at Jiqing Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Nuli, whose courtesy name was Nieliegün, came from a clan not recorded in the sources; he was appointed a palace attendant at Jiqing Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 應歷初，為習馬小底，以母憂去。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yingli he served as a junior horse-training attendant and left office to mourn his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yingli reign he served as a junior horse-training attendant and left office to mourn his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 一日至雅伯山，見一巨人，惶懼走。
manualTranslations.literal: One day he came to Mount Yabo and saw a giant; frightened, he fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One day he went to Mount Yabo, saw a giant, and fled in fear.

manualTranslations.zh: 巨人止之曰：「勿懼，我地祇也。
manualTranslations.literal: The giant stopped him and said: "Do not fear; I am an earth spirit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The giant stopped him and said, "Do not fear; I am an earth spirit.

manualTranslations.zh: 葬爾母於斯，當速詣闕，必貴。」
manualTranslations.literal: Bury your mother here, and go quickly to the court—you are certain to rise to eminence."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bury your mother here, go quickly to the court, and you are certain to rise to eminence."

manualTranslations.zh: 女裏從之，累遷馬群侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Nuli followed this counsel and was repeatedly promoted, eventually becoming Commissioner of Horse Herds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Nuli followed this counsel and rose through repeated promotions until he became Commissioner of Horse Herds.

manualTranslations.zh: 時景宗在藩邸，以女裏出自本宮，待遇殊厚，女裏亦傾心結納。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Jingzong was in the princely residence; because Nuli came from the same palace, he was treated with exceptional favor, and Nuli in turn devoted himself and formed close ties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Jingzong was still in the princely residence; because Nuli came from the same palace household, he was treated with exceptional favor, and Nuli in turn devoted himself and formed close ties with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及穆宗遇弒，女裏奔赴景宗。
manualTranslations.literal: When Muzong was assassinated, Nuli hastened to Jingzong's side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Muzong was assassinated, Nuli rushed to Jingzong's side.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夜，集禁兵五百以衛。
manualTranslations.literal: That night he gathered five hundred forbidden troops to guard him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night he gathered five hundred imperial guards to protect him.

manualTranslations.zh: 既即位，以翼戴功，加政事令、契丹行宮都部署，賞賚甚渥，尋加守太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement Nuli was made Chief Administrator and chief deployment of the Khitan mobile palace; he was richly rewarded, and soon thereafter was further made Defender Grandee.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement Nuli was made chief administrator and chief deployment of the Khitan mobile palace; he was richly rewarded, and soon thereafter was further made Defender Grandee.

manualTranslations.zh: 北漢主劉繼元聞女裏為上信任，遇其生日必致禮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Northern Han ruler Liu Jiyuan, hearing that Nuli enjoyed the emperor's trust, invariably sent gifts on his birthday.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Northern Han ruler Liu Jiyuan, hearing that Nuli enjoyed the emperor's trust, invariably sent gifts on his birthday.

sourceRange.text: 馬得臣，南京人，好學博古，善屬文，尤長於詩。保寧間，累遷政事舍人、翰林學士，常預朝議，以正直稱。乾亨初，宋師屢犯邊，命為南京副留守，復拜翰林學士承旨。聖宗即位，皇太后稱制，兼侍讀學士。上閱唐高祖、太宗、玄宗三《紀》，得臣乃錄其行事可法者進之。及扈從伐宋，進言降不可殺，亡不可追，二三其德者別議。詔從之。俄兼諫議大夫，知宣徽院事。時上擊鞠無度，上書諫曰：臣竊觀房玄齡、杜如晦，隋季書生，向不遇太宗，安能為一代名相？

localRange.text: 臣竊觀房玄齡、杜如晦，隋季書生，向不遇太宗，安能為一代名相？

context.afterSource: 臣雖不才，陛下在東宮，幸列侍從，今又得侍聖讀，未有裨補聖明。

sourceRange.text: 蕭孝忠，字撒板，小字圖古斯，誌慷慨。開泰中，補祗候郎君，尚越國公主，拜駙馬都尉，累遷殿前都點檢。太平中，擢北府宰相。重熙七年，為東京留守。時禁渤海人擊球，孝忠言：「東京最為重鎮，無從禽之地，若非球馬，何以習武？且天子以四海為家，何分彼此？宜弛其禁。」從之。十二年，入朝，封楚王，拜北院樞密使。國制，以契丹、漢人分北、南院樞密治之，孝忠奏曰：「一國二樞密，風俗所以不同。若並為一，天下幸甚。」事未及行，薨。追封楚國王。帝素服哭臨，赦死囚數人，為孝忠薦福。葬日，親臨，賜宮戶守冢。子阿速，終南院樞密使。

context.afterSource: 陳昭袞，小字王九，雲州人。
context.afterLocal: 陳昭袞，小字王九，雲州人。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭孝忠，字撒板，小字圖古斯，誌慷慨。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Xiaozhong, style name Saban, childhood name Tugusi, was noted for bold generosity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Xiaozhong, whose style was Saban and childhood name Tugusi, was known for bold generosity.

manualTranslations.zh: 開泰中，補祗候郎君，尚越國公主，拜駙馬都尉，累遷殿前都點檢。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kai Tai he was appointed attendant gentleman, married Princess Yueguo, was made commissioner of the imperial son-in-law, and was repeatedly promoted to chief inspector of the Palace Front.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Kai Tai era he was made an attendant gentleman, married Princess Yueguo, was appointed commissioner of the imperial son-in-law, and rose to chief inspector of the Palace Front.

manualTranslations.zh: 太平中，擢北府宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: During Taiping he was promoted to Northern Prefecture chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Taiping era he was promoted to chancellor of the Northern Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 重熙七年，為東京留守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongxi he became defender of the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chongxi he was made defender of the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 時禁渤海人擊球，孝忠言：「東京最為重鎮，無從禽之地，若非球馬，何以習武？
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Bohai people were forbidden to play cuju. Xiaozhong said: "The Eastern Capital is the most important garrison; there is no place for hunting. If not for ball and horse, how can one practice martial arts?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Bohai people were forbidden to play cuju. Xiaozhong said, "The Eastern Capital is the most important garrison, and there is no place for hunting. Without ball and horse, how can one train in martial arts?

manualTranslations.zh: 且天子以四海為家，何分彼此？
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the Son of Heaven takes the four seas as his home—why distinguish between us and them?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Son of Heaven takes the four seas as his home—why distinguish between one and another?

manualTranslations.zh: 宜弛其禁。」
manualTranslations.literal: The prohibition should be relaxed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prohibition should be relaxed."

manualTranslations.zh: 從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The court assented.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court assented.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，入朝，封楚王，拜北院樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year he came to court, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, and appointed Northern Chancellery commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he came to court, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, and appointed commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 國制，以契丹、漢人分北、南院樞密治之，孝忠奏曰：「一國二樞密，風俗所以不同。
manualTranslations.literal: Under the state system, Khitan and Han were divided and governed by separate Northern and Southern Chancellery commissioners. Xiaozhong memorialized: "One state with two commissioners is why customs differ.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the state system, Khitan and Han were governed by separate Northern and Southern Chancellery commissioners. Xiaozhong memorialized, "One state with two commissioners is why customs differ.

manualTranslations.zh: 若並為一，天下幸甚。」
manualTranslations.literal: If they were merged into one, the realm would be greatly fortunate."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If they were merged into one, the realm would be greatly fortunate."

manualTranslations.zh: 事未及行，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Before the matter could be carried out, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before the matter could be carried out, he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 追封楚國王。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was enfeoffed as King of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was enfeoffed as King of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝素服哭臨，赦死囚數人，為孝忠薦福。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor wore plain mourning garb and came to weep; he pardoned several condemned prisoners as a merit-offering for Xiaozhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor wore plain mourning garb and came to weep; he pardoned several condemned prisoners to accumulate merit for Xiaozhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 葬日，親臨，賜宮戶守冢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day of burial the emperor came in person and granted palace households to guard the tomb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the day of burial the emperor came in person and granted palace households to guard the tomb.

manualTranslations.zh: 子阿速，終南院樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Asu ended his career as Southern Chancellery commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Asu ended his career as commissioner of the Southern Chancellery.

sourceRange.text: 耶律勃古哲，字蒲奴隱，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。勇悍，善治生。保寧中，為天德軍節度使，歷南京侍衛馬步軍都指揮使。以討平党項羌阿理撒米、仆裏鱉米，遷南院大王。聖宗即位，太后稱制，會群臣議軍國事，勃古哲上疏陳便宜數事，稱旨，即日兼領山西路諸州事。統和四年，宋將曹彬等侵燕，勃古哲擊之甚力，賜輸忠保節致主功臣，總知山西五州。會有告勃古哲曲法虐民者，按之有狀，以大杖決之。八年，為南京統軍使，卒。子爻裏，官至詳穩。蕭陽阿，字稍隱。端毅簡嚴，識遼、漢字，通天文、相法。父卒，自五蕃部親挽喪車至奚王嶺，人稱其孝。年十九，為本班郎君。歷鐵林、鐵鷂、大鷹三軍詳穩。乾統元年，由烏古敵烈部屯田太保為易州刺史。幸臣劉彥良嘗以事至州，怙寵恣橫，為陽阿所沮。彥良歸，妄加毀訾，尋遣人代陽阿。州民千餘詣闕請留，即日授武安州觀察使。歷烏古涅裏、順義、彰信等軍節度使，權知東北路統軍使事。聞耶律狼不、鐸魯斡等叛，獨引麾下三十餘人追捕之，身被二創，生擒十餘人，送之行在。坐不獲首惡，免官。未幾，權南京留守，卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律勃古哲，字蒲奴隱，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Boguzhe, style name Punuyin, was a descendant of Chancellery Commissioner Puguzhi of the Six Yuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Boguzhe, whose style name was Punuyin, was a descendant of Puguzhi, Chancellery Commissioner of the Six Yuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 勇悍，善治生。
manualTranslations.literal: Brave and fierce, skilled at managing livelihood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Brave and fierce, he was skilled at managing livelihood.

manualTranslations.zh: 保寧中，為天德軍節度使，歷南京侍衛馬步軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: During Baoning he served as Tiande Army Military Commissioner and successively as Nanjing Palace Guard Cavalry and Infantry Commander-in-Chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Baoning he served as Tiande Army Military Commissioner and then as Nanjing Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry and Infantry.

manualTranslations.zh: 以討平党項羌阿理撒米、仆裏鱉米，遷南院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: For suppressing and pacifying the Tangut chiefs Ali Sami and Pulibie Mi, he was transferred to Southern Chancellery Grand Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For suppressing the Tangut chiefs Ali Sami and Pulibie Mi, he was promoted to Grand Prince of the Southern Chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖宗即位，太后稱制，會群臣議軍國事，勃古哲上疏陳便宜數事，稱旨，即日兼領山西路諸州事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shengzong succeeded, the empress dowager held regency; at a gathering of ministers to deliberate on military and state affairs, Boguzhe submitted a memorial setting forth several expedient measures; it accorded with the imperial intent, and that same day he was given concurrent charge of the western-circuit prefectures of Shanxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shengzong succeeded and the empress dowager assumed regency, ministers met to deliberate on military and state affairs. Boguzhe submitted a memorial with several expedient proposals; it pleased the throne, and that same day he was given concurrent charge of the western-circuit prefectures of Shanxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和四年，宋將曹彬等侵燕，勃古哲擊之甚力，賜輸忠保節致主功臣，總知山西五州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Song generals led by Cao Bin invaded Yan, Boguzhe struck them with great force; he was granted the merit title of Loyal Submission, Integrity Preservation, and Sovereign Service, and given overall charge of the five Shanxi prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Song generals led by Cao Bin invaded Yan, Boguzhe struck them hard. He received the merit title of Loyal Submission, Integrity Preservation, and Sovereign Service and was given overall charge of the five Shanxi prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 會有告勃古哲曲法虐民者，按之有狀，以大杖決之。
manualTranslations.literal: When someone reported that Boguzhe had bent the law and abused the people, investigation found grounds; he was punished with the great staff.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When someone reported that Boguzhe had bent the law and abused the people, investigation found grounds, and he was beaten with the great staff.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，為南京統軍使，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year he became Nanjing Grand General and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became Nanjing Grand General and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子爻裏，官至詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yaoli ultimately rose to detailed commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yaoli rose to detailed commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭陽阿，字稍隱。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Yanga, style name Shaoyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Yanga, whose style name was Shaoyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 端毅簡嚴，識遼、漢字，通天文、相法。
manualTranslations.literal: Upright, resolute, concise, and stern, he knew Khitan and Chinese characters and was versed in astronomy and physiognomy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Upright, resolute, concise, and stern, he knew Khitan and Chinese script and was versed in astronomy and physiognomy.

manualTranslations.zh: 父卒，自五蕃部親挽喪車至奚王嶺，人稱其孝。
manualTranslations.literal: When his father died, he personally drew the funeral cart from the Five Fan tribes to Xiwang Ridge; people praised his filial piety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his father died, he personally drew the funeral cart from the Five Fan tribes to Xiwang Ridge, and people praised his filial devotion.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十九，為本班郎君。
manualTranslations.literal: At nineteen he became an attendant of his corps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At nineteen he became an attendant of his corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷鐵林、鐵鷂、大鷹三軍詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively served as detailed commandant of the Iron Forest, Iron Hawk, and Great Hawk armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in turn as detailed commandant of the Iron Forest, Iron Hawk, and Great Hawk armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統元年，由烏古敵烈部屯田太保為易州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qiantong he went from Grand Guardian of the Ugu and Dilie Tribal Garrisons to prefect of Yi Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiantong he went from Grand Guardian of the Ugu and Dilie tribal garrisons to prefect of Yi Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 幸臣劉彥良嘗以事至州，怙寵恣橫，為陽阿所沮。
manualTranslations.literal: The favored minister Liu Yanliang once came to the prefecture on business and, relying on favor, acted wantonly; Yanga blocked him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The favored minister Liu Yanliang once came to the prefecture on business and, relying on imperial favor, acted wantonly; Yanga blocked him.

manualTranslations.zh: 彥良歸，妄加毀訾，尋遣人代陽阿。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanliang returned and slandered him without cause; before long someone was sent to replace Yanga.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanliang returned and slandered him without cause; before long an envoy was sent to replace Yanga.

manualTranslations.zh: 州民千餘詣闕請留，即日授武安州觀察使。
manualTranslations.literal: More than a thousand people of the prefecture went to court requesting that he remain; that same day he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: More than a thousand people of the prefecture went to court asking that he remain, and that same day he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷烏古涅裏、順義、彰信等軍節度使，權知東北路統軍使事。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively served as military commissioner of the Wugu Nieli, Shunyi, and Zhangxin armies and was given provisional charge of Northeast Route grand general affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in turn as military commissioner of the Wugu Nieli, Shunyi, and Zhangxin armies and was given provisional charge of Northeast Route grand general affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 聞耶律狼不、鐸魯斡等叛，獨引麾下三十餘人追捕之，身被二創，生擒十餘人，送之行在。
manualTranslations.literal: Hearing that Yelu Langbu, Duoluwo, and others had rebelled, he alone led more than thirty men under his command in pursuit; he received two wounds, captured more than ten men alive, and sent them to the imperial camp.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hearing that Yelu Langbu, Duoluwo, and others had rebelled, he alone led a little more than thirty men in pursuit. He received two wounds, captured more than ten men alive, and sent them to the imperial camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐不獲首惡，免官。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he failed to capture the chief culprit, he was dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he failed to capture the chief culprit, he was dismissed from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，權南京留守，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he served provisionally as Nanjing Military Governor and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he served provisionally as Nanjing Military Governor and died.

sourceRange.text: 景宗疾大漸，與耶律斜軫俱受顧命，立梁王為帝，皇后為皇太后，稱制。隆運總宿衛事，太后益寵任之。統和元年，加開府儀同三司，兼政事令。四年，宋遣曹彬、米信將十萬眾來侵，隆運從太后出師敗之，加守司空，封楚國公。師還，與北府宰相室昉共執國政。上言山西四州數被兵，加以歲饑，宜輕稅賦以來流民，從之。六年，太后觀擊鞠，胡裏室突隆運墜馬，命立斬之。詔率師伐宋，圍沙堆，敵乘夜來襲，隆運嚴軍以待，敗走之，封楚王。九年，復言燕人挾奸，茍免賦役，貴族因為囊橐，可遣北院宣徽使趙智戒諭，從之。十一年，丁母憂，詔強起之。明年，室昉致政，以隆運代為北府宰相，仍領樞密使，監修國史，賜興化功臣。十二年六月，奏三京諸鞫獄官吏，多因請托，曲加寬貸，或妄行搒掠，乞行禁止。上可其奏。又表請任賢去邪，太后喜曰：「進賢輔政，真大臣之職。」優加賜賚。服闋，加守太保、兼政事令。會北院樞密使耶律斜軫薨，詔隆運兼之。久之，拜大丞相，進王齊，總二樞府事。以南京、平州歲不登，奏免百姓農器錢，及請平諸郡商賈價，並從之。二十二年，從太后南征，及河，許宋成而還。徙王晉，賜姓，出宮籍，隸橫帳季父房後，乃改賜今名，位親王上，賜田宅及陪葬地。從伐高麗還，得末疾，帝與後臨視醫藥。薨，年七十一。贈尚書令，謚文忠，官給葬具，建廟乾陵側。無子。清寧三年，以魏王貼不子耶魯為嗣。天祚立，以皇子敖盧斡繼之。弟德威，侄制心。

context.beforeSource: 以功拜遼興軍節度使，徵為南院樞密使。
context.beforeLocal: 以功拜遼興軍節度使，徵為南院樞密使。

manualTranslations.zh: 景宗疾大漸，與耶律斜軫俱受顧命，立梁王為帝，皇后為皇太后，稱制。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, together with Yelu Xiezhen he received the dying command, enthroned the Prince of Liang as emperor, made the empress empress dowager, and she assumed regency.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong fell gravely ill, he and Yelu Xiezhen together received the dying command: they enthroned the Prince of Liang, made the empress empress dowager, and she assumed regency.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆運總宿衛事，太后益寵任之。
manualTranslations.literal: Longyun took overall charge of palace guard affairs, and the empress dowager favored and trusted him all the more.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Longyun took overall charge of the palace guards, and the empress dowager favored and trusted him all the more.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和元年，加開府儀同三司，兼政事令。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tonghe he was given the additional title Director of the Office with Peerage and made concurrent Administrator of Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tonghe era he was given the additional title Director of the Office with Peerage and made concurrent Administrator of Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，宋遣曹彬、米信將十萬眾來侵，隆運從太后出師敗之，加守司空，封楚國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, Song sent Cao Bin and Mi Xin with a hundred thousand troops to invade; Longyun accompanied the empress dowager on campaign and defeated them; he was given the additional title Defender of the Minister of Works and enfeoffed as Duke of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Song sent Cao Bin and Mi Xin with a hundred thousand men to invade, Longyun accompanied the empress dowager on campaign and routed them. He received the additional title Defender of the Minister of Works and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 師還，與北府宰相室昉共執國政。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army returned, together with Northern Chancellery Chancellor Shi Fang he jointly held state affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the army returned, he and Northern Chancellery Chancellor Shi Fang jointly directed state affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 上言山西四州數被兵，加以歲饑，宜輕稅賦以來流民，從之。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized that the four prefectures of Shanxi had repeatedly suffered warfare and, with famine added, taxes and levies should be lightened to draw back displaced people; the proposal was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the four Shanxi prefectures had repeatedly suffered warfare and, with famine added, taxes and levies should be lightened to draw back displaced people, and the court approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，太后觀擊鞠，胡裏室突隆運墜馬，命立斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, while the empress dowager watched cuju, Hu Lishi charged out and knocked Longyun from his horse; she ordered him beheaded on the spot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, while the empress dowager watched a cuju match, Hu Lishi charged out and knocked Longyun from his horse; she ordered him beheaded on the spot.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔率師伐宋，圍沙堆，敵乘夜來襲，隆運嚴軍以待，敗走之，封楚王。
manualTranslations.literal: By edict he led troops to campaign against Song and besieged Shadui; the enemy came in a night attack; Longyun kept the army strict and ready, defeated them and put them to flight, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ordered to lead troops against Song, he besieged Shadui. When the enemy attacked by night, Longyun held the army in strict readiness, routed them, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，復言燕人挾奸，茍免賦役，貴族因為囊橐，可遣北院宣徽使趙智戒諭，從之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he again memorialized that the people of Yan harbored malfeasance, sought to evade taxes and corvée, and the nobility used this as a purse; Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner Zhao Zhi could be sent to admonish and instruct them; the proposal was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again memorialized that people in Yan harbored malfeasance, sought to evade taxes and corvée, and the nobility profited from it; Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner Zhao Zhi could be sent to admonish them, and the court approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年，丁母憂，詔強起之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year, when his mother's mourning period began, an edict forcibly recalled him to office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when he entered mourning for his mother, an edict forcibly recalled him to office.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，室昉致政，以隆運代為北府宰相，仍領樞密使，監修國史，賜興化功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year Shi Fang retired from office, and Longyun replaced him as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, still heading the Privy Council, supervising compilation of the national history, and was granted the merit title Xinghua.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year Shi Fang retired, and Longyun replaced him as Northern Chancellery Chancellor while retaining the Privy Council, supervising compilation of the national history, and receiving the merit title Xinghua.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年六月，奏三京諸鞫獄官吏，多因請托，曲加寬貸，或妄行搒掠，乞行禁止。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year he memorialized that judicial officers in the three capitals often, through patronage, bent cases to grant undue leniency or recklessly applied beating and plunder, and requested that this be forbidden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year he memorialized that judicial officers in the three capitals often, through patronage, bent cases to grant undue leniency or recklessly beat and plunder, and asked that this be forbidden.

manualTranslations.zh: 上可其奏。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor approved the memorial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the memorial.

manualTranslations.zh: 又表請任賢去邪，太后喜曰：「進賢輔政，真大臣之職。」
manualTranslations.literal: He also memorialized requesting appointment of the worthy and removal of the corrupt; the empress dowager said with pleasure: "To advance the worthy and assist governance is truly the duty of a great minister."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also memorialized requesting appointment of the worthy and removal of the corrupt. The empress dowager said with pleasure, "To advance the worthy and assist governance is truly the duty of a great minister."

manualTranslations.zh: 優加賜賚。
manualTranslations.literal: He was especially favored with gifts and rewards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He received especially generous gifts and rewards.

manualTranslations.zh: 服闋，加守太保、兼政事令。
manualTranslations.literal: When mourning ended, he was given the additional titles Defender of the Grand Mentor and concurrent Administrator of Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he received the additional titles Defender of the Grand Mentor and concurrent Administrator of Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 會北院樞密使耶律斜軫薨，詔隆運兼之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Northern Chancellery Privy Councilor Yelu Xiezhen died, an edict made Longyun hold the post concurrently.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Northern Chancellery Privy Councilor Yelu Xiezhen died, an edict ordered Longyun to hold the post concurrently.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，拜大丞相，進王齊，總二樞府事。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was appointed Grand Chancellor, advanced to Prince of Qi, and took overall charge of both privy councils.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Grand Chancellor, advanced to Prince of Qi, and took overall charge of both privy councils.

manualTranslations.zh: 以南京、平州歲不登，奏免百姓農器錢，及請平諸郡商賈價，並從之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Nanjing and Pingzhou had poor harvests, he memorialized to exempt the people from the farm-implement levy and requested standardization of merchant prices in the various commanderies; both were approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Nanjing and Pingzhou had poor harvests, he memorialized to exempt the people from the farm-implement levy and requested standardization of merchant prices in the various commanderies; both were approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年，從太后南征，及河，許宋成而還。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-second year he accompanied the empress dowager on the southern campaign; reaching the river, Song sued for peace and the army returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he accompanied the empress dowager on the southern campaign; reaching the river, Song sued for peace and the army withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙王晉，賜姓，出宮籍，隸橫帳季父房後，乃改賜今名，位親王上，賜田宅及陪葬地。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Prince of Jin, granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house, then again granted his present name, ranked above the imperial princes, and given fields, residences, and burial land beside the imperial tombs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Prince of Jin, granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, and attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house. He was then granted his present name, ranked above the imperial princes, and given fields, residences, and burial land beside the imperial tombs.

manualTranslations.zh: 從伐高麗還，得末疾，帝與後臨視醫藥。
manualTranslations.literal: Returning from the campaign against Goryeo, he contracted a terminal illness; the emperor and empress came in person to oversee his medical care.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Returning from the campaign against Goryeo, he contracted a terminal illness; the emperor and empress came in person to oversee his medical care.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，年七十一。
manualTranslations.literal: He died at seventy-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-one.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈尚書令，謚文忠，官給葬具，建廟乾陵側。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Secretariat, given the posthumous title Wenzhong, supplied funeral goods by the state, and a temple was built beside Qianling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Secretariat, given the posthumous title Wenzhong, supplied state funeral goods, and a temple was built beside Qianling.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had no sons.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧三年，以魏王貼不子耶魯為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Qingning, Tiebu's son Yelu of Prince of Wei was made his heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qingning, Yelu, son of Prince of Wei Tiebu, was made his heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祚立，以皇子敖盧斡繼之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tianzuo succeeded, Prince Aoluwo was made his successor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo succeeded, Prince Aoluwo was made his successor.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟德威，侄制心。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother was Dewei; his nephew was Zhixin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Dewei; his nephew was Zhixin.

sourceRange.text: 滌魯，字遵寧。幼養宮中，授小將軍。重熙初，歷北院宣徽使、右林牙、副點檢，拜惕隱，改西北路招討使，封漆水郡王，請減軍籍三千二百八十人。後以私取回鶻使者獺毛裘，及私取阻卜貢物，事覺，決大杖，削爵免官。俄起為北院宣徽使。十九年，改烏古敵烈部都詳穩，尋為東北路詳穩，封混同郡王。清寧初，徙王鄧，擢拜南府宰相。以年老乞骸骨，更王漢。大康中薨，年八十。

context.afterSource: 滌魯神情秀徹，聖宗子視之，興宗待以兄禮，雖貴愈謙。
context.afterLocal: 滌魯神情秀徹，聖宗子視之，興宗待以兄禮，雖貴愈謙。

items.recommendation: Source text appears in the external witness but not in local JSON. Review and, if approved, restore the Chinese and translate/realign following sentences.

manualTranslations.zh: 滌魯，字遵寧。
manualTranslations.literal: Dilu, style name Zunning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dilu, whose style name was Zunning.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼養宮中，授小將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Raised in the palace in youth, he was appointed Junior General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Raised in the palace as a child, he was appointed Junior General.

manualTranslations.zh: 重熙初，歷北院宣徽使、右林牙、副點檢，拜惕隱，改西北路招討使，封漆水郡王，請減軍籍三千二百八十人。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi he successively served as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner, Right Linya, and Deputy Chief Inspector; was appointed Privy Councilor; was changed to Northwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner; was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery; and requested reduction of the military register by three thousand two hundred and eighty men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he served in turn as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner, Right Linya, and Deputy Chief Inspector, was appointed Privy Councilor, transferred to Northwestern Frontier Pacification Commissioner, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, and requested a reduction of three thousand two hundred and eighty men from the military register.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以私取回鶻使者獺毛裘，及私取阻卜貢物，事覺，決大杖，削爵免官。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, for privately taking an otter-fur coat from a Uyghur envoy and privately taking tribute goods from the Zubu, when the matter came to light he was punished with the great staff, stripped of his title, and dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, for privately taking an otter-fur coat from a Uyghur envoy and privately taking Zubu tribute goods, when the matter came to light he was beaten with the great staff, stripped of his title, and dismissed from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄起為北院宣徽使。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was forcibly recalled as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled to office as Northern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 十九年，改烏古敵烈部都詳穩，尋為東北路詳穩，封混同郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was changed to Chief Detailed Commandant of the Ugu and Dilie tribes; soon afterward he became Detailed Commandant of the Northeast Route and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made Chief Detailed Commandant of the Ugu and Dilie tribes; soon afterward he became Detailed Commandant of the Northeast Route and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧初，徙王鄧，擢拜南府宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was transferred to Prince of Deng and promoted to Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning he was transferred to Prince of Deng and promoted to Southern Chancellery Chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 以年老乞骸骨，更王漢。
manualTranslations.literal: On grounds of age he requested retirement; his princedom was changed to Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On grounds of age he requested retirement, and his title was changed to Prince of Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 大康中薨，年八十。
manualTranslations.literal: He died during Dakang at eighty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died during the Dakang era at eighty.

sourceRange.text: 蕭常哥，字胡獨堇，國舅之族。祖約直，同政事門下平章事，父實老，累官節度使。常哥魁偉寡言。年三十餘，始為祗候郎君。歷本族將軍、松山州刺史。壽隆二年，以女為燕王妃，拜永興宮使。及妃生子，為南院宣徽使，尋改漢人行宮都部署。乾統初，加太子太師，為國舅詳穩。二年，改遼興軍節度使，召為北府宰相，以柴冊禮，加兼侍中。天慶元年，致仕，卒，謚曰欽肅。

context.afterSource: 耶律虎古，字海鄰，六院夷離堇覿烈之孫。
context.afterLocal: 耶律虎古，字海鄰，六院夷離堇覿烈之孫。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭常哥，字胡獨堇，國舅之族。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Changge, style name Hudujin, was of the imperial maternal uncle's clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Changge, whose style name was Hudujin, was of the imperial maternal uncle's clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖約直，同政事門下平章事，父實老，累官節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Yuezhi was Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate; his father Shilao rose through repeated offices to military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuezhi was Acting Administrator of Affairs Below the Gate; his father Shilao rose through successive posts to military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 常哥魁偉寡言。
manualTranslations.literal: Changge was imposing in stature and sparing of speech.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Changge was imposing in stature and sparing of speech.

manualTranslations.zh: 年三十餘，始為祗候郎君。
manualTranslations.literal: Only in his thirties did he first become an attendant gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not until his thirties did he first become an attendant gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷本族將軍、松山州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively served as general of his clan and prefect of Songshan Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in turn as general of his clan and prefect of Songshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 壽隆二年，以女為燕王妃，拜永興宮使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Shoulong, because his daughter became Princess of Yan, he was appointed Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shoulong, when his daughter became Princess of Yan, he was appointed Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 及妃生子，為南院宣徽使，尋改漢人行宮都部署。
manualTranslations.literal: When the princess bore a son, he became Southern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner and soon was changed to Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the princess bore a son, he became Southern Chancellery Palace Attendant Commissioner and soon was made Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Palace Detachment.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統初，加太子太師，為國舅詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong he was given the additional title Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and made detailed commandant of the imperial maternal uncle's house.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qiantong he received the additional title Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and was made detailed commandant of the imperial maternal uncle's house.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，改遼興軍節度使，召為北府宰相，以柴冊禮，加兼侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was changed to Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner, summoned as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, and because of the imperial succession ceremony given the additional concurrent title Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner, summoned as Northern Chancellery Chancellor, and in recognition of his service at the imperial succession ceremony given the additional concurrent title Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 天慶元年，致仕，卒，謚曰欽肅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianqing he retired from office and died; his posthumous title was Qinsu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqing he retired from office and died; his posthumous title was Qinsu.
