sourceRange.text: 耶律斜軫，字韓隱，於越曷魯之孫。性明敏，不事生產。保寧元年，樞密使蕭思溫薦斜軫有經國才，上曰：「朕知之，第佚蕩，豈可羈屈？」對曰：「外雖佚蕩，中未可量。」乃召問以時政，占對剴切，帝器重之。妻以皇后之侄，命節制西南面諸軍，仍援河東。改南院大王。乾亨初，宋再攻河東，從耶律沙至白馬嶺遇敵，沙等戰不利；斜軫赴之，令麾下萬矢齊發，敵氣褫而退。是年秋，宋下河東，乘勝襲燕，北院大王耶律奚底與蕭討古逆戰，敗績，退屯清河北。斜軫取奚底等青幟軍於得勝口以誘敵，敵果爭赴。斜軫出其後，奮擊敗之。及高梁之戰，與耶律休哥分左右翼夾擊，大敗宋軍。

localRange.text: 耶律斜軫

sourceRange.text: 耶律抹只，字留隱，仲父隋國王之後。初以皇族入侍。景宗即位，為林牙，以幹給稱。保寧間，遷樞密副使。乾亨元年春，宋攻河東，南府宰相耶律沙為都統，將兵往援，抹只臨其軍。及白馬嶺之敗，僅以身免。宋乘銳攻燕，將奚兵翊休哥擊敗之。上以功釋前過。是年冬，從都統韓匡嗣伐宋，戰於滿城，為宋將所紿，諸軍奔潰；獨抹只部伍不亂，徐整旗鼓而歸。璽書褒諭，改南海軍節度使。乾亨二年，拜樞密副使。統和初，為東京留守。宋將曹彬、米信等侵邊，抹只引兵至南京，先繕守禦備。及車駕臨幸，抹只與耶律休哥逆戰於涿之東，克之，遷開遠軍節度使。故事，州民歲輸稅，鬥粟折錢五，抹只表請折錢六，部民便之。統和末卒。

localRange.text: 耶律抹只

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律抹只，字留隱，仲父隋國王之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Mozhi, courtesy name Liuyin, was of the younger line of the King of Sui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Mozhi, whose courtesy name was Liuyin, was of the younger line of the King of Sui.

manualTranslations.zh: 初以皇族入侍。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he entered attendance by virtue of imperial clan status.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first entered palace service as a member of the imperial clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 景宗即位，為林牙，以幹給稱。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he became linya and was praised for resourceful service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong acceded, he was made linya and won repute for resourceful service.

manualTranslations.zh: 保寧間，遷樞密副使。
manualTranslations.literal: During Baoning he was transferred to vice privy commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Baoning period he was promoted to vice privy commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾亨元年春，宋攻河東，南府宰相耶律沙為都統，將兵往援，抹只臨其軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring of the first year of Qianheng, Song attacked Hedong; the Southern Chancellor Yelu Sha served as supreme commander, led troops to relieve it, and Mozhi supervised his army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Qianheng, when the Song attacked Hedong, Southern Chancellor Yelu Sha was made supreme commander and marched to its relief; Mozhi supervised the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 及白馬嶺之敗，僅以身免。
manualTranslations.literal: At the defeat at White Horse Ridge he barely escaped with his life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the defeat at White Horse Ridge he barely escaped with his life.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋乘銳攻燕，將奚兵翊休哥擊敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song, riding their momentum, attacked Yan; leading Xi troops he assisted Xiuge and defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song, emboldened by their momentum, thrust into Yan; Mozhi led Xi troops to assist Yelu Xiuge and routed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 上以功釋前過。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor, for this merit, released his earlier fault.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned his earlier failures in light of this success.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年冬，從都統韓匡嗣伐宋，戰於滿城，為宋將所紿，諸軍奔潰；
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he followed the supreme commander Han Kuangsi in attacking Song and fought at Mancheng; deceived by a Song general, the armies broke in rout;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he followed Supreme Commander Han Kuangsi against the Song and fought at Mancheng; tricked by a Song commander, the armies broke in rout;

manualTranslations.zh: 獨抹只部伍不亂，徐整旗鼓而歸。
manualTranslations.literal: only Mozhi’s ranks did not fall into disorder, and he slowly reformed banners and drums and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: only Mozhi’s unit held its formation, and he slowly reformed his banners and drums and withdrew in order.

manualTranslations.zh: 璽書褒諭，改南海軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: An imperial edict in seal script commended and instructed him, and he was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Nanhai Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An imperial commendation arrived in seal script, and he was made Military Commissioner of the Nanhai Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾亨二年，拜樞密副使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Qianheng he was appointed vice privy commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianheng he was appointed vice privy commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和初，為東京留守。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he became regent of the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Tonghe he was made regent of the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋將曹彬、米信等侵邊，抹只引兵至南京，先繕守禦備。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded the frontier, Mozhi led troops to Nanjing and first repaired defenses and preparations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded the frontier, Mozhi marched to Nanjing and first strengthened the city’s defenses.

manualTranslations.zh: 及車駕臨幸，抹只與耶律休哥逆戰於涿之東，克之，遷開遠軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage arrived on inspection, Mozhi together with Yelu Xiuge met the enemy in battle east of Zhuo, took it, and was transferred to Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor arrived on inspection, Mozhi and Yelu Xiuge gave battle east of Zhuo, carried the day, and Mozhi was transferred to Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 故事，州民歲輸稅，鬥粟折錢五，抹只表請折錢六，部民便之。
manualTranslations.literal: By precedent the commandery people paid yearly taxes with each dou of grain converted at five cash; Mozhi memorialized requesting conversion at six cash, and the people of the division found it convenient.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By precedent the people of the commandery paid yearly taxes with each dou of grain valued at five cash; Mozhi memorialized to raise the rate to six cash, and the people welcomed the change.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和末卒。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tonghe he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died late in the Tonghe reign.

sourceRange.text: 耶律海裏，字留隱，令穩拔裏得之長子。察割之亂，其母的魯與焉。遣人召海裏，海裏拒之。亂平，的魯以子故獲免。海裏儉素，不喜聲利，以射獵自娛。雖居閑，人敬之若貴官然。保寧初，拜彰國軍節度使，遷惕隱。秩滿，稱疾不仕。久之，復為南院大王。及曹彬、米信等來侵，海裏有卻敵功，賜資忠保義匡國功臣。帝屢親征，海裏在南院十餘年，鎮以寬靜，戶口增給，時議重之。封漆水郡王，遷上京留守，薨。詔以家貧，給葬具。

localRange.text: 耶律海裏

context.afterSource: 論曰：當高梁、朔州之捷，偏裨之將如沙與抹只，既因休哥、斜軫類見其功，所謂失之東隅，收之桑榆。
context.afterLocal: 論曰：當高梁、朔州之捷，偏裨之將如沙與抹只，既因休哥、斜軫類見其功，所謂失之東隅，收之桑榆。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律海裏，字留隱，令穩拔裏得之長子。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Haili, courtesy name Liuyin, was the eldest son of the lingwen Balede.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Haili, whose courtesy name was Liuyin, was the eldest son of the lingwen Balede.

manualTranslations.zh: 察割之亂，其母的魯與焉。
manualTranslations.literal: During Chagai’s rebellion, his mother Dilu took part in it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Chagai’s rebellion, his mother Dilu was involved.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣人召海裏，海裏拒之。
manualTranslations.literal: They sent someone to summon Haili, and Haili refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chagai’s faction sent envoys to summon Haili, but he refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 亂平，的魯以子故獲免。
manualTranslations.literal: When the rebellion was pacified, Dilu was spared because of her son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed, Dilu was spared on account of her son.

manualTranslations.zh: 海裏儉素，不喜聲利，以射獵自娛。
manualTranslations.literal: Haili was frugal and plain, disliked sound and profit, and amused himself with archery and hunting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Haili lived frugally and plainly, cared nothing for luxury or gain, and amused himself with archery and hunting.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖居閑，人敬之若貴官然。
manualTranslations.literal: Although he lived in retirement, people respected him as if he were a noble official.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though he lived in retirement, people treated him with the respect due a high official.

manualTranslations.zh: 保寧初，拜彰國軍節度使，遷惕隱。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and transferred to tiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Baoning he was made Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and then promoted to tiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 秩滿，稱疾不仕。
manualTranslations.literal: When his term expired, he pleaded illness and would not serve.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his term expired, he pleaded illness and declined further office.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，復為南院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: After a long time he again became Great King of the Southern Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After some years he was again made Great King of the Southern Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 及曹彬、米信等來侵，海裏有卻敵功，賜資忠保義匡國功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others came to invade, Haili had merit in repelling the enemy and was granted the title Meritous Minister Loyal in Purpose, Righteous in Conduct, and Stabilizing the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded, Haili distinguished himself in repelling the enemy and was granted the title Meritous Minister Loyal in Purpose, Righteous in Conduct, and Stabilizing the State.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝屢親征，海裏在南院十餘年，鎮以寬靜，戶口增給，時議重之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor repeatedly campaigned in person; Haili was in the Southern Office for more than ten years, governing with lenience and quiet, increasing registered households and provisions, and contemporary opinion esteemed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While the emperor repeatedly took the field in person, Haili spent more than ten years in the Southern Office, governing with lenience and calm; households and provisions increased, and contemporaries held him in high regard.

manualTranslations.zh: 封漆水郡王，遷上京留守，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, transferred to regent of the Supreme Capital, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, made regent of the Supreme Capital, and died in office.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔以家貧，給葬具。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict, because his household was poor, granted funeral goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his household was poor, an edict granted funeral goods.

items.acceptedSourceText: 耶律海裏，字留隱，令穩拔裏得之長子。察割之亂，其母的魯與焉。遣人召海裏，海裏拒之。亂平，的魯以子故獲免。海裏儉素，不喜聲利，以射獵自娛。雖居閑，人敬之若貴官然。保寧初，拜彰國軍節度使，遷惕隱。秩滿，稱疾不仕。久之，復為南院大王。及曹彬、米信等來侵，海裏有卻敵功，賜資忠保義匡國功臣。帝屢親征，海裏在南院十餘年，鎮以寬靜，戶口增給，時議重之。封漆水郡王，遷上京留守，薨。詔以家貧，給葬具。

sourceRange.text: 耶律諧理，字烏古鄰，突舉部人。統和四年，宋將楊繼業來攻山西，諧理從耶律斜軫擊之，常居先鋒，偵候有功。是歲，伐宋，宋人拒於滹沱河，諧理率精騎便道先濟，獲其將康保威，以功詔世預節度使選。太平元年，稍遷本部節度使。六年，從蕭惠攻甘州，不克。會阻卜攻圍三克軍，諧理與都監耶律涅魯古往救，至可敦城西南，遇敵，不能陣，中流矢卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律諧理，字烏古鄰，突舉部人。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Xieli, style name Wugulin, was a man of the Tuju Division.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Xieli, whose style name was Wugulin, came from the Tuju Division.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和四年，宋將楊繼業來攻山西，諧理從耶律斜軫擊之，常居先鋒，偵候有功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, Song general Yang Ye came to attack Shanxi; Xieli followed Yelu Xiezhen to strike him, constantly serving in the vanguard, and had merit in scouting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when the Song general Yang Ye invaded Shanxi, Xieli marched under Yelu Xiezhen, regularly led the vanguard, and distinguished himself in reconnaissance.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，伐宋，宋人拒於滹沱河，諧理率精騎便道先濟，獲其將康保威，以功詔世預節度使選。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, on the campaign against Song, the Song men held at the Hutuo River; Xieli led elite cavalry by a shortcut to cross first, captured their general Kang Baowei, and for his merit an edict granted his family hereditary selection for military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That same year, on the campaign against Song, the Song army held the line at the Hutuo River. Xieli led elite cavalry along a bypath to ford first, captured the Song general Kang Baowei, and for this achievement an edict granted his family hereditary eligibility for military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 太平元年，稍遷本部節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taiping he was gradually transferred to military commissioner of his tribal division.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping he was gradually promoted to military commissioner of his tribal division.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，從蕭惠攻甘州，不克。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Xiao Hui to attack Ganzhou but could not take it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Xiao Hui in an attack on Ganzhou but failed to capture it.

manualTranslations.zh: 會阻卜攻圍三克軍，諧理與都監耶律涅魯古往救，至可敦城西南，遇敵，不能陣，中流矢卒。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Zubu attacked and besieged Sanke Army, Xieli went with Chief Supervisor Yelu Nielugu to rescue them; reaching the southwest of Kedun City, they met the enemy, could not form battle lines, and Xieli was struck by a stray arrow and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Zubu attacked and besieged Sanke Army, Xieli marched with Chief Supervisor Yelu Nielugu to relieve them. Reaching the southwest of Kedun City they met the enemy, could not deploy in formation, and Xieli was struck by a stray arrow and died.

sourceRange.text: 興宗即位，徙王秦，尋復為南京留守。重熙六年，進封吳國王，拜北院樞密使。八年，表請籍天下戶口以均徭役，又陳諸部及舍利軍利害。從之。由是政賦稍平，眾悅。九年，徙王楚。時天下無事，戶口蕃息，上富於春秋，每言及周取十縣，慨然有南伐之志。群臣多順旨。孝穆諫曰：「昔太祖南伐，終以無功。嗣聖皇帝仆唐立晉，後以重貴叛，長驅入汴，鑾馭始旋，反來侵軼。自後連兵二十餘年，僅得和好，蒸民樂業，南北相通。今國家比之曩日，雖曰富強，然勛臣宿將，往往物故。且宋人無罪，陛下不宜棄先帝盟約。」時上意已決，書奏不報。以年老乞骸骨，不許。十二年，復為北院樞密使，更王齊，薨。追贈大丞相、晉國王，謚曰貞。

manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xingzong took the throne, Xiaomu was transferred to Prince of Qin and soon again became Military Governor of Nanjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xingzong took the throne, Xiaomu was transferred to Prince of Qin and soon again became Military Governor of Nanjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 重熙六年，進封吳國王，拜北院樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongxi, he was advanced to Prince of Wu and appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Chongxi he was advanced to Prince of Wu and appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，表請籍天下戶口以均徭役，又陳諸部及舍利軍利害。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year, he memorialized requesting registration of households throughout the realm to equalize corvée and tax burdens, and also set forth the advantages and disadvantages of the various tribes and the Sheli Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he memorialized requesting a household register for the whole realm to equalize corvée and tax burdens, and also explained the advantages and disadvantages of the various tribes and the Sheli Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The request was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是政賦稍平，眾悅。
manualTranslations.literal: From this, government levies gradually became equitable, and the people were pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this, government levies gradually became fairer, and the people were pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，徙王楚。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year, his princedom was changed to Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year his title was changed to Prince of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 時天下無事，戶口蕃息，上富於春秋，每言及周取十縣，慨然有南伐之志。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the realm was at peace, the population was growing, and the emperor, still in the prime of life, whenever he spoke of Zhou's recovery of the ten counties would sigh with resolve and harbor a desire for a southern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the realm was at peace and the population was growing. The emperor, still in the prime of life, would sigh with resolve whenever he spoke of recovering the ten counties south of the passes and harbored a desire for a southern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 群臣多順旨。
manualTranslations.literal: Most of the ministers followed his intent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Most of the ministers echoed his wishes.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝穆諫曰：「昔太祖南伐，終以無功。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiaomu remonstrated, saying: "In former times Taizu campaigned south and ultimately achieved no success.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiaomu remonstrated, saying, "In former times Taizu campaigned south and ultimately achieved no success.

manualTranslations.zh: 嗣聖皇帝仆唐立晉，後以重貴叛，長驅入汴，鑾馭始旋，反來侵軼。

manualTranslations.zh: 自後連兵二十餘年，僅得和好，蒸民樂業，南北相通。
manualTranslations.literal: After that armies fought for more than twenty years before peace was barely restored; the common people lived in contentment and north and south were linked once more.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After that armies fought for more than twenty years before peace was barely restored; the common people lived in contentment and north and south were linked once more.

manualTranslations.zh: 今國家比之曩日，雖曰富強，然勛臣宿將，往往物故。
manualTranslations.literal: Now, though the state is said to be stronger than in former days, meritorious ministers and veteran generals have often passed away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, though the state is said to be stronger than in former days, meritorious ministers and veteran generals have often passed away.

manualTranslations.zh: 且宋人無罪，陛下不宜棄先帝盟約。

manualTranslations.zh: 」時上意已決，書奏不報。

manualTranslations.zh: 以年老乞骸骨，不許。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On grounds of age he requested retirement, but permission was refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，復為北院樞密使，更王齊，薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 追贈大丞相、晉國王，謚曰貞。

sourceRange.text: 撒八，字周隱。七歲，以戚屬加左右千牛衛大將軍。重熙初，補祗候郎君。性廉介，風姿爽郎，善球馬、馳射。帝每燕飲，喜諧謔。撒八雖承寵顧，常以禮自持，時人稱之。以柴冊禮恩，加檢校太傅、永興宮使，總領左右護衛，同知點檢司事。尚魏國公主，拜駙馬都尉，為北院宣徽使，仍總知朝廷禮儀。重熙末，出為西北路招討使、武寧郡王。居官以治稱。清寧初薨，年三十九，追封齊王。

sourceRange.text: 耶律韓留，字速寧，仲父隋國王之後。有明識，篤行義，舉止嚴重，工為詩。統和間，召攝禦院通進。開泰三年，稍遷烏古敵烈部都監，俄知詳穩事。敵烈部叛，將宮分軍，從樞密使耶律世良討平之，加千牛衛大將軍。重熙元年，累遷至同知上京留守，改奚六部禿裏太尉。性不茍合，為樞密使蕭解裏所忌。上欲召用韓留，解裏言目病不能視，議前寢。四年，召為北面林牙。帝曰：「朕早欲用卿，聞有疾，故待之至今。」韓留對曰：「臣昔有目疾，才數月耳；然料不至於昏。第臣駑拙，不能事權貴，是以不獲早睹天顏。非陛下聖察，則愚臣豈有今日耶！」詔進《述懷詩》，上嘉嘆。方將大用，卒。

sourceRange.text: 庶箴，字陳甫，善屬文。重熙中，為本族將軍。咸雍元年，同知東京留守事，俄徙烏衍突厥部節度使。九年，知薊州事。明年，遷都林牙。上表乞廣本國姓氏曰：「我朝創業以來，法制修明；惟姓氏止分為二，耶律與蕭而已。始太祖制契丹大字，取諸部鄉里之名，續作一篇，著於卷末。臣請推廣之，使諸部各立姓氏，庶男女婚媾有合典禮。」帝以舊制不可遽厘，不聽。大康二年，出耶律乙辛為中京留守，庶箴與耶律孟簡表賀。頃之，乙辛復為樞密使，專權恣虐。庶箴私見乙辛泣曰：「前抗表，非庶箴之願也。」乙辛信其言，乃得自安。聞者鄙之。八年，致仕，卒。子蒲魯。

sourceRange.text: __TOC__○蕭阿剌耶律義先（信先）蕭陶隗蕭塔剌葛耶律敵祿蕭阿剌，字阿裏懶，北院樞密使孝穆之子也。幼養宮中，興宗尤愛之。重熙六年，為弘義宮使。累遷同知北院樞密使，加同中書門下平章事，出為東京留守。二十一年，拜西北路招討使，封西平郡王。尋尚秦晉國王公主，拜駙馬都尉。清寧元年，遺詔拜北府宰相，兼南院樞密使，進王韓。明年，改北院樞密使，徙王陳，與蕭革同掌國政。革諂諛不法，阿剌爭之不得，告歸。上由此惡之，除東京留守。會行瑟瑟禮，入朝陳時政得失。革以事中傷，帝怒，縊殺之。皇太后營救不及，大慟曰：「阿剌何罪而遽見殺？」帝乃優加賻贈，葬乾陵之赤山。

sourceRange.text: 蕭塔剌葛，字陶哂，六院部人。素剛直。太祖時，坐叔祖臺哂謀殺於越釋魯，沒入弘義宮。世宗即位，以舅氏故，出其籍，補國舅別部敞史。或言泰寧王察割有無君心。塔剌葛曰：「彼縱忍行不義，人孰肯從！」他日侍宴，酒酣，塔剌葛捉察割耳，強飲之曰：「上固知汝傲狠，然以國屬，曲加矜憫，使汝在左右，且度汝才何能為。若長惡不悛，徒自取赤族之禍！」察割不能答，強笑曰：「何戲之虐也！」天祿末，塔剌葛為北府宰相，及察割作亂，塔剌葛醉詈曰：「吾悔不殺此逆賊！」尋為察割所害。耶律敵祿，字陽隱，孟父楚國王之後。性質直，多膂力。察割作亂，敵祿聞之，入見壽安王，慷慨言曰：「願得精兵數百，破賊黨。」王嘉其忠。穆宗即位，為北院宣徽使。上以飛狐道狹，詔敵祿廣之。明年，將兵援河東，至太原，與漢王會於高平，擊周軍，敗之，仍降其眾。忻、代二州叛，將兵討之。會耶律撻烈至，敗周師於忻口。師還，卒。

context.afterSource: 論曰：忠臣惟知有國，而不知有身，故惡惡不避其患。

sourceRange.text: 耶律獨攧，字胡獨堇，太師古昱之子。重熙初，為左護衛，將禁兵從伐夏有功，授十二行糺司徒。再舉伐夏，獨攧括山西諸郡馬。還，遷拽剌詳穩。西南未平，命獨攧同知金肅軍事。夏人來侵，擊敗之，進涅剌奧隗部節度使。清寧元年，召為皇太后左護衛太保。四年，改寧遠軍節度使。東路饑，奏振之。歷五國、烏古部、遼興軍三鎮節度使，四捷軍詳穩。大康元年卒，追贈同中書門下平章事。子阿思，有傳。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he served as Left Guard, led the imperial guard in a campaign against Xia with distinction, and was granted the title of Twelve-Row Jiu Chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 再舉伐夏，獨攧括山西諸郡馬。
manualTranslations.literal: When the campaign against Xia was raised again, Dumei requisitioned horses from the various prefectures west of the mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a second campaign against Xia was launched, Dumei requisitioned horses from the prefectures west of the mountains.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，遷拽剌詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: On his return he was transferred to Commandant of Zhuaila.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to Commandant of Zhuaila.

manualTranslations.zh: 西南未平，命獨攧同知金肅軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: The southwest was not yet pacified; Dumei was ordered to serve as deputy in command of Jinsu military affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the southwest was not yet pacified, Dumei was ordered to serve as deputy commander of Jinsu military affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏人來侵，擊敗之，進涅剌奧隗部節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xia forces invaded, he defeated them and was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Niela Aowei tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xia forces invaded, he defeated them and was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Niela Aowei tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧元年，召為皇太后左護衛太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qingning he was summoned to serve as Grand Guard Captain of the Left for the Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingning he was summoned to serve as Grand Guard Captain of the Left for the Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，改寧遠軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was reassigned as Military Commissioner of Ningyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was reassigned as Military Commissioner of Ningyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 東路饑，奏振之。
manualTranslations.literal: The eastern route suffered famine; he memorialized to provide relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the eastern route suffered famine, he memorialized to provide relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷五國、烏古部、遼興軍三鎮節度使，四捷軍詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: He served in succession as Military Commissioner of the Wuguo, Wugu, and Liaoxing garrisons, and as Commandant of the Sijie Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Military Commissioner of the Wuguo, Wugu, and Liaoxing garrisons, and as Commandant of the Sijie Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 大康元年卒，追贈同中書門下平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the first year of Dakang and was posthumously granted Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Dakang and was posthumously granted the title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 子阿思，有傳。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Asi has a separate biography.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Asi has a separate biography.

sourceRange.text: 奪剌體貌豐偉，騎射絕人。由祗候郎君升漢人行宮副部署。後為烏古敵烈統軍使，克敵有功，加龍虎衛上將軍，授西北路招討使。因陳北邊利害，請以本路諸部與倒塌嶺統軍司連兵屯戍。再表，不納。改東北路統軍使。乾統元年，以久練邊事，復為西北路招討使。北阻卜耶睹刮率鄰部來侵，奪剌逆擊，追奔數十里。二年，乘耶睹刮無備，以輕騎襲之，獲馬萬五千匹，牛羊稱是。先是，有詔方面無事，招討、副統軍、都監內一員入覲。是時同僚皆闕，奪剌以軍事付幕吏而朝，坐是免官。改西京留守，復為東北路統軍使。卒於官。

context.beforeSource: 清寧初，歷西南面、西北路招討使，加同中書門下平章事，卒。
context.beforeLocal: 清寧初，歷西南面、西北路招討使，加同中書門下平章事，卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 奪剌體貌豐偉，騎射絕人。
manualTranslations.literal: Duola was imposing in stature and build, and unmatched in mounted archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duola was imposing in build and excelled at mounted archery beyond all others.

manualTranslations.zh: 由祗候郎君升漢人行宮副部署。
manualTranslations.literal: From Attendant Gentleman he was promoted to Deputy Commander of the Chinese Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose from Attendant Gentleman to Deputy Commander of the Chinese Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 後為烏古敵烈統軍使，克敵有功，加龍虎衛上將軍，授西北路招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he served as Commander-in-Chief of the Wugu-Dilie tribes, had merit in defeating the enemy, was given the additional title of General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard, and was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he served as Commander-in-Chief of the Wugu-Dilie tribes, distinguished himself in defeating the enemy, was given the additional title of General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard, and was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest.

manualTranslations.zh: 因陳北邊利害，請以本路諸部與倒塌嶺統軍司連兵屯戍。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized on the advantages and disadvantages of the northern frontier, requesting that the tribes of his circuit together with the Daodaoling Commandery-in-Chief jointly garrison troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He memorialized on the strategic situation on the northern frontier, requesting that the tribes of his circuit join with the Daodaoling Commandery-in-Chief in joint garrison duty.

manualTranslations.zh: 再表，不納。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized again; it was not accepted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He submitted a second memorial, but it was not accepted.

manualTranslations.zh: 改東北路統軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: He was reassigned as Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Route.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統元年，以久練邊事，復為西北路招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qiantong, because he had long experience in frontier affairs, he was again made Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiantong, on account of his long experience in frontier affairs, he was again appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest.

manualTranslations.zh: 北阻卜耶睹刮率鄰部來侵，奪剌逆擊，追奔數十里。
manualTranslations.literal: The Northern Zubu chieftain Yeduogua led neighboring tribes in an invasion; Duola counterattacked and pursued the fleeing enemy for several tens of li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Northern Zubu chieftain Yeduogua led neighboring tribes in an invasion, Duola counterattacked and pursued the fleeing enemy for several tens of li.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，乘耶睹刮無備，以輕騎襲之，獲馬萬五千匹，牛羊稱是。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, taking advantage of Yeduogua's unpreparedness, he raided with light cavalry, capturing fifteen thousand horses and a comparable number of cattle and sheep.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year, taking advantage of Yeduogua's unpreparedness, he struck with light cavalry and captured fifteen thousand horses and a comparable number of cattle and sheep.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，有詔方面無事，招討、副統軍、都監內一員入覲。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, an edict had ordered that when a frontier region was at peace, one among the Pacification Commissioner, Deputy Commander-in-Chief, and Commandant should enter court for audience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously an edict had required that when a frontier region was at peace, one among the Pacification Commissioner, Deputy Commander-in-Chief, and Commandant should come to court for audience.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時同僚皆闕，奪剌以軍事付幕吏而朝，坐是免官。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time his colleagues were all absent; Duola left military affairs to his staff and went to court, and for this he was dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time his colleagues were all absent; Duola entrusted military affairs to his staff and went to court, and for this he was dismissed from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 改西京留守，復為東北路統軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: He was reassigned as Military Governor of the Western Capital, then again made Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Military Governor of the Western Capital and later again made Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Route.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒於官。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sourceRange.text: 興宗即位，知興中府，歷順義軍節度使、東京留守、西南面招討使，加開府儀同三司、檢校太師，兼侍中，封鄭王，賜推誠協謀竭節功臣。重熙六年，復為契丹行宮都部署，加守太師，徙王趙。拜南院樞密使，更王齊。是時帝欲一天下，謀取三關，集群臣議。惠曰：「兩國強弱，聖慮所悉。宋人西征有年，師老民疲，陛下親率六軍臨之，其勝必矣。」蕭孝穆曰：「我先朝與宋和好，無罪伐之，其曲在我；況勝敗未可逆料。願陛下熟察。」帝從惠言，乃遣使索宋十城，會諸軍於燕。惠與太弟帥師壓宋境，宋人重失十城，增歲幣請和。惠以首事功，進王韓。十二年，兼北府宰相，同知元帥府事，又為北樞密使。

context.beforeSource: 七年，左遷南京侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，尋遷南京統軍使。
context.afterSource: 十三年，夏國李元昊誘山南党項諸部，帝親征。
context.beforeLocal: 七年，左遷南京侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，尋遷南京統軍使。
context.afterLocal: 十三年，夏國李元昊誘山南党項諸部，帝親征。

manualTranslations.zh: 興宗即位，知興中府，歷順義軍節度使、東京留守、西南面招討使，加開府儀同三司、檢校太師，兼侍中，封鄭王，賜推誠協謀竭節功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xingzong ascended the throne, he administered Xingzhong Prefecture and successively served as Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army, Eastern Capital Prefect, and Southwestern Route Pacification Commissioner; he was additionally made Acting Three Excellencies of the Opening Office, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and Vice Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Counsel and Utmost Loyalty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xingzong took the throne, Hui governed Xingzhong Prefecture and held successive posts as military commissioner of the Shunyi Army, Eastern Capital prefect, and southwestern route pacification commissioner; he was further made acting three excellencies of the opening office, honorary grand preceptor, and vice director of the secretariat, created Prince of Zheng, and granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Counsel and Utmost Loyalty.

manualTranslations.zh: 重熙六年，復為契丹行宮都部署，加守太師，徙王趙。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongxi, he again became Khitan Mobile Court Chief Deployment Commissioner, was made Defender Grand Preceptor, and had his princely title changed to Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Chongxi year 6 he again became chief deployment commissioner of the Khitan mobile court, was made defender grand preceptor, and had his princely title changed to Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜南院樞密使，更王齊。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Southern Court Privy Councilor and had his princely title changed to Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Southern Court privy councilor and created Prince of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時帝欲一天下，謀取三關，集群臣議。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the emperor wished to unify the empire, planned to seize the Three Passes, and summoned the ministers to deliberate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor sought to unify the realm, plotted to take the Three Passes, and called the ministers together for counsel.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠曰：「兩國強弱，聖慮所悉。
manualTranslations.literal: Hui said: "The relative strength of the two states is something the sacred mind well knows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hui said, "The relative strength of the two states is something Your Majesty well understands.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋人西征有年，師老民疲，陛下親率六軍臨之，其勝必矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Song people have campaigned west for years; the armies are weary and the people exhausted. If Your Majesty personally leads the six armies against them, victory is assured."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song have been campaigning west for years until their armies are weary and the people exhausted; if Your Majesty leads the six armies in person against them, victory is assured."

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭孝穆曰：「我先朝與宋和好，無罪伐之，其曲在我；
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Xiaomu said: "Our previous dynasty made peace with Song; to attack them without cause puts the fault on our side;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Xiaomu said, "Our previous dynasty made peace with Song; to attack them without cause puts us in the wrong;

manualTranslations.zh: 況勝敗未可逆料。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover victory and defeat cannot be foretold in advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover victory and defeat cannot be foretold.

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下熟察。」
manualTranslations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to consider this carefully."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to consider this carefully."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝從惠言，乃遣使索宋十城，會諸軍於燕。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor followed Hui's words, then sent envoys to demand ten Song cities and assembled the armies at Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted Hui's counsel, sent envoys to demand ten Song cities, and assembled the armies at Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠與太弟帥師壓宋境，宋人重失十城，增歲幣請和。
manualTranslations.literal: Hui and the imperial younger brother led armies to press the Song frontier; the Song people, dreading the loss of ten cities, increased annual tribute and requested peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hui and the imperial younger brother led armies to press the Song frontier; dreading the loss of ten cities, the Song increased annual tribute and sued for peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠以首事功，進王韓。
manualTranslations.literal: For initiating the affair Hui was enfeoffed as Prince of Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For initiating the affair Hui was created Prince of Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，兼北府宰相，同知元帥府事，又為北樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year he additionally served as Northern Court Chancellor, joint administrator of the Marshal's Headquarters, and again became Northern Privy Councilor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 12 he additionally served as Northern Court chancellor, joint administrator of the marshal's headquarters, and was again made Northern privy councilor.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__○耶律化哥耶律斡臘耶律速撒蕭阿魯帶耶律那也耶律何魯掃古耶律世良耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。善騎射。乾亨初，為北院林牙。統和四年，南侵宋，化哥擒諜者，知敵由海路來襲，即先據平州要地。事平，拜上京留守，遷北院大王。十六年，復侵宋，為先鋒，破敵於遂城，以功遷南院大王，尋改北院樞密使。開泰元年，伐阻卜，阻卜棄輜重遁走，俘獲甚多。帝嘉之，封豳王。後邊吏奏，自化哥還闕，糧乏馬弱，勢不可守，上復遣化哥經略西境。化哥與邊將深入，聞蕃部逆命，居翼只水，化哥徐以兵進。敵望風奔潰，獲羊馬及輜重。路由白拔烈，遇阿薩蘭回鶻，掠之。都監裏繼至，謂化哥曰：「君誤矣！此部實效順者。」化哥悉還所俘。諸蕃由此不附。上使按之，削王爵。以侍中遙領大同軍節度使，卒。

items.acceptedSourceText: 耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。善騎射。乾亨初，為北院林牙。統和四年，南侵宋，化哥擒諜者，知敵由海路來襲，即先據平州要地。事平，拜上京留守，遷北院大王。十六年，復侵宋，為先鋒，破敵於遂城，以功遷南院大王，尋改北院樞密使。開泰元年，伐阻卜，阻卜棄輜重遁走，俘獲甚多。帝嘉之，封豳王。後邊吏奏，自化哥還闕，糧乏馬弱，勢不可守，上復遣化哥經略西境。化哥與邊將深入，聞蕃部逆命，居翼只水，化哥徐以兵進。敵望風奔潰，獲羊馬及輜重。路由白拔烈，遇阿薩蘭回鶻，掠之。都監裏繼至，謂化哥曰：「君誤矣！此部實效順者。」化哥悉還所俘。諸蕃由此不附。上使按之，削王爵。以侍中遙領大同軍節度使，卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Huage, courtesy name Hongyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Huage, whose courtesy name was Hongyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 善騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: He was skilled at mounted archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He excelled at riding and shooting from horseback.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾亨初，為北院林牙。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng, he served as Northern Court Secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianheng era he was made secretary of the Northern Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 統和四年，南侵宋，化哥擒諜者，知敵由海路來襲，即先據平州要地。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, on a southern invasion of Song, Huage captured a spy and learned the enemy would attack by sea; he immediately seized the strategic points of Ping Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tonghe 4, during a southern campaign against Song, Huage captured a spy, learned the enemy would strike by sea, and at once seized the key positions around Ping Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 事平，拜上京留守，遷北院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: When the affair was settled, he was appointed Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital and transferred to Northern Great King.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the crisis passed he was appointed garrison commander of the Supreme Capital and promoted to northern great king.

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，復侵宋，為先鋒，破敵於遂城，以功遷南院大王，尋改北院樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year he again invaded Song as vanguard, defeated the enemy at Suicheng, and for his merit was transferred to Southern Great King, soon changed to Northern Privy Council Director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 16 he again invaded Song as vanguard, routed the enemy at Suicheng, and for his service was made southern great king, then soon reassigned as northern privy council director.

manualTranslations.zh: 開泰元年，伐阻卜，阻卜棄輜重遁走，俘獲甚多。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Kaitai, campaigning against the Zubu, the Zubu abandoned baggage and fled; many captives and spoils were taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Kaitai 1, on campaign against the Zubu, the Zubu abandoned their baggage train and fled, and Huage took a great haul of captives and booty.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝嘉之，封豳王。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor commended him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Bin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Bin.

manualTranslations.zh: 後邊吏奏，自化哥還闕，糧乏馬弱，勢不可守，上復遣化哥經略西境。
manualTranslations.literal: Later frontier officials memorialized that since Huage's return to court, provisions were scarce and horses weak and the position could not be held; the emperor again dispatched Huage to manage the western frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later frontier officials reported that after Huage returned to court, supplies ran short, horses were weakened, and the frontier could not be held; the emperor sent Huage back to manage the western border.

manualTranslations.zh: 化哥與邊將深入，聞蕃部逆命，居翼只水，化哥徐以兵進。
manualTranslations.literal: Huage and the frontier generals penetrated deep; hearing that fan tribes had rebelled and were encamped at the Yizhi River, Huage advanced slowly with his troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huage marched deep into the frontier with border generals; learning that rebel tribes were encamped on the Yizhi River, he advanced his army at a measured pace.

manualTranslations.zh: 敵望風奔潰，獲羊馬及輜重。
manualTranslations.literal: The enemy fled at sight of his banners; sheep, horses, and baggage were captured.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The enemy broke and fled at the sight of his banners, and he seized sheep, horses, and baggage in great numbers.

manualTranslations.zh: 路由白拔烈，遇阿薩蘭回鶻，掠之。
manualTranslations.literal: The route passed through Babelie; he encountered the Aslan Uyghurs and plundered them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the march through Babelie he encountered the Aslan Uyghurs and plundered them.

manualTranslations.zh: 都監裏繼至，謂化哥曰：「君誤矣！
manualTranslations.literal: Chief Overseer Li arrived and said to Huage: "My lord is mistaken!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chief overseer Li arrived and told Huage, "My lord is mistaken!

manualTranslations.zh: 此部實效順者。」
manualTranslations.literal: This tribe has in fact submitted in good faith."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This tribe has in fact submitted in good faith."

manualTranslations.zh: 化哥悉還所俘。
manualTranslations.literal: Huage returned all captives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huage returned all the captives.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸蕃由此不附。
manualTranslations.literal: The various fan tribes therefore would not attach themselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From that time the frontier tribes would not attach themselves to the court.

manualTranslations.zh: 上使按之，削王爵。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor ordered an investigation and stripped his princely rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered an inquiry and stripped him of his princely title.

manualTranslations.zh: 以侍中遙領大同軍節度使，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He was made Vice Director while holding the distant post of Military Commissioner of the Datong Army, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made vice director with nominal command of the Datong army as military commissioner, and died.

acceptedSourceCorrections.from: __TOC__○耶律化哥耶律斡臘耶律速撒蕭阿魯帶耶律那也耶律何魯掃古耶律世良耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。
acceptedSourceCorrections.to: 耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。

sourceRange.text: 蕭阿魯帶，字乙辛隱，烏隗部人。父女古，仕至糺詳穩。阿魯帶少習騎射，曉兵法。清寧間始仕，累遷本部司徒，改烏古敵烈統軍都監。大安七年，遷山北副部署。九年，達理得、拔思母二部來侵，率兵擊卻之。達理得復劫牛羊去，阿魯帶引兵追及，盡獲所掠，斬渠帥數人。是冬，達理得等以三百餘人梗邊，復戰卻之，斬首二百餘級，加金吾衛上將軍，封蘭陵縣公。壽隆元年，第功，加同中書門下平章事，進爵郡公，改西北路招討使。乾統三年，坐留宋俘當遣還者為奴，免官。後被征，以老疾致仕，卒。耶律那也，字移斯輦，夷離堇蒲古只之後。父斡，嘗為北克，從伐夏戰歿。季父趙三，始為宿直官，累遷至北面林牙。咸雍四年，拜北院大王，改西南面招討使。大康中，西北諸部擾邊，議欲往討，帝以為非趙三不可，遂拜西北路招討使，兼行軍都統，平之，以功復為北院大王。那也敦厚才敏。上以其父斡死王事，九歲加諸衛小將軍，為題裏司徒，尋召為宿直官。大康三年，為遙輦克。大安九年，為倒塌嶺節度使。明年冬，以北阻卜長磨古斯叛，與招討都監耶律胡呂率精騎二千往討，破之。那也薦胡呂為漢人行宮副部署。壽隆元年，復討達理得、拔思母等有功，賜詔褒美，改烏古敵烈部統軍使，邊境以寧。部民乞留，詔許再任。乾統六年，拜中京留守，改北院大王，薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭阿魯帶，字乙辛隱，烏隗部人。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Aludai, courtesy name Yixin, was a man of the Wuwei tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Aludai, whose courtesy name was Yixin, came from the Wuwei tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 父女古，仕至糺詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Nugu rose in office to Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Nugu rose in office to the rank of commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿魯帶少習騎射，曉兵法。
manualTranslations.literal: Aludai in youth practiced mounted archery and understood military tactics.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Aludai trained in riding and archery and understood military tactics.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧間始仕，累遷本部司徒，改烏古敵烈統軍都監。
manualTranslations.literal: He first entered service during Qingning, was repeatedly promoted to Steward of his tribe, and was changed to Chief Overseer of the Wugu Dilie Field Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first entered service during Qingning, rose step by step to steward of his tribe, and was reassigned as chief overseer of the Wugu-Dilie field army.

manualTranslations.zh: 大安七年，遷山北副部署。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Da'an, he was transferred to Deputy Deployment Commissioner of the Northern Mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Da'an 7 he was made deputy deployment commissioner of the Northern Mountains.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，達理得、拔思母二部來侵，率兵擊卻之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year, the two tribes Dalide and Basimu invaded; he led troops and drove them back.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 9 the Dalide and Basimu tribes raided the border; he led troops and beat them back.

manualTranslations.zh: 達理得復劫牛羊去，阿魯帶引兵追及，盡獲所掠，斬渠帥數人。
manualTranslations.literal: Dalide again raided cattle and sheep and fled; Aludai led troops in pursuit, recovered all that had been plundered, and beheaded several chieftains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dalide raided again, driving off cattle and sheep; Aludai pursued, recovered everything that had been taken, and beheaded several chieftains.

manualTranslations.zh: 是冬，達理得等以三百餘人梗邊，復戰卻之，斬首二百餘級，加金吾衛上將軍，封蘭陵縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter Dalide and others with more than three hundred men blocked the frontier; he fought again and drove them back, taking more than two hundred heads; he was made General-in-Chief of the Jinwu Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Lanling County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter Dalide and more than three hundred men blocked the frontier; Aludai fought them off again, taking more than two hundred heads, and was made general-in-chief of the Jinwu Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Lanling County.

manualTranslations.zh: 壽隆元年，第功，加同中書門下平章事，進爵郡公，改西北路招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, ranked for merit, he was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, advanced in rank to Duke of a Commandery, and changed to Northwestern Route Campaign Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shoulong 1, ranked for merit, he was made associate grand councilor, advanced to duke of a commandery, and reassigned as northwestern route campaign commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統三年，坐留宋俘當遣還者為奴，免官。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Qiantong, for keeping Song captives who should have been sent back as slaves, he was dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qiantong 3 he was dismissed from office for keeping Song captives who should have been repatriated and making them slaves.

manualTranslations.zh: 後被征，以老疾致仕，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was summoned back, but retired on account of age and illness, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later summoned back to service but retired on account of age and illness, and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 耶律那也，字移斯輦，夷離堇蒲古只之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Naye, courtesy name Yisinian, was a descendant of Yilijin Puguzhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Naye, whose courtesy name was Yisinian, was a descendant of Yilijin Puguzhi.

manualTranslations.zh: 父斡，嘗為北克，從伐夏戰歿。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Wo had once served as Northern Ke and died in battle on campaign against Xia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Wo had served as a northern ke and died in battle on campaign against Xia.

manualTranslations.zh: 季父趙三，始為宿直官，累遷至北面林牙。
manualTranslations.literal: His uncle Zhao San first served as Palace Attendant and was repeatedly promoted to Northern Court Secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His uncle Zhao San began as a palace attendant and rose step by step to secretary of the Northern Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸雍四年，拜北院大王，改西南面招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianyong, he was appointed Northern Great King and changed to Southwestern Route Campaign Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianyong 4 he was made northern great king and reassigned as southwestern route campaign commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 大康中，西北諸部擾邊，議欲往討，帝以為非趙三不可，遂拜西北路招討使，兼行軍都統，平之，以功復為北院大王。
manualTranslations.literal: During Dakang, northwestern tribes disturbed the frontier; when an expedition was proposed, the emperor thought none but Zhao San would do, and appointed him Northwestern Route Campaign Commander, concurrently Field Army Commander-in-Chief; he pacified them and for his merit was again made Northern Great King.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Dakang, when northwestern tribes raided the frontier and an expedition was proposed, the emperor insisted that only Zhao San could lead it; he was made northwestern route campaign commander and field army commander-in-chief, pacified the rebels, and for his service was again made northern great king.

manualTranslations.zh: 那也敦厚才敏。
manualTranslations.literal: Naye was sincere, generous, talented, and quick-witted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Naye was sincere and generous, talented and quick-witted.

manualTranslations.zh: 上以其父斡死王事，九歲加諸衛小將軍，為題裏司徒，尋召為宿直官。
manualTranslations.literal: Because his father Wo died in service to the state, at age nine he was made Junior General of the Guards, appointed Steward of Tili, and soon summoned as Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his father Wo had died in the state's service, Naye was at age nine made a junior general of the guards, appointed steward of Tili, and soon summoned as a palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 大康三年，為遙輦克。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he served as Yaolian Ke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Dakang 3 he was made yaolian ke.

manualTranslations.zh: 大安九年，為倒塌嶺節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year of Da'an, he was made Military Commissioner of Daotaoling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Da'an 9 he was made military commissioner of Daotaoling.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年冬，以北阻卜長磨古斯叛，與招討都監耶律胡呂率精騎二千往討，破之。
manualTranslations.literal: The next winter, because the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi rebelled, he together with Campaign Chief Overseer Yelu Hulu led two thousand elite cavalry to subdue him and defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next winter, when the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi rebelled, he and campaign chief overseer Yelu Hulu led two thousand elite cavalry against him and defeated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 那也薦胡呂為漢人行宮副部署。
manualTranslations.literal: Naye recommended Hulu as Deputy Deployment Commissioner of the Han Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Naye recommended Hulu for appointment as deputy deployment commissioner of the Han palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 壽隆元年，復討達理得、拔思母等有功，賜詔褒美，改烏古敵烈部統軍使，邊境以寧。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, campaigning again against Dalide, Basimu, and others with merit, he was granted an edict of praise, changed to Commander of the Wugu Dilie Field Army, and the frontier was pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shoulong 1, on renewed campaigns against Dalide, Basimu, and others he won further merit, received an edict of commendation, was made commander of the Wugu-Dilie field army, and the frontier was pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 部民乞留，詔許再任。
manualTranslations.literal: The tribesmen begged that he remain; an edict permitted him to serve another term.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The tribesmen asked that he stay on, and an edict allowed him to serve another term.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統六年，拜中京留守，改北院大王，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiantong, he was appointed Garrison Commander of the Central Capital, changed to Northern Great King, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qiantong 6 he was made garrison commander of the Central Capital, reassigned as northern great king, and died.

sourceRange.text: 咸雍元年，加於越，改封遼王，與耶律乙辛共知北院樞密事。乙辛恃寵不法，仁先抑之，由是見忌，出為南京留守，改王晉。恤孤惸，禁奸慝，宋聞風震服。議者以為自於越休哥之後，惟仁先一人而已。阻卜塔裏幹叛命，仁先為西北路招討使，賜鷹紐印及劍。上諭曰：「卿去朝廷遠，每俟奏行，恐失機會，可便宜從事。「仁先嚴斥候，扼敵沖，懷柔服從，庶事整飭。塔裏幹復來寇，仁先逆擊，追殺八十餘里。大軍繼至，又敗之。別部把裏斯、禿沒等來救，見其屢挫，不敢戰而降。北邊遂安。八年卒，年六十，遺命家人薄葬。弟義先、信先，俱有傳。子撻不也。

context.beforeSource: 」加尚父，進封宋王，為北院樞密使，親制文以褒之，詔畫《灤河戰圖》以旌其功。
context.beforeLocal: 加尚父，進封宋王，為北院樞密使，親制文以褒之，詔畫《灤河戰圖》以旌其功。

manualTranslations.zh: 咸雍元年，加於越，改封遼王，與耶律乙辛共知北院樞密事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xianyong he was given the title yuyue, reassigned as Prince of Liao, and jointly administered Northern Court Secretariat affairs with Yelu Yixin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianyong reign he was given the title yuyue, reassigned as Prince of Liao, and jointly administered Northern Court Secretariat affairs with Yelu Yixin.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙辛恃寵不法，仁先抑之，由是見忌，出為南京留守，改王晉。
manualTranslations.literal: Yixin relied on favor and acted lawlessly; Renxian restrained him and on that account was resented, sent out as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, and reassigned as Prince of Jin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yixin relied on imperial favor and acted lawlessly. Renxian restrained him, and on that account was resented, sent out as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, and reassigned as Prince of Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 恤孤惸，禁奸慝，宋聞風震服。
manualTranslations.literal: He cared for orphans and the solitary, forbade wickedness and evil, and when Song heard of it they were awed into submission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He cared for orphans and the destitute, forbade wickedness and evil, and when Song heard of his conduct they were awed into submission.

manualTranslations.zh: 議者以為自於越休哥之後，惟仁先一人而已。
manualTranslations.literal: Commentators held that since yuyue Xiuge, Renxian alone had been such a man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Commentators held that since Yelu Xiuge as yuyue, Renxian alone had been such a man.

manualTranslations.zh: 阻卜塔裏幹叛命，仁先為西北路招討使，賜鷹紐印及劍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Zubu chieftain Taligan rebelled, Renxian was made Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit and granted an eagle-button seal and a sword.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Zubu chieftain Taligan rebelled, Renxian was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit and granted an eagle-button seal and a sword.

manualTranslations.zh: 上諭曰：「卿去朝廷遠，每俟奏行，恐失機會，可便宜從事。」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor instructed him, saying, "You are far from court; if you wait for memorials and orders on every matter, you may miss opportunities. You may act at discretion."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him, saying, "You are far from court. If you wait for memorials and orders on every matter, you may miss your chance. You may act at discretion."

manualTranslations.zh: 仁先嚴斥候，扼敵沖，懷柔服從，庶事整飭。
manualTranslations.literal: Renxian strictly posted scouts, blocked the enemy's thrusts, treated the compliant with kindness, and put all affairs in good order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Renxian strictly posted scouts, blocked the enemy's thrusts, treated those who submitted with kindness, and put all affairs in good order.

manualTranslations.zh: 塔裏幹復來寇，仁先逆擊，追殺八十餘里。
manualTranslations.literal: Taligan came raiding again; Renxian met him in counterattack and pursued, killing for more than eighty li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taligan came raiding again. Renxian met him in counterattack and pursued the enemy for more than eighty li.

manualTranslations.zh: 大軍繼至，又敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the main army arrived it again defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, it again defeated them.

manualTranslations.zh: 別部把裏斯、禿沒等來救，見其屢挫，不敢戰而降。
manualTranslations.literal: Subordinate divisions Balisi, Tumo, and others came to the rescue; seeing repeated defeats, they did not dare fight and surrendered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Subordinate divisions under Balisi, Tumo, and others came to the rescue, but seeing repeated defeats they did not dare fight and surrendered.

manualTranslations.zh: 北邊遂安。
manualTranslations.literal: The northern frontier was thus pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The northern frontier was thus pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年卒，年六十，遺命家人薄葬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year he died, aged sixty, and left instructions that his family bury him simply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he died at the age of sixty and left instructions that his family bury him simply.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟義先、信先，俱有傳。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brothers Yixian and Xinxian both have separate biographies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Yixian and Xinxian both have separate biographies.

manualTranslations.zh: 子撻不也。
manualTranslations.literal: His son was Tabuye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son was Tabuye.

sourceRange.text: 耶律阿思，字撒班。清寧初，補祗候郎君。以善射，掌獵事，進渤海近侍詳穩。重元之亂，與護衛蘇射殺涅魯古，賜號靖亂功臣，徙契丹行宮都部署。大安初，為北院大王，封漆水郡王。壽隆元年，為北院樞密使，監修國史。道宗崩，受顧命，加於越。錄乙辛黨人，罪重者當籍其家，阿思受賂，多所寬貰。蕭合魯嘗言當修邊備，阿思力沮其事，或譏其以金賣國。後以風疾失音，致仕，加尚父，封趙王。薨，年八十，追封齊國王。

manualTranslations.literal: Yelu Asi, style name Saban.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yelu Asi, whose style name was Saban.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning reign he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 以善射，掌獵事，進渤海近侍詳穩。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he was skilled at archery he managed hunting affairs and was promoted to Xiangwen of the Bohai Close Attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 重元之亂，與護衛蘇射殺涅魯古，賜號靖亂功臣，徙契丹行宮都部署。
manualTranslations.literal: In Chongyuan's rebellion he together with the guard Su shot and killed Nielugu, was granted the title Meritorious in Quelling Disorder, and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Chongyuan's rebellion he and the guard Su shot and killed Nielugu, was granted the title Meritorious in Quelling Disorder, and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 大安初，為北院大王，封漆水郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Da'an he became Great King of the Northern Court and was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Da'an reign he became Great King of the Northern Court and was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui.

manualTranslations.zh: 壽隆元年，為北院樞密使，監修國史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong he became Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat and supervised compilation of the national history.

manualTranslations.zh: 道宗崩，受顧命，加於越。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Daozong died he received the final imperial command and was given the title yuyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong died he received the dying edict and was given the title yuyue.

manualTranslations.zh: 錄乙辛黨人，罪重者當籍其家，阿思受賂，多所寬貰。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yixin's partisans were registered, those whose crimes were grave should have had their households confiscated, but Asi took bribes and pardoned many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yixin's partisans were registered, those whose crimes were grave should have had their households confiscated, but Asi took bribes and pardoned many.

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭合魯嘗言當修邊備，阿思力沮其事，或譏其以金賣國。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Helu once said that frontier defenses should be strengthened, but Asi strenuously blocked the proposal, and some mocked him for selling the state for gold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Helu once argued that frontier defenses should be strengthened, but Asi strenuously blocked the proposal, and some mocked him for selling the state for gold.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以風疾失音，致仕，加尚父，封趙王。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, because of wind disorder he lost his voice, retired from office, was given the exalted title Imperial Father, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he lost his voice to wind disorder, retired from office, was given the exalted title Imperial Father, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，年八十，追封齊國王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died, aged eighty, and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at the age of eighty and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sourceRange.text: 蕭德，字特末隱，楮特部人。性和易，篤學好禮法。太平中，領牌印、直宿，累遷北院樞密副使，敷奏詳明，多稱上旨。詔與林牙耶律庶成修《律令》，改契丹行宮都部署，賜宮戶十有五。清寧元年，遷同知北院樞密使，封魯國公。上以德為先朝眷遇，拜南府宰相。五年，轉南京統軍使。九年，復為南府宰相。重元之亂，推鋒力戰，斬涅魯古首以獻，論功封漢王。咸雍初，以告老歸，優詔不許。久之，加尚父，致仕。卒，年七十二。

context.beforeSource: 子楊九，終右祗候郎君班詳穩，贈同中書門下平章事。
context.afterSource: 蕭惟信，字耶寧，楮特部人。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭德，字特末隱，楮特部人。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao De, style name Temoyin, was a man of the Chute Tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao De, whose style name was Temoyin, was a man of the Chute Tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 性和易，篤學好禮法。
manualTranslations.literal: His nature was easygoing; he was devoted to learning and loved ritual and law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was easygoing by nature, devoted to learning, and fond of ritual and law.

manualTranslations.zh: 太平中，領牌印、直宿，累遷北院樞密副使，敷奏詳明，多稱上旨。
manualTranslations.literal: During Taiping he was put in charge of seals and tally and night watch, rose through successive posts to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat, and in memorials was detailed and clear, often winning approval of the sovereign's intent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Taiping reign he was put in charge of seals and tally and night watch, rose through successive appointments to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat, and in memorials was detailed and clear, often winning approval of the sovereign's intent.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔與林牙耶律庶成修《律令》，改契丹行宮都部署，賜宮戶十有五。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered him together with Linya Yelu Shucheng to compile the Statutes and Ordinances; he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and granted fifteen palace households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him and Linya Yelu Shucheng to compile the Statutes and Ordinances. He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and granted fifteen palace households.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧元年，遷同知北院樞密使，封魯國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qingning he was transferred to co-administrator of the Northern Court Secretariat and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qingning reign he was transferred to co-administrator of the Northern Court Secretariat and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.

manualTranslations.zh: 上以德為先朝眷遇，拜南府宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the emperor regarded De as one favored by the previous reign, he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the emperor regarded De as one favored by the previous reign, he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，轉南京統軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，復為南府宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he again became Chancellor of the Southern Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again became Chancellor of the Southern Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 重元之亂，推鋒力戰，斬涅魯古首以獻，論功封漢王。
manualTranslations.literal: In Chongyuan's rebellion he led the van and fought hard, beheaded Nielugu and presented the head, and for his merit was enfeoffed as Prince of Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Chongyuan's rebellion he led the van and fought hard, beheaded Nielugu and presented the head, and for his merit was enfeoffed as Prince of Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸雍初，以告老歸，優詔不許。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Xianyong, on grounds of age he requested retirement and return home, but a gracious edict did not permit it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianyong reign, on grounds of age he requested retirement and return home, but a gracious edict did not permit it.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，加尚父，致仕。
manualTranslations.literal: After some time he was given the exalted title Imperial Father and retired from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After some time he was given the exalted title Imperial Father and retired from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，年七十二。
manualTranslations.literal: He died, aged seventy-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-two.

sourceRange.text: 楊績，良鄉人。太平十一年進士及第，累遷南院樞密副使。與杜防、韓知白等擅給進士堂帖，降長寧軍節度使，徙知涿州。清寧初，拜參知政事，兼同知樞密院事，為南府宰相。九年，聞重元亂，與姚景行勤王，上嘉之。十年，知興中府。咸雍初，入知樞密院事。二年，乞致仕，不許，拜南院樞密使。帝以績舊臣，特詔燕見，論古今治亂，人臣邪正。帝曰：「方今群臣忠直，耶律玦、劉伸而已；然伸不及玦之剛介。」績拜賀曰：「何代無賢，世亂則獨善其身，主聖則兼濟天下。陛下銖分邪正，升黜分明，天下幸甚。」累表告歸，不許，封趙王。大康中，以例改王遼西。致仕，加守太保，薨。子貴忠，知興中府。

context.beforeSource: 乙辛由是益嫉之，除懷德軍節度使，徙漠北猾水馬群太保，卒。
context.beforeLocal: 乙辛由是益嫉之，除懷德軍節度使，徙漠北猾水馬群太保，卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 楊績，良鄉人。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang Ji was a man of Liangxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang Ji was a native of Liangxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太平十一年進士及第，累遷南院樞密副使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Taiping he passed the civil examinations and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Taiping he passed the civil examinations and was repeatedly promoted until he became Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 與杜防、韓知白等擅給進士堂帖，降長寧軍節度使，徙知涿州。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with Du Fang, Han Zhibai, and others he arbitrarily issued jinshi hall credentials; he was demoted to Military Commissioner of Changning Army and transferred to administer Zhuo Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Together with Du Fang, Han Zhibai, and others he arbitrarily issued jinshi hall credentials; he was demoted to Military Commissioner of Changning Army and transferred to administer Zhuo Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧初，拜參知政事，兼同知樞密院事，為南府宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, concurrently Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, and served as Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, concurrently Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, and Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，聞重元亂，與姚景行勤王，上嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year, hearing of Chongyuan's rebellion, he marched with Yao Jingxing to aid the throne, and the emperor commended him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on hearing of Chongyuan's rebellion, he marched with Yao Jingxing to aid the throne, and the emperor commended him.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，知興中府。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he administered Xingzhong Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he administered Xingzhong Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸雍初，入知樞密院事。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he entered to administer the Military Affairs Commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianyong he entered court to administer the Military Affairs Commission.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，乞致仕，不許，拜南院樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he requested retirement but was not permitted and was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he asked to retire, but permission was refused, and he was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝以績舊臣，特詔燕見，論古今治亂，人臣邪正。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Ji was an old minister, the emperor specially summoned him to a private audience to discuss the order and disorder of ancient and modern times and the wickedness and rectitude of ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Ji was an old minister, the emperor specially summoned him to a private audience to discuss the order and disorder of ancient and modern times and the wickedness and rectitude of ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「方今群臣忠直，耶律玦、劉伸而已；
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "Among the ministers today who are loyal and upright, only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen remain;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Among the ministers today who are loyal and upright, only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen remain;

manualTranslations.zh: 然伸不及玦之剛介。」
manualTranslations.literal: yet Shen does not match Jue in firm integrity."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet Shen does not match Jue in firm integrity."

manualTranslations.zh: 績拜賀曰：「何代無賢，世亂則獨善其身，主聖則兼濟天下。
manualTranslations.literal: Ji bowed in congratulation and said: "What age has lacked worthy men? When the age is chaotic one keeps oneself whole; when the ruler is sage one benefits all under Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ji bowed in congratulation and said, "What age has lacked worthy men? When the age is chaotic one keeps oneself whole; when the ruler is sage one benefits all under Heaven.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下銖分邪正，升黜分明，天下幸甚。」
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty minutely distinguishes the wicked and the upright and promotes and demotes with clarity—great fortune for the realm."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty minutely distinguishes the wicked and the upright and promotes and demotes with clarity—great fortune for the realm."

manualTranslations.zh: 累表告歸，不許，封趙王。
manualTranslations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized asking to return home but was not permitted and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly memorialized asking to return home, but permission was refused, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 大康中，以例改王遼西。
manualTranslations.literal: During Dakang, by precedent his princedom was changed to Liaoxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Dakang era, by precedent his title was changed to Prince of Liaoxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 致仕，加守太保，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He retired, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He retired from office, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子貴忠，知興中府。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Guizhong administered Xingzhong Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Guizhong administered Xingzhong Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 竇景庸，中京人，中書令振之子。
manualTranslations.literal: Dou Jingyong was a man of the Central Capital and son of Director of the Department of State Affairs Zhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dou Jingyong was a native of the Central Capital and the son of Director of the Department of State Affairs Dou Zhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 聰敏好學。
manualTranslations.literal: He was intelligent and quick-witted and loved learning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was intelligent and loved learning.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧中，第進士，授秘書省校書郎，累遷少府少監。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingning he passed the civil examinations, was appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Qingning era he passed the civil examinations, was appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, and was repeatedly promoted until he became Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸雍六年，授樞密直學士，尋知漢人行宮副部署事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianyong he was appointed Academician of the Military Affairs Commission and soon administered the affairs of Deputy Deployer of the Han Imperial Camp.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xianyong he was appointed Academician of the Military Affairs Commission and soon served as Acting Deputy Deployer of the Han Imperial Camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 大安初，遷南院樞密副使，監修國史，知樞密院事，賜同德功臣，封陳國公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, supervised compilation of the National History, administered the Military Affairs Commission, was granted the merit title Meritous Minister of Shared Virtue, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Da'an he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, supervised compilation of the National History, administered the Military Affairs Commission, was granted the merit title Meritous Minister of Shared Virtue, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen State.

manualTranslations.zh: 有疾，表請致仕，不從，加太子太保，授武定軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When he fell ill he memorialized requesting retirement, but was not permitted; he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian and appointed Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he fell ill he memorialized asking to retire, but permission was refused; he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian and appointed Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 審決冤滯，輕重得宜，以獄空聞。
manualTranslations.literal: In reviewing and deciding cases of wrongful detention, he weighed severity and leniency appropriately and became known for empty prisons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In reviewing cases of wrongful detention he weighed severity and leniency appropriately and became known for emptying the prisons.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，拜中京留守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Military Governor of the Central Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed Military Governor of the Central Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年薨，謚曰肅憲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he died and was posthumously titled Suxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died and was given the posthumous title Suxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 子瑜，三司副使。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yu served as Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yu served as Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

items.acceptedSourceText: 竇景庸，中京人，中書令振之子。聰敏好學。清寧中，第進士，授秘書省校書郎，累遷少府少監。咸雍六年，授樞密直學士，尋知漢人行宮副部署事。大安初，遷南院樞密副使，監修國史，知樞密院事，賜同德功臣，封陳國公。有疾，表請致仕，不從，加太子太保，授武定軍節度使。審決冤滯，輕重得宜，以獄空聞。七年，拜中京留守。九年薨，謚曰肅憲。子瑜，三司副使。

sourceRange.text: 帝晚年倦勤，用人不能自擇，令各擲骰子，以采勝者官之。儼嘗得勝采，上曰：「上相之征也！」遷知樞密院事，賜經邦佐運功臣，封越國公。修《皇朝實錄》七十卷。帝大漸，儼與北院樞密使阿思同受顧命。乾統三年，徙封秦國。六年，封漆水郡王。天慶中，以疾，命乘小車入朝。疾甚，遣太醫視之。薨，贈尚父，謚曰忠懿。

manualTranslations.zh: 帝晚年倦勤，用人不能自擇，令各擲骰子，以采勝者官之。
manualTranslations.literal: In his later years the emperor grew weary of diligence; unable to choose men himself, he had each throw dice, and whoever drew the winning lot was given office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In his later years the emperor grew weary of governing and could not choose officials himself; he had each candidate throw dice, and whoever drew the winning lot received appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 儼嘗得勝采，上曰：「上相之征也！」
manualTranslations.literal: Yan once drew the winning lot; the emperor said, "This is a sign of a chief minister!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan once drew the winning lot; the emperor said, "This is the mark of a chief minister!"

manualTranslations.zh: 遷知樞密院事，賜經邦佐運功臣，封越國公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to administer the Privy Council Office, granted the title Merit Minister Who Supports the State in Governing, and enfeoffed Duke of Yue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made administrator of the Privy Council Office, granted the title Merit Minister Who Supports the State in Governing, and enfeoffed Duke of Yue.

manualTranslations.zh: 修《皇朝實錄》七十卷。
manualTranslations.literal: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Imperial Dynasty in seventy juan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Imperial Dynasty in seventy juan.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝大漸，儼與北院樞密使阿思同受顧命。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor fell gravely ill, Yan together with Northern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Asi jointly received the final imperial command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor fell gravely ill, Yan and Northern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Asi jointly received the final imperial command.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統三年，徙封秦國。
manualTranslations.literal: In Qiantong 3 his fief was changed to the State of Qin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qiantong 3 his fief was changed to the State of Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，封漆水郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year six he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 天慶中，以疾，命乘小車入朝。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianqing, because of illness, he was ordered to enter court riding in a small carriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianqing, because of illness, he was ordered to attend court in a small carriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 疾甚，遣太醫視之。
manualTranslations.literal: When his illness grew severe, the court dispatched the chief physician to attend him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his illness grew severe, the court sent the chief physician to treat him.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，贈尚父，謚曰忠懿。

sourceRange.text: 蕭撻不也，字斡裏端，國舅郡王高九之孫。性剛直。咸雍中，補祗候郎君。大康元年，為彰湣宮使，尚趙國公主，拜駙馬都尉。三年，改同知漢人行宮都部署。與北院宣徽使耶律撻不也善，乙辛嫉之，令人誣告謀廢立事。不勝搒掠，誣伏。上引問，昏聵不能自陳，遂見殺。乾統間，追封蘭陵郡王，繪像宜福殿。

sourceRange.text: 蕭得裏底，字糺鄰，晉王孝先之孫。父撒缽，歷官使相。得裏底短而僂，外謹內倨。大康中，補祗候郎君，稍遷興聖宮副使，兼同知中丞司事。大安中，燕王妃生子，得裏底以妃叔故，歷寧遠軍節度使、長寧宮使。壽隆二年，監討達裏得、拔思母二部，多俘而還，改同知南京留守事。乾統元年，為北面林牙、同知北院樞密事，受詔與北院樞密使耶律阿思治乙辛餘黨。阿思納賄，多出其罪；得裏底不能制，亦附會之。四年，知北院樞密事。夏王李乾順為宋所攻，遣使請和解，詔得裏底與南院樞密使牛溫舒使宋平之。宋既許，得裏底受書之日，乃曰：「始奉命取要約歸，不見書辭，豈敢徒還。」遂對宋主發函而讀。既還，朝議為是。天慶三年，加守司徒，封蘭陵郡王。

sourceRange.text: 十三年春，上疏曰：「臣聞先世遙輦可汗窪之後，國祚中絕。自夷離堇雅裏立阻午，大位始定。然上世俗樸，未有尊稱。臣以為三皇禮文未備，正與遙輦氏同。後世之君以禮樂治天下，而崇本追遠之義興焉。近者唐高祖創立先廟，尊四世為帝。昔我太祖代遙輦即位，乃制文字，修禮法，建天皇帝名號，制宮室以示威服，興利除害，混一海內。厥後累聖相承，自夷離堇湖烈以下，大號未加，天皇帝之考夷離堇的魯猶以名呼。臣以為宜依唐典，追崇四祖為皇帝，則陛下弘業有光，墜典復舉矣。」疏奏，帝納之，始行追冊玄、德二祖之禮。

sourceRange.text: 張孝傑，建州永霸縣人。家貧，好學。重熙二十四年，擢進士第一。清寧間，累遷樞密直學士。咸雍初，坐誤奏事，出為惠州刺史。俄召復舊職，兼知戶部司事。三年，參知政事，同知樞密院事，加工部侍郎。八年，封陳國公。上以孝傑勤幹，數問以事，為北府宰相。漢人貴幸無比。大康元年，賜國姓。明年秋獵，帝一日射鹿三十，燕從官。酒酣，命賦《雲上於天詩》，詔孝傑坐禦榻旁。上誦《黍離》詩：「知我者謂我心憂，不知我者謂我何求。」孝傑奏曰：「今天下太平，陛下何憂？富有四海，陛下何求？」帝大悅。三年，群臣侍燕，上曰：「先帝用仁先、化葛，以賢智也。朕有孝傑、乙辛，不在仁先、化葛下，誠為得人。」歡飲至夜，乃罷。

context.afterSource: 是年夏，乙辛譖皇太子，孝傑同力相濟。

sourceRange.text: 及長，美風儀，外和內狡。重熙中，為文班吏，掌太保印，陪從入宮。皇后見乙辛詳雅如素宦，令補筆硯吏；帝亦愛之，累遷護衛太保。道宗即位，以乙辛先朝任使，賜漢人戶四十，同知點檢司事，常召決疑議，升北院同知，歷樞密副使。清寧五年，為南院樞密使，改知北院，封趙王。九年，耶律仁先為南院樞密使，時駙馬都尉蕭胡睹與重元黨，惡仁先在朝，奏曰：「仁先可任西北路招討使。」帝將從之。乙辛奏曰：「臣新參國政，未知治體。仁先乃先帝舊臣，不可遽離朝廷。」帝然之。重元亂平，拜北院樞密使，進王魏，賜匡時翊聖竭忠平亂功臣。咸雍五年，加守太師。詔四方有軍旅，許以便宜從事，勢震中外，門下饋賂不絕。凡阿順者蒙薦擢，忠直者被斥竄。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭達魯古，遙輦嘲古可汗宮分人。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Dalugu was a member of the palace division of Yaolian Khan Chaogukohan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Dalugu belonged to the palace division of Yaolian Khan Chaogukohan.

manualTranslations.zh: 性奸險。
manualTranslations.literal: In nature he was treacherous and dangerous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature he was treacherous and ruthless.

manualTranslations.zh: 清寧間，乙辛為樞密使，竊權用事，陰懷逆謀。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingning, when Yixin served as privy commissioner, he usurped power and acted arbitrarily while secretly harboring treasonous designs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingning, when Yixin was privy commissioner, he seized power and ruled arbitrarily while secretly plotting treason.

manualTranslations.zh: 達魯古比附之，遂見獎拔，稍遷至旗鼓拽剌詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: Dalugu attached himself to Yixin, won promotion, and was gradually advanced to xiangwen of the Qigu zhuala banner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dalugu attached himself to Yixin, won favor and promotion, and was gradually raised to xiangwen of the Qigu zhuala banner.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙辛欲害太子，以達魯古凶果可使，遣與近侍直長撒把詣上京，同留守蕭撻得夜引力士至囚室，紿以有赦，召太子出，殺之，函其首以歸，詐云疾薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Wanting to harm the crown prince, Yixin deemed Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he dispatched him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, summoned him out, killed him, boxed his head and returned, falsely reporting that he had died of sudden illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yixin wished to kill the crown prince, he judged Dalugu cruel and resolute enough for the task; he sent him with Inner Attendant Direct Chief Saba to the Upper Capital, where together with the acting commander Xiao Tade they led strongmen by night to the prison chamber, deceived the prince with word of an amnesty, called him out and killed him, boxed his head and returned, and falsely reported that he had died of sudden illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 以達魯古為國舅詳穩。
manualTranslations.literal: Dalugu was appointed State Uncle xiangwen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dalugu was made State Uncle xiangwen.

manualTranslations.zh: 達魯古恐殺太子事白，出入常佩刀，有急召即欲自殺。
manualTranslations.literal: Dalugu feared that the affair of killing the crown prince would be exposed; he constantly carried a knife when going in and out, and if urgently summoned intended to kill himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dalugu feared that the murder of the crown prince would come to light; he always carried a knife when he went in and out, and if urgently summoned he intended to kill himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾統間，詔樞密使耶律阿思大索乙辛黨人，達魯古以賂獲免。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qiantong, an edict had Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi conduct a sweeping search for Yixin's partisans; Dalugu escaped through bribery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qiantong, when an edict ordered Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi to conduct a sweeping purge of Yixin's faction, Dalugu bought his way free.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以疾卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he died of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he died of illness.

sourceRange.text: 牒蠟，字述蘭，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。天顯中，為中臺省右相。會同元年，與趙思溫持節冊晉帝。及我師伐晉，至滹沱河，降晉將杜重威，牒蠟功居多。大同元年，平相州之叛，斬首數萬級。世宗即位，遣使馳報，仍命牒蠟執偏將術者以來。其使誤入術者營，術者得詔，反誘牒蠟，執送太后。牒蠟亡歸世宗。和約既成，封燕王，為南京留守。天祿五年，察割弒逆，牒蠟方醉，其妻扶入察割之幕，因從之。明旦，壽安王討亂，凡脅從者皆棄兵降；牒蠟不降，陵遲而死。妻子皆誅。朗，字歐新，季父房罨古只之孫。性輕佻，多力，人呼為「虎斯」。天顯間以材勇進，每戰輒克，由是得名。會同九年，太宗入汴，命知澶淵，控扼河渡。天祿元年，燕、趙已南皆應劉知遠，朗與汴守蕭翰棄城歸闕。先是，朗祖罨古只為其弟轄底詐取夷離堇，自是族中無任六院職事者；世宗不悉其事，以朗為六院大王。及察割作亂，遣人報朗曰：「事成矣！」朗遣詳穩蕭胡裏以所部軍往，命曰：「當持兩端，助其勝者。」穆宗即位，伏誅，籍其家屬。

sourceRange.text: 敵獵，字烏輦，六院夷離堇術不魯之子。少多詐。世宗即位，為群牧都林牙。察割謀亂，官僚多被囚系。及壽安王與耶律屋質率兵來討，諸黨以次引去。察割度事不成，即詣囚所，持弓矢脅曰：「悉殺此曹！」敵獵進曰：「殺何益於事？竊料屋質將立壽安王，故為此舉，且壽安未必知。若遣人藉此為辭，庶可免。」察割曰：「如公言。誰可使者？」敵獵曰：「大王若不疑，敵獵請與罨撒葛同往說之。」察割遣之。壽安王用敵獵計，誘殺察割，凡被脅之人無一被害者，皆敵獵之力。亂既平，帝嘉賞，然未顯用。敵獵失望，居常怏怏，結群不逞，陰懷不軌。應歷三年，與其黨謀立婁國，事覺，陵遲死。

sourceRange.text: 天祚即位，乾統元年，夏遣使來賀。二年，復請尚公主。又以為宋所侵，遣李造福、田若水來求援。三年，復遣使請尚公主。十月，使復來求援。四年、五年，李造福等至，乞援。以族女南仙封成安公主下嫁乾順。六年正月，遣牛溫舒使宋，令歸所侵夏地。六月，遣李造福來謝。八年，乾順以成安公主生子，遣使來告。九年，以宋不歸地來告。十年，遣李造福等來貢。天慶三年六月，來貢。保大二年，天祚播遷，乾順率兵來援，為金師所敗，乾順請臨其國。六月，遣使冊乾順為夏國皇帝，而天祚被執歸金矣。論曰：高麗、西夏之事遼，雖嘗請婚下嫁，烏足以得其固志哉？

localRange.text: 校勘記一∶鷹鷙鳥以之名軍取捷速之義後記龍軍虎軍鐵鷂軍者仿此鳥字原脫。記，原誤「托」。據上下文義補正。二∶萬役陷河冶按萬為人名，見紀開泰元年七月。下文只釋陷河冶，「萬役」二字當刪。三∶西域大軍將名據紀保大五年後附耶律大石紀事，應作「西域大軍名」，「將」字衍。四∶禮志志字原脫，依史文例補。五∶捏褐耐犬首也犬，原誤「大」。據禮志六及國志二七改。六∶宮帳部族皆設之凡宗室外戚大臣犯罪者家屬沒入於此族字原脫。宗，原誤「宮」。據大典五二五二及百官志一補正。七∶孳息也孳，原誤「慈」。據營衛志上改。八∶寬大也寬，原誤「實」。據營衛志上改。九∶阿魯碗阿，原誤「何」。據營衛志上改。一○∶得失得本營衛志上，作赤得本。一一∶有技藝者置之帳下「有技藝者置」五字原缺，據陳士元諸史夷語音義卷三補。置，大典五二五二作「隸」。一二∶雲為戶戶，原誤「所」。據大典五二五二及食貨志上改。一三∶掌北面訊囚者訊，原誤「詔」。據大典五二五二改。一四∶後為六院六字原脫，據大典五二五二補。一五∶舔咸鹿舔，本書亦作舐；鹹，本書亦作鹼。字通。一六∶女瑰瑰，原誤「鑲」。據大典五二五二及紀應曆十四年八月、十八年九月改。一七∶穴傍樹中有金往取之果得金「樹中有金往取之果」八字原缺，據大典五二五二補。一八∶柢宮衛門外行馬也柢，周禮天官掌舍作，注雲：「，謂行馬。一九∶俟再取旨旨，原誤「二日」。據營衛志中改。
